title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
title_zh: 迈向物理AI中的递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: {physicalaifrontmatter} Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver’s knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.
paragraphs.zh: {physicalaifrontmatter} 递归自我改进（RSI）描述的是一种不仅改进自身行为、还改进其改进过程的系统。 近期的数字智能体通过重写自身代码并用可执行测试检验每个版本来验证这一理念。 将这些机制引入物理世界，需要通过代价高昂的试验从部分观测中学习，同时还要考虑不断变化的运行条件以及可能不可逆的后果。 我们将RSI置于机器人学习的背景中，并梳理从改进机器人能力到改进生成这些能力的过程的路径。 我们考察物理经验如何能够强化这些改进机制，以及由此产生的收益何时能够支持机制本身的进一步自我改进。 只有当反馈能够满足尚存的学习需求、接收该改进的组件能够利用这一改变、其价值在任务或硬件变化中得以保留、且持续实践仍然安全且可负担时，收益才能延续下去。 现有研究集中于操作任务，支持行为改进、对后续学习的益处以及流程改进。 一些系统还会改变改进者的知识或工具，但本文所综述的物理研究尚未分离出可归因于递归的收益。 我们将这些发现综合为评估原则和研究方向，面向那些在一次次试验中安全地改进自身改进方式的机器。

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves the process by which it improves, not only its behavior. The idea goes back to I. J. Good’s speculation about machines that design better machines ( Good, 1966 ) and to self-referential learners such as the Gödel machine ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) , and recent digital agents have begun to approach it ( Chen et al., 2026d ) . STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) applies a program that improves code to its own source, and the Darwin Gödel Machine ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) lets improved coding agents modify themselves; both judge each candidate with executable tests. Yet a system can get better at a task, and a fixed procedure can keep producing better versions of it, without anything recursive happening. RSI requires two further links (Section 2.2 ): what the system retains from earlier improvements must make its next revision better, and the improver , the component that revises the learning procedure, must in turn use what it has gained to help produce its own next improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）描述的是一个不仅改进自身行为，还改进自身改进过程的系统。这一思想可以追溯到 I. J. Good 关于设计更好机器的机器的猜想（Good, 1966），以及诸如哥德尔机（Schmidhuber, 2003）之类的自指学习器，而近期的数字智能体已开始接近这一目标（Chen et al., 2026d）。 STOP（Zelikman et al., 2024）将一个改进代码的程序应用于其自身源码，达尔文哥德尔机（Zhang et al., 2026c）则让经过改进的编码智能体修改自身；两者都用可执行的测试来评估每个候选版本。 然而，一个系统可以在某项任务上变得更好，一个固定程序也可以持续产出更好的版本，而其中并没有任何递归发生。 RSI 还需要另外两个环节（第 2.2 节）：系统从早期改进中所保留的内容必须使其下一次修订更好，并且改进者——即修订学习过程的组件——必须反过来利用它所获得的东西来帮助产生它自己的下一次改进。

paragraphs.en: Physical RSI asks the same question of systems that learn by acting in the physical world, such as robots. Digital RSI supplies the mechanisms (language models that write reward code or controllers, archives of earlier variants, and automated experiment loops); physical RSI tests how these mechanisms use physical experience and whether they hold under physical constraints (Figure 1 ). The physical setting changes the experimental conditions in four ways (Table 1 ). First, physical outcome checks depend on sensors and task-specific verifiers, people, or learned detectors whose reliability must be established; even an automated grasp-success check can miss what it does not sense, and an error in that judgment can be reinforced and then executed on hardware. Second, every candidate costs robot time, resets, supervision, and wear, so a revision must pay off within few trials. Third, practice changes its own conditions: objects move, grippers wear, calibration drifts, and rolling back software does not repair a damaged object. Fourth, what can be improved extends beyond prompts and code to controllers, dynamics models, and the interface to a particular body. Each difference bears on the central question of RSI, whether what one round of revision teaches the improver makes the next revision better.
paragraphs.zh: 物理RSI对那些通过在物理世界中行动来学习的系统（如机器人）提出同样的问题。 数字RSI提供机制（撰写奖励代码或控制器的语言模型、早期变体的存档以及自动化实验循环）；物理RSI则检验这些机制如何利用物理经验，以及它们在物理约束下是否成立（图1）。 物理环境在四个方面改变了实验条件（表1）。 首先，物理结果检查依赖于传感器和任务专用的验证器、人员或学习得到的检测器，必须先确立它们的可靠性；即使是自动化的抓取成功检查也可能遗漏它没有感知到的东西，而这类判断中的错误可能被强化，随后在硬件上执行。 其次，每个候选方案都要耗费机器人时间、重置、监督和磨损，因此一次修订必须在很少的试验次数内产生回报。 第三，练习会改变其自身的条件：物体会移动，夹爪会磨损，标定会漂移，而回滚软件并不能修复已损坏的物体。 第四，可改进的对象不再局限于提示和代码，还扩展到控制器、动力学模型以及与特定身体的接口。 每一个差异都关系到RSI的核心问题：一轮修订教给改进者的东西是否能让下一次修订变得更好。

paragraphs.en: Consider a robot arm that keeps missing the same grasp. The failure can have several causes, and each calls for a change kept in a different place; these places organize Sections 3.1 and 3.2 . The robot’s policy , the learned controller that turns observations into motor commands, may never produce the recovery motion; an expert correction can teach it, as RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) learns from deployment experience and corrections (Section 3.1.1 ). The robot may mistake a light touch for a stable hold because its model of contact is wrong; a world model refitted to contact data can correct the prediction and give the policy a place to practice, as in PlayWorld ( Yin et al., 2026b ) (Section 3.1.2 ). The robot may have recovered from this failure before without keeping what worked; external knowledge , such as a saved recovery or program, can be called the next time, as Zetta ( Ding et al., 2026 ) grows code-based critics and recoveries around a frozen policy in simulation (Section 3.1.3 ). Finally, the robot may keep choosing the wrong kind of repair; then the learning procedure must change: which attempts to collect, how to judge them, and how to turn them into updates (Section 3.2 ). Eureka ( Ma et al., 2024a ) rewrites reward code from simulated training results, and ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026b ) lets coding agents modify the training infrastructure from robot experiments. The first three routes improve what the robot does; the fourth improves how it learns, and it is where physical RSI would begin. Recursion would further require that knowledge of why earlier repairs worked, which we call repair knowledge , improves how the next procedure revision is made. Figure 2 contrasts this route with applying a fixed training recipe to new experience.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一个机械臂总是抓取失败的场景。 失败可能有多种原因，而每种原因需要一处不同的修改；这些位置组织了 3.1 节和 3.2 节。 机器人的策略，即把观测转化为电机指令的学习型控制器，可能从未产生恢复动作；专家纠正可以教会它，如 RECAP（Physical Intelligence et al., 2026）从部署经验和纠正中学习（3.1.1 节）。 机器人可能把轻微触碰误判为稳固握持，因为它的接触模型是错误的；用接触数据重新拟合的世界模型可以修正预测，并为策略提供练习场所，如 PlayWorld（Yin et al., 2026b）（3.1.2 节）。 机器人可能以前从这个失败中恢复过，但没有保留有效的方法；外部知识，例如保存的恢复动作或程序，可以在下次被调用，如 Zetta（Ding et al., 2026）在仿真中围绕冻结的策略扩展基于代码的评判器和恢复方案（3.1.3 节）。 最后，机器人可能一直选择错误类型的修复；这时必须改变学习过程本身：收集哪些尝试、如何评判它们，以及如何将它们转化为更新（3.2 节）。 Eureka（Ma et al., 2024a）根据仿真训练结果改写奖励代码，ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026b）则让编码智能体根据机器人实验修改训练基础设施。 前三条路径改进机器人的行为；第四条改进其学习方式，而这正是物理 RSI 的起点。 递归还需要一种知识——即关于为何早先的修复有效、我们称之为修复知识的知识——能改进下一次程序修订的制定方式。 图 2 将这条路径与把固定训练配方应用于新经验的做法进行了对比。

paragraphs.en: Our central argument is that physical experience can improve task competence, the learning procedure, and the improver that revises this procedure, and that four recurring conditions, each sharpened by the physical setting, decide whether such gains carry forward. Each can fail: the new signal may not address what the learner still lacks, because sensing shows only part of a failure; the receiving component may be unable to absorb it on its body; its value may not survive later changes in behavior or hardware; or further practice may become unsafe or unaffordable. For the grasping robot, this could mean collecting more of the grasps it already makes well, refining a contact model that its controller cannot use, relying on a fix that stops working once the gripper is replaced, or practicing until the gripper wears out. A change can improve execution and still fail to help later learning: added autonomous data often yield modest gains that saturate and can even regress ( Mirchandani et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心论点是：物理经验可以提升任务能力、学习过程，以及修订这一过程的改进者，而四种反复出现的条件——每一种都被物理环境所放大——决定了这些收益能否延续下去。 每一条都可能失效：新信号可能没有触及学习者仍然欠缺的东西，因为感知只能呈现失败的一部分；接收部件可能无法在其本体上吸收该信号；其价值可能在后续行为或硬件变更后无法保留；或者进一步的练习可能变得不安全或成本过高。 对抓取机器人而言，这可能意味着收集更多它本来就做得很好的抓取动作，改进一个其控制器无法使用的接触模型，依赖一个在夹爪被更换后就失效的修补方案，或者一直练习到夹爪磨损报废。 一项改进可以提升执行表现，却仍然无助于后续学习：新增的自主数据往往只带来有限且会饱和的收益，甚至可能导致性能退化（ Mirchandani et al., 2025 ）。

sents.en: Our central argument is that physical experience can improve task competence, the learning procedure, and the improver that revises this procedure, and that four recurring conditions, each sharpened by the physical setting, decide whether such gains carry forward.
sents.zh: 我们的核心论点是：物理经验可以提升任务能力、学习过程，以及修订这一过程的改进者，而四种反复出现的条件——每一种都被物理环境所放大——决定了这些收益能否延续下去。

sents.en: Each can fail: the new signal may not address what the learner still lacks, because sensing shows only part of a failure; the receiving component may be unable to absorb it on its body; its value may not survive later changes in behavior or hardware; or further practice may become unsafe or unaffordable.
sents.zh: 每一条都可能失效：新信号可能没有触及学习者仍然欠缺的东西，因为感知只能呈现失败的一部分；接收部件可能无法在其本体上吸收该信号；其价值可能在后续行为或硬件变更后无法保留；或者进一步的练习可能变得不安全或成本过高。

sents.en: For the grasping robot, this could mean collecting more of the grasps it already makes well, refining a contact model that its controller cannot use, relying on a fix that stops working once the gripper is replaced, or practicing until the gripper wears out.
sents.zh: 对抓取机器人而言，这可能意味着收集更多它本来就做得很好的抓取动作，改进一个其控制器无法使用的接触模型，依赖一个在夹爪被更换后就失效的修补方案，或者一直练习到夹爪磨损报废。

sents.en: A change can improve execution and still fail to help later learning: added autonomous data often yield modest gains that saturate and can even regress ( Mirchandani et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 一项改进可以提升执行表现，却仍然无助于后续学习：新增的自主数据往往只带来有限且会饱和的收益，甚至可能导致性能退化（ Mirchandani et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: Several research traditions supply pieces of this progression. Self-supervised grasping showed that physical outcomes alone can supervise behavior at scale, first by learning from tens of thousands of real grasp attempts ( Pinto and Gupta, 2016 ) and then through large-scale real-robot reinforcement learning (RL) with QT-Opt ( Kalashnikov et al., 2018 ) . Interactive imitation learning, as in DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) and HG-DAgger ( Kelly et al., 2019 ) , showed how an expert can correct the learner in the states that the learner itself reaches. Lifelong robot learning ( Thrun and Mitchell, 1995 ) asks how knowledge gained on earlier tasks can reduce the real-world experimentation needed for later ones; model-based RL, from Dyna ( Sutton, 1990 ) and PILCO ( Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011 ) to Dreamer ( Hafner et al., 2020 ) , asks how recorded transitions can support practice inside a learned model; and skill-based approaches, such as options ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) and the shared RoboEarth knowledge base ( Waibel et al., 2011 ) , ask how an extended behavior can be stored and called again. Each tradition widened what one learning episode can pass on to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 若干研究传统为这一发展脉络提供了各自的组成部分。 自监督抓取表明，仅有物理结果就足以在大规模上监督行为：首先是通过数万次真实抓取尝试进行学习（Pinto and Gupta, 2016），随后是通过 QT-Opt 进行大规模真实机器人强化学习（RL）（Kalashnikov et al., 2018）。 交互式 imitation learning，如 DAgger（Ross et al., 2011）和 HG-DAgger（Kelly et al., 2019），展示了专家如何在智能体自身所处的状态下对其进行纠正。 终身机器人学习（Thrun and Mitchell, 1995）探讨在早期任务中获得的知识如何减少后续任务所需的真实世界实验；基于模型的强化学习，从 Dyna（Sutton, 1990）、PILCO（Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011）到 Dreamer（Hafner et al., 2020），探讨如何利用记录下来的状态转移在已学习的模型内部进行练习；而基于技能的方法，如 options（Sutton et al., 1999）和共享的 RoboEarth 知识库（Waibel et al., 2011），则探讨如何存储一个较长的行为并再次调用它。 每个传统都扩展了一次学习经历能够传递给下一次的内容。

sents.en: Several research traditions supply pieces of this progression.
sents.zh: 若干研究传统为这一发展脉络提供了各自的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Recent generalist and foundation-model-based systems widen both what can change and what role the change plays. RoboCat ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) turns a policy adapted to a new task into a source of training data for the next generalist, and SILVR ( Luo et al., 2026a ) revises a video-based planner using its own executions. In RoboCat, Eureka (in simulation), and ENPIRE, experience reaches the machinery that produces future updates (a data collector, a reward function, the training infrastructure) as well as the policy that receives them. This brings the physical problem close to the long-standing aspiration of learning to learn ( Thrun and Pratt, 1998 ) , and several reviewed systems already contain the components that a demonstration of recursion would need. The open question is how to realize that aspiration with limited trials, imperfect sensing, and a body that changes over time.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的通用型智能体与基于基础模型的系统，同时拓宽了什么可以改变以及改变所扮演的角色。 RoboCat（Bousmalis et al., 2024）将一个适配到新任务的策略转化为下一个通用型智能体的训练数据来源，而 SILVR（Luo et al., 2026a）利用其自身的执行结果来修正基于视频的规划器。 在 RoboCat、Eureka（仿真中）以及 ENPIRE 中，经验不仅到达产生未来更新的机制（数据采集器、奖励函数、训练基础设施），也到达接收这些更新的策略。 这使物理问题接近于“学习如何学习”这一长期以来的愿景（Thrun and Pratt, 1998），并且若干被综述的系统已经包含验证递归所需的组件。 尚待解决的问题是如何在试验次数有限、感知不完善以及身体随时间变化的条件下实现这一愿景。

paragraphs.en: Our scope is the improvement of policies, world models, memories, skills, and the software procedures that update or use them, whenever their evidence or evaluation is connected to physical action. We discuss hardware change when it affects compatibility, maintenance, or continued experimentation. Autonomous morphology design and physical self-reconstruction are adjacent topics outside our scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的范围是改进策略、世界模型、记忆、技能，以及更新或使用它们的软件流程，只要其证据或评估与物理动作相关。 当硬件变更影响兼容性、维护或持续实验时，我们会讨论硬件变更。 自主形态设计与物理自我重建是相邻主题，不在我们的范围之内。

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys cover neighboring ground (Table 2 ). Some focus on agents and embodiment: recursive self-improvement in AI systems ( Chen et al., 2026d ) , self-evolving agents ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , weights versus executable skills as stores of improvement ( Jena et al., 2026 ) , self-evolving embodied AI ( Feng et al., 2026 ) and humanoids ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) , and levels of physical recursive self-improvement ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) . Others analyze world models for robot learning ( Hou et al., 2026 ) and manipulation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , joint world–action models ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , actionable simulators ( Chen and Zhu, 2026 ) , verifiers for robot policies ( Wan et al., 2026 ) , and physical AI broadly ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) . Our organizing question is different: after a change has been acquired, who uses it next, and what does that use improve? Component names alone cannot answer it, because two data collectors with similar task success can yield training data of very different value; a more accurate predictor can still produce less useful training data for a policy; and the same kind of retrieved memory can change either how a program is repaired or how an outcome is judged.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的综述已涵盖了相邻领域的内容（表 2）。 一些综述聚焦于智能体与具身性：AI 系统中的递归自我改进（Chen et al., 2026d）、自演化智能体（Gao et al., 2025）、权重与可执行技能作为改进的存储形式（Jena et al., 2026）、自演化的具身 AI（Feng et al., 2026）与人形机器人（Nguyen et al., 2026），以及物理递归自我改进的层级（Zhou et al., 2026a）。 另一些综述分析了用于机器人学习的世界模型（Hou et al., 2026）与操作（Wang et al., 2026a）、世界–行动联合模型（Lu et al., 2026b）、可行动的模拟器（Chen and Zhu, 2026）、机器人策略的验证器（Wan et al., 2026），以及广义上的物理 AI（Xiang et al., 2025）。 我们的组织性问题有所不同：在一项改进被获取之后，接下来由谁使用它，而这种使用又改进了什么？ 仅凭组件名称无法回答这个问题，因为两个任务成功率相近的数据采集器可能产生价值差异极大的训练数据；一个更准确的预测器仍可能产生对策略而言用处更小的训练数据；而同一种被检索的记忆，既可能改变程序如何被修复，也可能改变结果如何被评判。

paragraphs.en: The review makes three connected contributions. First, it positions RSI within robot learning by separating method paradigms and problem settings (from reinforcement learning and meta-learning to AutoML) from a ladder of claims (behavioral improvement, later-learning benefit, procedure improvement, and the two links of recursion), each defined by the comparison that would establish it. It organizes physical self-improvement along that ladder according to where experience leaves its change and which decision of the learning procedure it revises, showing that data volume and component accuracy are unreliable proxies for progress. Second, it separates mechanisms that change an improver’s knowledge or tools from evidence that the improver has improved: existing studies support the first three claims, while recursive gains still need dedicated verification. It reviews digital precedents and physical boundary cases and specifies a two-round experiment that could isolate the recursive relation, together with its controls and an estimate of its hardware cost; Table 13 records where the reviewed studies stand on each claim. Third, it names the four breakdowns above as recurring conditions ( informative feedback , usability , robustness to distribution shift , and continued practice ) and shows how each fails and which capability would restore it. Four research questions organize the review.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述做出了三项相互关联的贡献。 首先，它将 RSI 置于机器人学习领域之中，区分了各类方法范式与问题设定（从强化学习、元学习到 AutoML），以及一个由断言构成的阶梯（行为改进、后续学习收益、流程改进，以及递归的两个环节），每条断言都由能够确立它的对比所定义。 它依据经验在何处留下改变、以及修订了学习流程中的哪一决策，将物理自我改进沿该阶梯加以组织，表明数据量与组件精度是衡量进展的不可靠代理指标。 其次，它将改变改进者知识或工具的机制与改进者确有改进的证据区分开来：现有研究支持前三条断言，而递归收益仍需专门的验证。 它回顾了数字化先例与物理边界案例，并给出了一个能够分离递归关系的两轮实验设计，连同其对照条件与硬件成本估算；表 13 记录了所回顾研究在各条断言上的立场。 第三，它将上述四种失效归纳为反复出现的条件（信息性反馈、可用性、对分布偏移的鲁棒性以及持续练习），并说明每种条件如何失效，以及哪种能力能够予以恢复。 四个研究问题组织起本综述的整体结构。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 lays the foundations: a primer for newcomers (Section 2.1 ), where improvement is kept, the ladder from self-improvement to recursion, the position of RSI relative to neighboring learning paradigms (Section 2.3 ), and the benchmarks and metrics used in the reviewed studies (Section 2.5 ); Figure 3 maps the review, and Appendix C collects the terms. Section 3 climbs the ladder, from improving the learner (Section 3.1 ) and the learning procedure (Section 3.2 ) to improving the improver (Section 3.3 ) and closing the recursive loop (Section 3.4 ). Section 4 turns to what current evaluation cannot yet measure, why gains stop compounding, how practice can stay safe, and which problems remain open, including the two-round test that recursion would require. \physicalaisectionaccent PAIInk
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节奠定基础：面向新手的入门介绍（第 2.1 节），改进内容的保存方式，从自我改进到递归的阶梯，递归自我改进（RSI）相对于邻近学习范式的定位（第 2.3 节），以及所综述研究使用的基准与指标（第 2.5 节）；图 3 给出本综述的结构图，附录 C 汇总了相关术语。 第 3 节沿着阶梯逐级而上：从改进学习者（第 3.1 节）和学习过程（第 3.2 节），到改进改进者本身（第 3.3 节），再到闭合递归回路（第 3.4 节）。 第 4 节讨论当前评估尚无法衡量什么、收益为何会停止累积、实践如何保持安全，以及哪些问题仍然悬而未决，其中包括递归所需的两轮测试。 \physicalaisectionaccent PAIInk

paragraphs.en: We follow every system in this review along one path: from experience, to a retained change, to the change’s next use. Later sections use this path to work out when a gain survives another round, without assuming a common architecture.

paragraphs.en: A few groups of ideas are enough to follow the rest of the review. We introduce them with the running example of the robot that keeps missing a grasp.
paragraphs.zh: 几组概念就足以理解本综述的其余内容。 我们通过一个机器人总是抓取失败的持续示例来介绍这些概念。

paragraphs.en: A policy is the controller that maps what the robot currently observes (camera images, joint angles, force readings, and possibly a language instruction) to its next motor command; for the grasping robot, it turns a view of the object into the next movement of the arm and gripper. In the systems reviewed here, policies are usually neural networks. Generalist policies are trained on large collections of robot data spanning many tasks, as in RT-1 ( Brohan et al., 2023b ) , and sometimes many robot bodies, or embodiments , as in Octo ( Octo Model Team et al., 2024 ) . A vision-language model (VLM) reads images and text and outputs text; robot systems often use one to propose goals or to judge whether an attempt succeeded. A vision-language-action (VLA) model is a generalist policy built on a pretrained VLM, so that it reads images and an instruction and outputs actions; RT-2 ( Brohan et al., 2023a ) , OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2025 ) are examples. Many recent policies output a short sequence of future actions at once, called an action chunk .
paragraphs.zh: 策略是一种控制器，它将机器人当前观测到的内容（相机图像、关节角度、力读数，以及可能的语言指令）映射为其下一个电机指令；对于抓取机器人而言，策略将物体的视野转化为机械臂和夹爪的下一个动作。 在本文回顾的系统中，策略通常是神经网络。 通用策略是在跨多个任务的大型机器人数据集合上训练的，如 RT-1（Brohan et al., 2023b），有时也在多种机器人本体或具身形态上训练，如 Octo（Octo Model Team et al., 2024）。 视觉-语言模型（VLM）读取图像和文本并输出文本；机器人系统常用它来提出目标或判断一次尝试是否成功。 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是构建在预训练 VLM 之上的通用策略，因此它读取图像和指令并输出动作；RT-2（Brohan et al., 2023a）、OpenVLA（Kim et al., 2024）和 π 0 \pi_{0}（Black et al., 2025）都是例子。 许多近期的策略一次性输出一段较短的未来动作序列，称为动作块。

paragraphs.en: The simplest way to obtain a policy is imitation learning from demonstrations, which are often recorded while a person teleoperates the robot ( Argall et al., 2009 ) . In behavior cloning (BC), the policy is trained to reproduce the demonstrated action in each recorded situation. BC learns only from recorded situations, so its small errors can compound: if the gripper drifts slightly off the object into a state that no demonstration covers, the policy may have no good action to take. Interactive methods such as DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) address this by asking an expert what to do in the situations that the learner itself reaches. In practice, a person often takes over when the robot errs, and these interventions supply corrective training data.
paragraphs.zh: 获取策略最简单的方法是从示教数据中进行模仿学习，这些示教数据通常是在人遥操作机器人时记录下来的（Argall et al., 2009）。 在行为克隆（BC）中，策略被训练以在每个被记录的情境中复现示教的动作。 BC 只从被记录的情境中学习，因此其微小的误差可能会不断累积：如果夹爪稍微偏离物体、进入没有示教覆盖的状态，策略可能就没有好的动作可以执行。 诸如 DAgger（Ross et al., 2011）之类的交互式方法通过询问专家在学习者自身到达的情境中该怎么做来解决这一问题。 在实践中，当机器人出错时，人通常会接管控制，而这些干预提供了纠正性的训练数据。

paragraphs.en: In reinforcement learning (RL) ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ; Kober et al., 2013 ) , the robot instead tries actions and receives a reward that scores the outcome, for example 1 for a stable grasp and 0 otherwise. On a real robot, rewards do not arrive automatically: a person, a hand-written check, or a learned reward model , such as a success detector, must judge each attempt. We call a component that supplies such judgments for learning an evaluator . Because rewards are often sparse and delayed, many methods learn a value function , or critic , that predicts how much future reward to expect; some systems use the word critic more loosely for any component, learned or hand-written, that scores behavior. The advantage of an action measures how much better it is than what the policy would typically do in the same situation. Off-policy methods can learn from experience collected by earlier versions of the policy or by other sources, which they keep in a replay buffer . On hardware, every trial costs time, supervision, wear, and a reset that returns the scene to a usable starting state, so the source of the reward and the number of available trials become central resources.
paragraphs.zh: 在强化学习（reinforcement learning, RL）（Sutton and Barto, 2018；Kober et al., 2013）中，机器人转而尝试各种动作并接收一个对结果打分的奖励，例如稳定抓取得 1 分，否则得 0 分。 在真实机器人上，奖励不会自动产生：必须由某个人、某段手写的检查逻辑或某个学习得到的奖励模型（例如成功检测器）来评判每一次尝试。 我们把为学习提供此类评判的组件称为评估器（evaluator）。 由于奖励往往稀疏且延迟，许多方法会学习一个价值函数（value function），即评论家（critic），用于预测未来可期望获得多少奖励；一些系统对「评论家」一词的使用较为宽泛，泛指任何对行为进行打分的组件，无论其是学习得到的还是手写的。 动作的优势（advantage）衡量的是该动作比策略在同一情境下通常会采取的做法好多少。 异策略（off-policy）方法可以从由策略的早期版本或其他来源收集的经验中学习，这些经验被保存在经验回放缓冲区（replay buffer）中。 在硬件上，每次尝试都要耗费时间、监督、磨损，以及一次将场景恢复到可用初始状态的重置，因此奖励的来源和可用尝试的次数成为核心资源。

paragraphs.en: Large pretrained policies are rarely retrained from scratch. They are fine-tuned , or post-trained, on new data. A small residual policy can add corrections on top of the actions of a frozen base policy, such as a slight change to the angle at which the gripper approaches the object. Distillation trains one policy to imitate another, for example to fold a specialist’s behavior back into a generalist. When a policy learns a sequence of tasks, it can forget earlier ones, a problem studied in continual learning ( Parisi et al., 2019 ) ; replaying stored data from earlier tasks is a common protection.
paragraphs.zh: 大型预训练策略很少从零开始重新训练。 它们会在新数据上进行微调，或称后训练。 一个小型残差策略可以在冻结的基础策略的动作之上添加修正，例如对夹爪接近物体的角度做微小调整。 蒸馏训练一个策略去模仿另一个策略，例如把专家策略的行为折叠回通才策略中。 当策略学习一系列任务时，可能会遗忘较早的任务，这是持续学习（Parisi et al., 2019）中研究的问题；重放早期任务存储的数据是一种常见的保护手段。

paragraphs.en: A world model , or dynamics model, predicts what will happen after an action, for instance the next camera image or the next object positions ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ) . The grasping robot’s contact model is one example: it predicts whether a touch will become a stable hold. A robot can use such a model to plan , by imagining the outcomes of candidate actions, or to generate imagined experience on which a policy is trained. A physics simulator is a hand-built model of this kind; a learned world model is fitted to recorded robot data and can be wrong in ways that a policy may learn to exploit.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型（world model），或称动力学模型（dynamics model），用于预测动作执行后会发生什么，例如下一帧相机图像或下一时刻的物体位置（Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner et al., 2020）。 抓取机器人的接触模型就是一个例子：它预测一次触碰是否会变成稳定的抓持。 智能体可以利用这样的模型进行规划，即在头脑中想象候选动作的结果；或者用它生成想象出的经验，供策略在其上进行训练。 物理仿真器是人工构建的此类模型；而学习得到的世界模型是根据记录的机器人数据拟合出来的，可能会以策略学会加以利用的方式出错。

paragraphs.en: Not every improvement is stored in network weights. A system can keep memories of earlier episodes, maintain a library of callable skills ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) , or write programs that compose perception and control functions ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . Large language models are increasingly used to write such code or to revise reward functions ( Ma et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 并非每项改进都会存储在网络权重中。 一个系统可以保留先前情节的记忆，维护一个可调用技能的库（Sutton et al., 1999），或者编写将感知与控制功能组合起来的程序（Liang et al., 2023）。 大语言模型越来越多地被用来编写此类代码或修改奖励函数（Ma et al., 2024a）。

paragraphs.en: Results come either from simulation benchmarks or from hardware experiments on physical robots, and training in simulation before deployment on hardware is called sim-to-real transfer. Section 2.4 discusses what each setting can establish.

paragraphs.en: We consider loops in which experience produces a retained change that affects later attempts or learning. Human demonstration, correction, reset, or approval can remain part of the loop: automation concerns who makes each decision, whereas learning concerns whether experience changes it (Table 17 in Appendix A ). A failed update can also be informative by showing where this connection breaks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑这样一类循环：经验会产生一种被保留的变化，该变化会影响后续的尝试或学习。 人类演示、纠正、重置或批准仍可作为循环的一部分：自动化关注的是由谁做出每个决策，而学习关注的是经验是否会改变这一决策（见附录 A 中的表 17）。 失败的更新同样具有信息量，因为它能揭示这种联系在哪里断裂。

paragraphs.en: Generic pretraining without a subsequent experience–update–use comparison serves as background, as does adaptation confined to a single attempt. Rapid Motor Adaptation ( Kumar et al., 2021 ) , for example, infers current conditions from recent history without retaining the adaptation. Zeva’s interaction memory is a boundary case: it carries across retries within an episode but not across episodes or learning rounds. Simulation-only and formal studies supply enabling mechanisms, while meta-learning, AutoML, and digital agents supply precedents (Section 2.3 ); direct evidence about physical RSI must come from physical systems.
paragraphs.zh: 没有后续「经验–更新–使用」对比的通用预训练只起背景作用，局限于单次尝试的适应也是如此。 例如，快速运动适应（Rapid Motor Adaptation，Kumar et al., 2021）从近期历史推断当前状况，但不保留该适应。 Zeva 的交互记忆是一个边界情形：它在一次情节内的多次重试之间保持，但不跨情节或跨学习轮次保持。 仅仿真和形式化研究提供了使能机制，而元学习、AutoML 和数字智能体提供了先例（第 2.3 节）；关于物理 RSI 的直接证据必须来自物理系统。

paragraphs.en: A retained change can serve four uses (Figure 4 ). It can choose or execute actions, predict outcomes or supply practice, support reuse (for example, calling a saved recovery or consulting guidance for a new program), or change how later data are collected, judged, and turned into updates. These uses are usually carried by policies, world models, external knowledge, and learning procedures, respectively (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). They can overlap: a policy can collect training data, a model can judge outcomes, and a memory can guide an updater. Each study is discussed mainly under the use its experiment tests, regardless of whether its authors call it self-evolving or recursively self-improving.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的变更可以发挥四种用途（图 4）。 它可以选择或执行动作、预测结果或提供练习、支持复用（例如，调用已保存的恢复方案或查阅新程序的指导），或者改变后续数据被收集、评估并转化为更新的方式。 这些用途通常分别由策略、世界模型、外部知识和学习程序来承载（第 3.1 节和第 3.2 节）。 它们可能重叠：策略可以收集训练数据，模型可以评估结果，记忆可以指导更新器。 每项研究主要在其实验所测试的用途下进行讨论，无论其作者是否称之为自进化或递归自改进。

paragraphs.en: The learner acquires task capabilities; the learning procedure determines what experience to collect, how to judge it, and how to construct updates. An improver proposes or selects revisions of that procedure. It may be a person, a fixed rule, a search process, or a learned component, with knowledge in memory, weights, code, or prompts. Figure 2 separates the two levels: the learner improves under a fixed recipe, whereas the improver revises the recipe itself.
paragraphs.zh: 学习者获得任务能力；学习过程决定收集什么经验、如何评判经验以及如何构建更新。 改进者提出或选择对该过程的修订。 它可以是一个人、一条固定规则、一个搜索过程或一个学习到的组件，其知识存在于记忆、权重、代码或提示中。 图 2 区分了这两个层级：学习者在固定的方案下进行改进，而改进者则修订方案本身。

sents.en: The learner acquires task capabilities; the learning procedure determines what experience to collect, how to judge it, and how to construct updates.
sents.zh: 学习者获得任务能力；学习过程决定收集什么经验、如何评判经验以及如何构建更新。

sents.en: An improver proposes or selects revisions of that procedure.
sents.zh: 改进者提出或选择对该过程的修订。

paragraphs.en: In the grasp example, adding a corrected grasp to the training data is a repair , an update made in response to an observed failure or limitation. The rule choosing which failed grasps need correction belongs to the learning procedure; whoever devises or changes that rule is the improver. The object being changed determines the role: an editor of task skills or data belongs to the procedure, whereas an editor of rewards, evaluators, collection rules, or update-generating training code acts as an improver.
paragraphs.zh: 在抓取的例子中，向训练数据添加一次修正后的抓取是一种修复，即为响应观察到的失败或局限而做出的更新。 选择哪些失败抓取需要修正的规则属于学习过程；而设计或修改该规则的人则是改进者。 被修改的对象决定了角色：任务技能或数据的编辑者属于过程，而奖励、评估器、收集规则或生成更新的训练代码的编辑者则充当改进者。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish four claims (Table 3 ), and evidence for an earlier claim does not establish a later one. Behavioral improvement means better execution under a common task test. A later-learning benefit means that retained data, weights, models, skills, or code help a subsequent learner. Procedure improvement means that a revised collector, evaluator, editor, or updater teaches better than its earlier version. This comparison requires matched learners , which differ only in the component under test and share starting conditions, resources, and evaluation protocol (Figure 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分了四种主张（表3），对较早主张的证据并不能确立较晚的主张。 行为改进意味着在共同任务测试下有更好的执行表现。 后续学习收益意味着保留的数据、权重、模型、技能或代码能够帮助后续的学习者。 流程改进意味着经过修订的采集器、评估器、编辑器或更新器比其早期版本教得更好。 这一比较需要匹配的学习者，它们仅在受测组件上不同，并共享相同的起始条件、资源和评估协议（图8）。

sents.zh: 流程改进意味着经过修订的采集器、评估器、编辑器或更新器比其早期版本教得更好。

sents.en: This comparison requires matched learners , which differ only in the component under test and share starting conditions, resources, and evaluation protocol (Figure 8 ).

paragraphs.en: We operationalize recursive self-improvement through two further links, which this review uses as empirical criteria for attributing a gain to recursion. First (R1), repair knowledge retained from earlier repairs must improve the improver: on new failures, its procedures must teach matched learners better than those produced by its earlier version. Second (R2), the improver, once improved, must help produce its own next improvement: given the same new repair histories, a self-revision proposed using its acquired knowledge must yield an improver that outperforms both the improver it revised and a revision of that same improver proposed with the acquired knowledge frozen. A fixed improver can repeatedly improve procedures without satisfying either link; an external designer’s growing expertise does not establish system-level recursion either. Section 3.3 develops the grasp example. A concurrent survey grades physical RSI by whether an update changes capabilities or the improvement procedure and whether its gain holds on the same or on other tasks, reserving its top level for an independently verified recursive gain ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) ; the claims here are instead defined by the comparison that would establish each. The name is shared by other concurrent work. PhysRSI-eval ( Li et al., 2026j ) applies it to agents with frozen weights that revise code, tools, and notes after each graded attempt, and Physical RSI 1.0 ( MMLab & PhysicalRSI contributors, 2026 ) names a system in which a multimodal foundation model revises the harness through which a robot acts. We read these works, like any other, by the comparisons they report; a name does not establish either link. Behavioral improvement means J ⁡ ( L ′ ) > J ⁡ ( L ) J(L^{\prime})>J(L) .

paragraphs.en: In R1, the right-hand side is the frozen-knowledge control. In R2, the first term requires the successor to improve on its parent, so a revision that changes nothing cannot pass; the second revises the same parent with the acquired knowledge frozen and so isolates what that knowledge contributes to the revision. Withholding the acquired knowledge while keeping the same parent is straightforward when that knowledge resides in a memory snapshot, code, or prompts; when it is stored in the improver’s weights, the R2 control needs a design of its own.
paragraphs.zh: 在 R1 中，右侧是冻结知识的对照组。 在 R2 中，第一项要求后继者优于其父代，因此没有任何改动的修订无法通过；第二项在冻结所获知识的情况下对同一父代进行修订，从而分离出该知识对修订的贡献。 当所获知识存放在记忆快照、代码或提示中时，在保持同一父代的情况下扣留该知识很简单；当它存储在改进器的权重中时，R2 对照组需要专门的设计。

paragraphs.en: For R1 and R2, we distinguish mechanism only , where machinery could change the improver; an uncontrolled result , consistent with a link but without a control that withholds only what was acquired; and a controlled result , which tests that contribution with matched learners and budgets (Section 4.4 ). The claim and its level of support are separate.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 R1 和 R2，我们只区分机制，其中机械装置可以改变改进者；无控制的结果，与某一联系一致但缺少只扣留已习得内容的控制；以及有控制的结果，它用匹配的学习者和预算来检验该贡献（第 4.4 节）。 该主张与其支持程度是分开的。

paragraphs.en: Two controls answer different questions. A frozen-knowledge control withholds acquired repair knowledge while retaining the improver, testing that knowledge’s contribution to the procedures produced (R1) or the self-revision proposed (R2). A fixed-improver control keeps the initial improver while the rest of the system improves. A gain over it shows that revising the improver contributes to later improvement, bearing on R2, but does not identify which acquired knowledge caused the revision.
paragraphs.zh: 两种对照回答的是不同的问题。 冻结知识对照在保留改进器的同时，屏蔽已习得的修复知识，用于检验这些知识对所产出的流程（R1）或所提出的自我修订（R2）的贡献。 固定改进器对照在系统其余部分持续改进的同时，保留初始的改进器。 相对于它的增益表明修订改进器有助于后续的改进，这与 R2 相关，但并不能确定是哪些已习得的知识导致了该修订。

paragraphs.en: Four conditions recur across these claims. Informative feedback distinguishes the remaining learning need. Usability means that the receiving component can represent, optimize, and execute the change. Robustness to distribution shift asks whether the change stays useful as the policy, model, task, or hardware changes, including changes caused by improvement itself. Continued practice asks whether another informative trial remains safe and affordable. These four conditions overlap and serve as diagnostic lenses rather than independently validated constructs. Section 4.2 examines their failures, and Figure 3 connects these conditions to the uses and claims above.
paragraphs.zh: 四个条件在这些主张中反复出现。 信息性反馈区分出剩余的学习需求。 可用性意味着接收组件能够表示、优化并执行该变更。 对分布偏移的鲁棒性关注的是，当策略、模型、任务或硬件发生变化时（包括由改进本身引起的变化），该变更是否仍然有用。 持续练习关注的是是否还存在另一次安全且可负担的信息性试验。 这四个条件相互重叠，它们是诊断性的视角，而非经过独立验证的构念。 第 4.2 节考察它们的失效情形，图 3 将这些条件与上文的用途和主张联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning and meta-learning already let robots improve from experience and learn how to learn. Self-training, continual learning, and automated machine learning (AutoML) let systems learn from their own outputs, keep learning across tasks, or search for better training recipes. It is therefore fair to ask what RSI adds. These are method paradigms or problem settings, which say how an update is computed or what it must cope with, whereas the claims of Section 2.2 say what an experiment shows to have changed. An RSI system may use any of them to revise any of its components, so the categories overlap rather than exclude one another: RSI is not a further paradigm after meta-learning but a level of improvement that a system built with any of them might reach (Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习与元学习已经能让机器人从经验中改进，并学会如何学习。 自训练、持续学习和自动化机器学习（AutoML）让系统能够从自身的输出中学习、跨任务持续学习，或搜索更好的训练方案。 因此，我们有理由追问递归自我改进（RSI）究竟能带来什么。 这些是方法范式或问题设定，说明一次更新是如何计算的，或它必须应对什么；而 2.2 节的主张说明的是一项实验被证明改变了什么。 递归自我改进（RSI）系统可以使用其中任何方法来修改其任何组件，因此这些类别是相互重叠而非彼此排斥的：RSI 不是元学习之后的又一种范式，而是用其中任何方法构建的系统都可能达到的一个改进层次（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Standard RL improves a policy under an objective and update mechanism chosen before training ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ) . Run repeatedly on hardware, as in HIL-SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) and RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) , it yields behavioral improvement, and its data or policy can supply a later-learning benefit. RL loops can also be nested inside an outer optimization over part of the learning procedure. Eureka searches over reward programs using the RL training results they produce ( Ma et al., 2024a ) , and meta-gradient RL adapts the return while the agent learns ( Xu et al., 2018 ) . LPG discovers an update rule ( Oh et al., 2020 ) , and DiscoRL learns such a rule across many agents and environments and applies it to unseen benchmarks ( Oh et al., 2025 ) . These loops target procedure improvement, while the outer search itself stays fixed. DERL ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) departs from this on text-based and mathematical reasoning tasks: it trains its reward proposer by policy gradient on the validation success of the inner policies, so the search learns from its own trials, while the rule that trains the proposer stays fixed. In the grasp example, RL that tunes the grasp under a fixed slip penalty improves behavior, whereas a search that revises the slip penalty changes the procedure; further rounds of the first kind do not become the second.
paragraphs.zh: 标准强化学习在训练前选定的目标和更新机制下改进策略（Sutton and Barto, 2018）。 像HIL-SERL（Luo et al., 2025）和RECAP（Physical Intelligence et al., 2026）那样在硬件上反复运行，它能带来行为上的改进，并且其数据或策略可以为后续学习提供收益。 强化学习循环还可以嵌套在学习过程某一部分的外层优化之中。 Eureka利用强化学习训练产生的结果来搜索奖励程序（Ma et al., 2024a），而元梯度强化学习在智能体学习的同时调整回报（Xu et al., 2018）。 LPG发现了一种更新规则（Oh et al., 2020），而DiscoRL在众多智能体和环境中学习这样的规则，并将其应用于未见过的基准任务（Oh et al., 2025）。 这些循环的目标是改进过程本身，而外层搜索本身保持固定。 DERL（Cheng et al., 2025）在基于文本和数学推理的任务上偏离了这一点：它以内部策略在验证集上的成功率为目标，用策略梯度训练其奖励提出者，因此搜索能够从自身的试验中学习，而训练奖励提出者的规则保持固定。 在抓取的例子中，在固定滑落惩罚下调优抓取的强化学习改进了行为，而修订滑落惩罚的搜索则改变了过程；前一种类型的进一步循环不会变成后一种类型。

paragraphs.en: Many systems called self-improving train on their own outputs. In self-training such as Noisy Student ( Xie et al., 2020 ) , a teacher trained on labeled data labels unlabeled data, and a student trained on both becomes the next teacher. Expert Iteration ( Anthony et al., 2017 ) and STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) apply the same pattern to search and reasoning, and RoboCat ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) applies it to robot data collection. Each round improves behavior and helps the next learner through the data it generates, while the recipe that generates, labels or filters, and trains on the data stays fixed. When the model also judges its own outputs, as in Self-Rewarding Language Models ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , the evaluator changes with training, but the judging prompt and the training recipe do not.
paragraphs.zh: 许多被称为自我改进的系统会在自身的输出上进行训练。 在诸如 Noisy Student（Xie et al., 2020）这类自训练方法中，一个用有标签数据训练的教师模型为无标签数据打标签，而在两者之上训练的学生模型则成为下一轮的教师模型。 Expert Iteration（Anthony et al., 2017）和 STaR（Zelikman et al., 2022）将相同的模式应用于搜索和推理，RoboCat（Bousmalis et al., 2024）则将其应用于机器人数据采集。 每一轮都会改进行为，并通过其生成的数据帮助下一个学习器，而生成、打标签或过滤并在数据上训练的这套流程保持固定。 当模型同时也评判自身的输出时，如 Self-Rewarding Language Models（Yuan et al., 2024），评估器会随训练而变化，但评判提示词和训练流程并不改变。

sents.en: Each round improves behavior and helps the next learner through the data it generates, while the recipe that generates, labels or filters, and trains on the data stays fixed.
sents.zh: 每一轮都会改进行为，并通过其生成的数据帮助下一个学习器，而生成、打标签或过滤并在数据上训练的这套流程保持固定。

sents.en: When the model also judges its own outputs, as in Self-Rewarding Language Models ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , the evaluator changes with training, but the judging prompt and the training recipe do not.
sents.zh: 当模型同时也评判自身的输出时，如 Self-Rewarding Language Models（Yuan et al., 2024），评估器会随训练而变化，但评判提示词和训练流程并不改变。

paragraphs.en: Continual, or lifelong, learning asks how a learner that meets a sequence of tasks can reuse what it learned on earlier ones ( Thrun and Mitchell, 1995 ) without forgetting them ( Parisi et al., 2019 ) . Backward and forward transfer ( Lopez-Paz and Ranzato, 2017 ) measure how learning one task changes performance on earlier and later ones. Backward transfer thus measures retention, whereas forward transfer as defined there is performance on a new task before training on it; LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) , a benchmark of sequential robot manipulation tasks, instead scores forward transfer by success on each new task averaged over its training, which is closer to a later-learning benefit. Replay, regularization, and other protections against forgetting are usually chosen by designers, so continual learning defines a setting that an RSI system must also handle (Section 4.2 ) rather than a way of improving the improver.
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习（continual learning），或称终身学习，研究的是一个依次面对一系列任务的学习者如何复用在早期任务上学到的知识（Thrun and Mitchell, 1995）而不遗忘它们（Parisi et al., 2019）。 后向迁移与前向迁移（Lopez-Paz and Ranzato, 2017）衡量学习一个任务会如何改变在更早和更晚任务上的表现。 因此，后向迁移衡量的是记忆保持，而那里定义的前向迁移是指在新任务上训练之前的表现；LIBERO（Liu et al., 2023a）是一个顺序机器人操作任务基准，它则以每个新任务在训练过程中的平均成功率来衡量前向迁移，这更接近于后续学习的收益。 回放、正则化以及其他防止遗忘的保护机制通常由设计者选定，因此持续学习定义的是 RSI 系统也必须应对的一种设定（第 4.2 节），而非改进改进器本身的方法。

paragraphs.en: Meta-learning trains over many tasks so that new tasks are learned faster ( Thrun and Pratt, 1998 ) , and what it learns decides which claim it can support. An initialization from which a few gradient steps solve a new task, as in MAML ( Finn et al., 2017 ) , is an acquired artifact and supports a later-learning benefit. Other methods learn part of the learning procedure: recurrent policies whose activations carry out adaptation ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ) , a dynamics prior that adapts online, as in GrBAL ( Nagabandi et al., 2019 ) , learned optimizers ( Andrychowicz et al., 2016 ) , and evolved or learned losses ( Houthooft et al., 2018 ; Yu et al., 2018 ; Bechtle et al., 2021 ) . When a learner guided by such a part learns better than a matched learner guided by the original, the comparison supports procedure improvement. LMPC ( Liang et al., 2024 ) is a boundary case: it fine-tunes the model that writes reward code on past teaching sessions so that later teaching needs fewer turns, but that code drives a model-predictive controller directly rather than a training run, so the gain lies in how behavior is constructed. The outer meta-training procedure that produces the part (a gradient loop, an evolutionary search, or a fine-tuning recipe) is specified by its designers and is not changed by the revisions it produces, so learning reaches the procedure but not the process that produces it.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习在多个任务上进行训练，从而使新任务能够被更快地学习（Thrun and Pratt, 1998），而它学到了什么决定了它能够支持哪种主张。 一种初始化，只需少量梯度步骤即可解决新任务，如 MAML（Finn et al., 2017），属于后天习得的产物，并支持后续学习的收益。 其他方法学习学习过程的一部分：其激活执行适应的循环策略（Duan et al., 2016；Wang et al., 2016）、可在线适应的动力学先验，如 GrBAL（Nagabandi et al., 2019）、学习到的优化器（Andrychowicz et al., 2016），以及演化或学习到的损失函数（Houthooft et al., 2018；Yu et al., 2018；Bechtle et al., 2021）。 当由这样一个部分引导的学习者比由原始部分引导的匹配学习者表现更好时，该比较便支持了过程改进的主张。 LMPC（Liang et al., 2024）是一个边界情形：它在过往教学会话上对编写奖励代码的模型进行微调，使后续教学需要更少的轮次，但该代码直接驱动模型预测控制器而非训练运行，因此其收益在于行为是如何构建的。 生成该部分的外层元训练过程（梯度循环、演化搜索或微调方案）由设计者规定，且不会因其所产生的修订而被改变，因此学习触及的是过程本身，而非产生该过程的过程。

paragraphs.en: AutoML searches over architectures, hyperparameters, and training pipelines ( Hutter et al., 2019 ) , and AutoML-Zero extends the search to learning algorithms ( Real et al., 2020 ) ; a found configuration that teaches matched learners better supports procedure improvement. Some searchers learn from their own record: the controller of neural architecture search ( Zoph and Le, 2017 ) is trained with reinforcement learning on the validation accuracy of the architectures it generates. Because it edits the learner rather than the rules for collecting, judging, or updating, it is a learned part of the procedure, like the skill editor of PRACTICE ( Bai et al., 2026 ) , and the rule that trains it stays fixed.
paragraphs.zh: AutoML 在架构、超参数和训练流水线上进行搜索（Hutter et al., 2019），而 AutoML-Zero 将搜索扩展到学习算法（Real et al., 2020）；一个找到的能教会匹配的学习者的配置，更好地支持程序改进。 一些搜索器会从自己的记录中学习：神经架构搜索的控制器（Zoph and Le, 2017）通过强化学习在其所生成架构的验证准确率上进行训练。 因为它编辑的是学习者，而不是用于收集、评判或更新的规则，所以它是程序中一个被学习的部分，就像 PRACTICE 的技能编辑器（Bai et al., 2026）一样，而训练它的规则保持固定。

paragraphs.en: RSI moves the process that produces revisions inside as well, as the two links of Section 2.2 require. The requirement is self-referential, as in the Gödel machine ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) , STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , the Darwin Gödel Machine ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , and Gödel Agent ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , which let the improving process act on its own code. Generalized Agent Iteration places iterative policy improvement and RSI in one formal framework, in which whether the improvement mechanism sits inside the agent separates the two, and whether the evaluation standard is grounded outside it decides whether goals can drift ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . The criterion is therefore which component changes with the revision history, not whether some outer recipe stays fixed. In the meta-learning and AutoML methods above, the component that produces revisions of the learning procedure does not change; an improver fine-tuned by a fixed recipe on its own repair histories does change and can satisfy R1, which the frozen-knowledge comparison of Section 4.4 tests. Conversely, an improver whose code changes in every round satisfies neither link if the changes come from a designer or from a search that learns nothing from earlier rounds.
paragraphs.zh: RSI 也将产生修订的过程本身置于被修改之列，正如第 2.2 节的两条链路所要求的那样。 这一要求是自指的，正如 Gödel 机器（Schmidhuber, 2003）、STOP（Zelikman et al., 2024）、Darwin Gödel 机器（Zhang et al., 2026c）和 Gödel 智能体（Yin et al., 2025）那样，它们让改进过程作用于自身的代码。 广义智能体迭代将迭代式策略改进与 RSI 置于同一个形式化框架之中，其中改进机制是否位于智能体内部区分了二者，而评估标准是否扎根于智能体之外则决定了目标是否会漂移（Tang et al., 2026）。 因此，判据在于哪个组件随修订历史而变化，而不是某个外部流程是否保持固定。 在上述元学习与 AutoML 方法中，产生学习程序修订的那个组件并不变化；而一个由固定流程在其自身修复历史上进行微调的改进器则会变化，并且可以满足 R1，第 4.4 节的冻结知识对比对此进行了检验。 反之，如果一个改进器的代码在每一轮都发生变化，但这些变化来自设计者，或来自一个没有从先前轮次学到任何东西的搜索，那么它两条链路都不满足。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists the terms we use to judge how closely a study is tied to physical experience. Hardware interaction connects learning directly to physical consequences, but a consequence still needs a diagnosis and a reliable judge. A binary failure label on a grasp may not distinguish pose error from slip, whereas force measurements or contact history may separate the two. Simulation, learned prediction, and formal checks represent selected consequences whose adequacy must be tested at the decision they support. Simulation is cheap and repeatable but omits some physical effects, whereas hardware captures real contact, sensing, and wear but allows few trials, so the two settings support different conclusions about cost, transfer, and the comparisons a study can afford.
paragraphs.zh: 表1列出了我们用来判断一项研究与物理经验关联紧密程度的术语。 硬件交互使学习直接与物理后果相连，但后果仍需要诊断和一个可靠的评判者。 抓取上的二元失败标签可能无法区分位姿误差与滑移，而力测量或接触历史则可能将二者区分开。 仿真、学习预测和形式化检查代表的是被选中的后果，其充分性必须在它们所支持的决策处加以检验。 仿真廉价且可重复但忽略某些物理效应，而硬件能捕捉真实的接触、感知与磨损但只允许少量试验，因此这两种环境在成本、迁移以及一项研究能够承担的比较方面支持不同的结论。

paragraphs.en: Because practice changes its own conditions (Section 1 ), returning to a usable starting state may require a reset policy or human assistance; early work on autonomous real-world RL already named resets, onboard perception, and rewards without instrumentation as the ingredients that continued learning needs ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) . Moving knowledge to another robot adds a further gap, because reuse across bodies needs compatible coordinates, timing, sensing, and reachable effects. A study’s connection to physical experience is therefore a matter of degree. It depends on the success evaluation (who or what judges whether an attempt succeeded), on interaction coverage and recoverability, and on whether successive trials remain comparable. The success evaluation may rely on the same evaluator that supplied the learning signal or on one independent of it, a difference that Section 4.1 shows to matter. Table 1 contrasts these conditions with those of digital self-improvement, Section 4.3 develops their consequences for continued learning, and Table 18 in Appendix A shows what evidence each robot domain contributes.
paragraphs.zh: 由于实践会改变其自身条件（第1节），返回到一个可用的初始状态可能需要重置策略或人工辅助；关于自主真实世界强化学习的早期工作已经将重置、机载感知以及无需专门仪表化装置的奖励列为持续学习所需的要素（Zhu et al., 2020）。 将知识迁移到另一台机器人会带来进一步的差距，因为跨身体的复用需要兼容的坐标、时序、传感以及可达效果。 因此，一项研究与物理体验的关联是一个程度问题。 它取决于成功评估（由谁或什么来判断一次尝试是否成功）、取决于交互的覆盖范围与可恢复性，以及取决于连续的试验是否保持可比性。 成功评估可能依赖于提供学习信号的同一个评估器，也可能依赖于独立于它的另一个评估器，第4.1节表明这一差异很重要。 表1将这些条件与数字自我改进的条件进行对比，第4.3节阐述它们对持续学习的影响，附录A中的表18展示每个机器人领域提供了何种证据。

sents.zh: 成功评估可能依赖于提供学习信号的同一个评估器，也可能依赖于独立于它的另一个评估器，第4.1节表明这一差异很重要。

sents.en: Table 1 contrasts these conditions with those of digital self-improvement, Section 4.3 develops their consequences for continued learning, and Table 18 in Appendix A shows what evidence each robot domain contributes.
sents.zh: 表1将这些条件与数字自我改进的条件进行对比，第4.3节阐述它们对持续学习的影响，附录A中的表18展示每个机器人领域提供了何种证据。

paragraphs.en: These conditions weigh on each paradigm of Section 2.3 in a different place. Meta-learning needs a distribution of training tasks, and on hardware every sampled task costs trials, resets, and supervision; domain-adaptive meta-learning meta-trains on previously collected human and robot demonstrations, and LMPC collected its training data in simulation. Eureka and DrEureka run their reward search in simulation, where many candidates can be trained in parallel, and DrEureka then deploys the resulting policy on hardware ( Ma et al., 2024b ) . For RSI, the bottleneck shifts to revision histories: an improver learns from them, and each entry needs at least one learning round judged by physical trials, so these histories accumulate more slowly than the task samples of meta-learning or the transitions of RL, and no executable test settles whether a revision helped. Simulation, stored traces, and learned models can screen candidate revisions before hardware trials, but their adequacy for that screening is itself a claim to test (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些条件在第 2.3 节的各个范式中作用于不同的位置。 元学习需要一个训练任务分布，而在硬件上每个采样任务都要付出试验、重置和监督的代价；域自适应元学习在先前收集的人类和机器人演示上进行元训练，而 LMPC 是在仿真中收集其训练数据的。 Eureka 和 DrEureka 在仿真中进行奖励搜索，其中许多候选方案可以并行训练，然后 DrEureka 将得到的策略部署到硬件上（Ma et al., 2024b）。 对于 RSI，瓶颈转移到修订历史：改进器从中学习，而每条记录都需要至少一轮由物理试验评判的学习，因此这些历史的积累速度比元学习的任务样本或强化学习的转移样本更慢，并且没有任何可执行的测试能判定某次修订是否有效。 仿真、存储的轨迹和学到的模型可以在硬件试验之前筛选候选修订，但它们用于这种筛选的充分性本身就是一个有待检验的主张（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Most comparisons in this review run in simulation, and the benchmarks differ in what they stress (Table 5 ). LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) supplies sequential manipulation suites, and LIBERO-PRO ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) perturbs manipulated objects, initial states, task instructions, and environments to test whether behavior depends on the original cues; LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) varies seven factors, including camera viewpoint, initial robot state, and sensor noise. RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) broadens household task coverage, and RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025c ) and RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026g ) cover bimanual manipulation. VLABench ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) and Meta-World ( Yu et al., 2019 ) supply further manipulation suites, and SIMPLER ( Li et al., 2024 ) mirrors real robot setups for policy evaluation. Navigation studies use Habitat ( Savva et al., 2019 ) and R2R-CE ( Krantz et al., 2020 ) , and household agents use EmbodiedBench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Except for LIBERO’s lifelong protocol, which scores transfer and forgetting along a task sequence, these suites test a system at one point in time, and a claim about improvement across rounds still needs a protocol on top that fixes what carries over between rounds and what stays held out (Section 4.2 ). A recent benchmark prototype moves in this direction: it provides no in-domain demonstrations, carries experience over between requests within a deployment, and names how quickly an agent becomes competent in a deployment as a quantity of interest ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . PhysRSI-eval ( Li et al., 2026j ) fixes what carries over between rounds, in simulation. Six model-and-configuration systems revise a persistent workspace of code, tools and notes with frozen weights, for up to 17 graded rounds on each of 18 RoboDojo tasks, and each system is scored on five axes: first-attempt score, how early gains appear, attained score, physical budget saved, and the share of first-round failures later solved. The axes need not agree: Claude Opus 5.5 attains a higher score than GPT-6.1 Sol but scores lower on gain timing and budget saved. In a six-task ablation with GPT-6 Astra, withholding all information from earlier rounds lowers success over rounds 4–6 from 15 of 36 attempts to 3 of 36.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述中的大多数比较都在仿真中进行，且各基准测试所考察的侧重点各不相同（表5）。 LIBERO（Liu et al., 2023a）提供顺序操作任务套件，LIBERO-PRO（Zhou et al., 2025b）通过扰动被操作对象、初始状态、任务指令和环境来检验行为是否依赖于原始线索；LIBERO-Plus（Fei et al., 2025）变化七个因素，包括相机视角、初始机器人状态和传感器噪声。 RoboCasa（Nasiriany et al., 2024）扩展了家庭任务的覆盖范围，RoboTwin 2.0（Chen et al., 2025c）和RoboDojo（Chen et al., 2026g）涵盖双手操作。 VLABench（Zhang et al., 2025d）和Meta-World（Yu et al., 2019）提供了更多操作任务套件，SIMPLER（Li et al., 2024）则镜像真实机器人设置用于策略评估。 导航研究使用Habitat（Savva et al., 2019）和R2R-CE（Krantz et al., 2020），家庭智能体使用EmbodiedBench（Yang et al., 2025）。 除LIBERO的终身学习协议（沿任务序列评估迁移与遗忘）之外，这些套件都只在某一时间点测试系统，而关于跨轮次改进的论断仍需在其上叠加一个协议，明确规定轮次之间哪些内容可以延续、哪些内容保持留出（第4.2节）。 一个近期的基准原型正朝这个方向迈进：它不提供域内示范，在一次部署内的各次请求之间延续经验，并将智能体在部署中达到胜任水平的速度称为一个感兴趣的量（Cai et al., 2026）。 PhysRSI-eval（Li et al., 2026j）在仿真中固定了轮次之间可以延续的内容。 六个模型加配置系统在权重冻结的条件下修订一个由代码、工具和笔记组成的持久工作区，在18个RoboDojo任务上各进行最多17个有评分的轮次，且每个系统在五个维度上评分：首次尝试得分、收益出现得有多早、最终达到的得分、节省的物理预算，以及首轮失败后来被解决的比例。 这些维度未必一致：Claude Opus 5.5的最终得分高于GPT-6.1 Sol，但在收益时机和节省预算方面得分更低。 在使用GPT-6 Astra的六任务消融实验中，屏蔽此前轮次的全部信息会使第4–6轮的成功率从36次尝试中的15次降至36次尝试中的3次。

paragraphs.en: A second group of benchmarks targets the components on which self-improvement relies. FailBench ( Navasardyan et al., 2026 ) tests success detectors on 2,197 real and simulated manipulation attempts, where the best of 13 VLM detectors reaches 0.77 balanced accuracy. CaliBench ( Sadeghi et al., 2026 ) tests whether the outcome frequencies of video world models are calibrated. MC-EvoBench ( Song et al., 2026a ) fixes the controls that a transfer claim needs, and RLE-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) holds out robustness perturbations that coding agents cannot query. RoboCoach-Bench ( Lei et al., 2026 ) collects 32 simulated tasks for agents that write and revise training code. Digital benchmarks of recursive self-improvement isolate related questions. PAST-Bench ( Xue et al., 2026a ) turns retained experience on and off across ordered task sequences, and RSIBench-Data ( Meng et al., 2026a ) has agents revise training-data strategies for a fixed model. RSIGym ( Meng et al., 2026b ) measures the fraction of the remaining performance gap that agents close across benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 第二组基准测试瞄准的是自我改进所依赖的组件。 FailBench（Navasardyan et al., 2026）在 2,197 次真实与模拟操作尝试上测试成功检测器，其中 13 个 VLM 检测器中最好的达到 0.77 的平衡准确率。 CaliBench（Sadeghi et al., 2026）测试视频世界模型的结果频率是否经过校准。 MC-EvoBench（Song et al., 2026a）固定了迁移性主张所需的对照条件，而 RLE-Bench（Ma et al., 2026）保留了编码智能体无法查询的鲁棒性扰动。 RoboCoach-Bench（Lei et al., 2026）为编写和修改训练代码的智能体收集了 32 个模拟任务。 递归自我改进的数字基准隔离出了相关的问题。 PAST-Bench（Xue et al., 2026a）在有序任务序列上开启和关闭保留的经验，而 RSIBench-Data（Meng et al., 2026a）让智能体针对固定模型修改训练数据策略。 RSIGym（Meng et al., 2026b）衡量智能体在各基准上弥合的剩余性能差距的比例。

paragraphs.en: Hardware evaluations instead use task suites built by each study, and their budgets vary widely, from a handful of trials per task, as in PhysEvo’s 25 trials over five real tasks ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , to hundreds of evaluation episodes, as in the more than 600 pairwise episodes of RoboArena ( Atreya et al., 2025 ) . Most controlled downstream comparisons concern manipulation; navigation, locomotion, flight, and robotic laboratories support particular mechanisms without testing each condition across robot bodies (Table 18 ). Simulation results support mechanism comparisons at scale, whereas hardware results show what survives real contact, sensing, and resets (Section 2.4 ). Because tasks, trial counts, and metrics differ, results are compared within each study rather than across studies; Appendix B records the settings behind selected numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件评估则使用每项研究自行构建的任务套件，其预算差异很大，从每个任务仅少量试验，如 PhysEvo 在五个真实任务上的 25 次试验（Tian et al., 2026），到数百个评估回合，如 RoboArena 超过 600 个成对回合（Atreya et al., 2025）。 大多数受控的下游比较集中在操作任务上；导航、运动控制、飞行以及机器人实验室仅支持特定机制的验证，而未在不同机器人本体上检验各项条件（表 18）。 仿真结果支持大规模的机制比较，而硬件结果则展示哪些机制能在真实接触、感知和复位中存活（第 2.4 节）。 由于任务、试验次数和指标各不相同，结果只在每项研究内部进行比较，而非跨研究比较；附录 B 记录了所选数字背后的实验设置。

paragraphs.en: Most studies report success rate, the fraction of trials that reach a task-defined goal as judged by a person, a scripted check, or a learned detector. Some give partial credit for progress through task stages, which needs a different statistical model than binary success. Others add efficiency during execution, such as cycle time in HIL-SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) or throughput in RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大多数研究报告成功率，即在人工、脚本化检查或学习到的检测器判定下，试验达到任务设定目标的比例。 一些研究对任务各阶段的进展给予部分得分，这需要与二元成功不同的统计模型。 另一些研究还加入执行过程中的效率指标，例如 HIL-SERL 中的循环时间（Luo et al., 2025）或 RECAP 中的吞吐量（Physical Intelligence et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Some give partial credit for progress through task stages, which needs a different statistical model than binary success.
sents.zh: 一些研究对任务各阶段的进展给予部分得分，这需要与二元成功不同的统计模型。

sents.en: Others add efficiency during execution, such as cycle time in HIL-SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) or throughput in RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 另一些研究还加入执行过程中的效率指标，例如 HIL-SERL 中的循环时间（Luo et al., 2025）或 RECAP 中的吞吐量（Physical Intelligence et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Learning efficiency is reported as the time, episodes, or supervision needed to reach a level of performance. ConRFT ( Chen et al., 2025d ) reaches 96.3% average success on eight real tasks after 45–90 minutes of online fine-tuning, and VLAC ( Zhai et al., 2025 ) raises real success from about 30% to 90% within 200 episodes. ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026b ) reports the time its robot fleet needs to reach a target, and LMPC ( Liang et al., 2024 ) counts chat turns per successful teaching session.
paragraphs.zh: 学习效率以达到某一性能水平所需的时间、回合数或监督量来报告。 ConRFT（Chen 等，2025d）经过 45–90 分钟的在线微调后，在八个真实任务上达到 96.3% 的平均成功率，而 VLAC（Zhai 等，2025）在 200 个回合内将真实成功率从约 30% 提升至 90%。 ENPIRE（Xiao 等，2026b）报告了其机器人编队达到目标所需的时间，LMPC（Liang 等，2024）则统计每次成功教学会话的对话轮数。

paragraphs.en: Retention asks whether earlier competence survives later learning or deployment, and a later-learning benefit on a new task is forward transfer . ACCRUE ( Kim et al., 2026 ) reports transfer as a cut in real-robot training time for later tasks, CIDER ( Li et al., 2026d ) reports forward transfer of an accumulated policy, and MC-EvoBench sets out the controls that such a claim needs.
paragraphs.zh: 保持性（retention）关注先前获得的能力能否在后续学习或部署中保持，而在新任务上的后续学习收益则是前向迁移（forward transfer）。 ACCRUE（Kim et al., 2026）将迁移报告为后续任务在真实机器人上训练时间的缩短，CIDER（Li et al., 2026d）报告了累积策略的前向迁移，而 MC-EvoBench 则给出了这类结论所需的对照设置。

CARD ( Sun et al., 2024 ) needs about 14K tokens per task against about 663K for Eureka, and ENPIRE’s fleet scaling shortens the time to target at lower per-robot utilization and faster-than-linear token growth; because studies count different parts of this work, their costs are not directly comparable (Section 4.1 ). \physicalaisectionaccent PAIBlue

paragraphs.en: This section reviews physical self-improvement by what a system actually changes, following the ladder of Section 2.2 . Section 3.1 covers changes to the learner L L , kept in policies, world models, or external knowledge; a policy trained with relabeled targets, a reward, or an optimization algorithm belongs there, because those rules stay fixed. Section 3.2 covers changes to the rules themselves, the learning procedure P P that collects, judges, and updates, and Section 3.3 covers changes to the improver I K I^{K} that revises that procedure (notation of Section 2.2 ). Section 3.4 adds no fourth component: it asks whether these layers close into a recursive relation, in which the improver, once improved, helps produce its own next improvement. A system that serves several roles is discussed mainly where its experiment tests it, with cross-references elsewhere; Table 11 collects the systems that describe themselves as recursive self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 本节按照第 2.2 节的阶梯，从系统实际改变了什么的角度来回顾物理自我改进。 第 3.1 节涵盖对学习者 L L 的更改，这些更改保存在策略、世界模型或外部知识中；用重标注目标、奖励或优化算法训练出的策略属于这一类，因为这些规则保持固定。 第 3.2 节涵盖对规则本身，即负责收集、评判和更新的学习过程 P P 的更改，第 3.3 节涵盖对修订该过程的改进器 I K I^{K} 的更改（记号见第 2.2 节）。 第 3.4 节并未添加第四个组件：它探讨的是这些层是否闭合为一种递归关系，即改进器在被改进后，能够帮助产生它自己的下一次改进。 承担多种角色的系统，主要在其验证该角色的实验处讨论，并在其他处以交叉引用说明；表 11 汇总了那些自称递归自我改进的系统。

paragraphs.en: This section reviews the base loop of physical self-improvement: experience improves what the robot does, and the data, models, and skills it leaves behind can help later learners. These are the first two claims of Section 2.2 , behavioral improvement and later-learning benefit. We follow the change to where it is kept, in a policy (Section 3.1.1 ), a world model (Section 3.1.2 ), or memories, skills, and code (Section 3.1.3 ). The learning procedure that produces these changes stays fixed here; where a study also changes how experience is collected, judged, or turned into updates, that part appears in Section 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节回顾物理自我改进的基础循环：经验改进机器人的行为，而它留下的数据、模型和技能可以帮助后来的学习者。 这些是 2.2 节的前两个论断：行为改进和后续学习收益。 我们追踪这些变化被保存在何处：策略中（3.1.1 节）、世界模型中（3.1.2 节），或者记忆、技能和代码中（3.1.3 节）。 产生这些变化的学习过程在此保持固定；当某项研究还改变了经验的收集、评判或转化为更新的方式时，该部分内容出现在 3.2 节中。

sents.zh: 本节回顾物理自我改进的基础循环：经验改进机器人的行为，而它留下的数据、模型和技能可以帮助后来的学习者。

sents.zh: 产生这些变化的学习过程在此保持固定；当某项研究还改变了经验的收集、评判或转化为更新的方式时，该部分内容出现在 3.2 节中。

paragraphs.en: The most direct way for experience to help is to change the policy itself, and on the path to RSI the policy is also the most common target of a revised learning procedure. A deployed policy determines both what the robot does and which situations later appear in its training data, so the question to ask of new data is what learning signal they contain. Four kinds of signal recur. Relabeling reinterprets behavior that has already happened: an attempt that pushed the cup aside instead of grasping it is still a correct example of how to push the cup aside. A reward scores attempted outcomes so that optimization can prefer better ones. A correction supplies an action that the policy did not take, typically from a person who intervenes. Replay reuses earlier experience to preserve or recover previously learned behavior (Figure 5 ). Each signal fits a different failure.
paragraphs.zh: 经验提供帮助的最直接方式是改变策略本身，而在通往 RSI 的道路上，策略也是修订后的学习程序最常针对的对象。 部署的策略既决定了机器人做什么，也决定了哪些情形会随后出现在其训练数据中，因此对数据要问的问题是：它们包含什么学习信号。 有四种信号反复出现。 重标注是对已经发生的行为进行重新解读：一次把杯子推到一旁而非抓住杯子的尝试，仍然是关于如何把杯子推到一旁的正确示例。 奖励对尝试的结果进行评分，使优化能够偏向更好的结果。 纠正提供策略没有采取的动作，通常来自进行干预的人。 回放复用早期经验，以保持或恢复先前已学会的行为（图 5）。 每种信号对应不同的失败情形。

sents.zh: 经验提供帮助的最直接方式是改变策略本身，而在通往 RSI 的道路上，策略也是修订后的学习程序最常针对的对象。

sents.zh: 回放复用早期经验，以保持或恢复先前已学会的行为（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: A recorded trajectory becomes useful for learning only once a goal, reward, or action label is attached to it. Hindsight experience replay ( Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ) relabels an attempt with the goal it actually achieved, and SOAR ( Zhou et al., 2025c ) carries this achieved-goal relabeling to goal-conditioned imitation. Earlier large-scale systems such as MT-Opt ( Kalashnikov et al., 2022 ) shared physical outcomes across twelve tasks; pretrained generalists change the starting point, because practice can refine behavior that is already useful, and value-based fine-tuning must then keep offline estimates calibrated, as Cal-QL ( Nakamoto et al., 2023 ) does in simulation. RoboCat ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) closes the resulting cycle: a generalist adapted to a target task from demonstrations collects trajectories that, mixed with retained multi-task data, retrain the generalist offline. RoboCat also relabels unsuccessful episodes with the goals they reached, whereas SOAR retrains only on attempts that its fixed VLM judges successful (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 一条被记录的轨迹只有在被附加了目标、奖励或动作标签之后，才会对学习有用。 后见之明经验回放（Andrychowicz et al., 2017）将一次尝试重新标注为它实际达成的目标，而 SOAR（Zhou et al., 2025c）把这种已达成目标的重新标注推广到目标条件模仿中。 更早期的大规模系统如 MT-Opt（Kalashnikov et al., 2022）在十二个任务之间共享物理结果；预训练的通才模型改变了起点，因为练习可以打磨已经可用的行为，而基于价值的微调随后必须保持离线估计的校准，正如 Cal-QL（Nakamoto et al., 2023）在仿真中所做的那样。 RoboCat（Bousmalis et al., 2024）闭合了由此形成的循环：一个通过演示适配到目标任务上的通才模型收集轨迹，这些轨迹与保留的多任务数据混合后，离线再训练该通才模型。 RoboCat 还会用失败回合实际达到的目标对其重新标注，而 SOAR 只在其固定的 VLM 判定成功的尝试上进行再训练（附录 B）。

sents.zh: 一条被记录的轨迹只有在被附加了目标、奖励或动作标签之后，才会对学习有用。

sents.en: RoboCat also relabels unsuccessful episodes with the goals they reached, whereas SOAR retrains only on attempts that its fixed VLM judges successful (Appendix B ).
sents.zh: RoboCat 还会用失败回合实际达到的目标对其重新标注，而 SOAR 只在其固定的 VLM 判定成功的尝试上进行再训练（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Adding more of the robot’s own data does not necessarily improve the targets it learns from. In their study of mostly single-task policies on five simulated and two real manipulation tasks, Mirchandani et al. (2025) find that added autonomous data yield modest gains that saturate and, over two to four collection rounds, can regress. On two of the tasks, human demonstrations started from conditions where rollouts had failed help more than randomly chosen ones, whereas autonomous collection from the same conditions offers no comparable advantage. More state diversity in demonstration data does not always help, whereas inconsistent actions often hurt ( Belkhale et al., 2023 ) . These results separate two needs, finding the difficult conditions and supplying useful actions there; repeating the policy’s familiar successes addresses neither.
paragraphs.zh: 增加更多机器人自身的数据并不一定能改善其学习目标。 在一项针对五个仿真任务和两个真实操作任务上多为单任务策略的研究中，Mirchandani 等人 （2025）发现，新增的自主数据带来的收益有限且会趋于饱和，在两到四轮数据收集过程中甚至可能出现退步。 在其中两个任务上，从策略执行失败的条件出发采集的人类示教比随机选取的示教更有帮助，而从相同条件出发的自主数据采集则没有类似的优势。 示教数据中更多的状态多样性并不总是有益的，而不一致的动作往往会造成损害（Belkhale et al., 2023）。 这些结果区分了两个需求：找到困难条件并在这些条件下提供有用的动作；而重复策略已经熟悉成功的动作两者都解决不了。

sents.en: Adding more of the robot’s own data does not necessarily improve the targets it learns from.
sents.zh: 增加更多机器人自身的数据并不一定能改善其学习目标。

sents.en: In their study of mostly single-task policies on five simulated and two real manipulation tasks, Mirchandani et al.
sents.zh: 在一项针对五个仿真任务和两个真实操作任务上多为单任务策略的研究中，Mirchandani 等人

sents.en: (2025) find that added autonomous data yield modest gains that saturate and, over two to four collection rounds, can regress.
sents.zh: （2025）发现，新增的自主数据带来的收益有限且会趋于饱和，在两到四轮数据收集过程中甚至可能出现退步。

sents.en: On two of the tasks, human demonstrations started from conditions where rollouts had failed help more than randomly chosen ones, whereas autonomous collection from the same conditions offers no comparable advantage.
sents.zh: 在其中两个任务上，从策略执行失败的条件出发采集的人类示教比随机选取的示教更有帮助，而从相同条件出发的自主数据采集则没有类似的优势。

sents.zh: 示教数据中更多的状态多样性并不总是有益的，而不一致的动作往往会造成损害（Belkhale et al., 2023）。

sents.en: These results separate two needs, finding the difficult conditions and supplying useful actions there; repeating the policy’s familiar successes addresses neither.
sents.zh: 这些结果区分了两个需求：找到困难条件并在这些条件下提供有用的动作；而重复策略已经熟悉成功的动作两者都解决不了。

paragraphs.en: Relabeling cannot supply an action the policy never produced, but an incomplete attempt can still reveal partial progress, and a person can replace part of it with a corrective motion. SI-EFM ( Ghasemipour et al., 2025 ) takes the first route: a frozen model of the steps remaining to a goal rewards each step that brings the robot closer, and policy gradients then learn from incomplete real-robot attempts without new demonstrations, though only among variations that the policy actually tries. FAR ( Hao et al., 2026 ) uses failed attempts in a different way: it turns them into preference data that steers retries away from the failed behavior and adds successful recoveries to later training, with gains in simulation and on real manipulation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 重标注无法提供策略从未产生的动作，但一次不完整的尝试仍能反映出部分进展，人可以用一个纠正性动作替换其中的一部分。 SI-EFM（Ghasemipour et al., 2025）采取了第一种路线：一个对达成目标所需剩余步骤建模的冻结模型会奖励每一个让机器人更接近目标的步骤，然后策略梯度便可以从真实机器人的不完整尝试中学习，而无需新的演示，尽管学习仅限于策略实际尝试过的变化范围之内。 FAR（Hao et al., 2026）以另一种方式利用失败的尝试：它把失败尝试转化为偏好数据，引导重试避开导致失败的行为，并将成功的恢复动作加入后续训练，在仿真和真实操作任务中都取得了提升。

paragraphs.en: Corrections take the second route. HIL-SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) builds on SERL ( Luo et al., 2024 ) , which combines off-policy learning, learned reward classifiers, and reset policies, and adds online human interventions so that corrective transitions inform the critic that guides the actor. RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) conditions the policy on the advantage of each action, fitted from deployment trajectories and expert corrections. Max-Q selective imitation ( Wang and Wang, 2026 ) regresses the actor toward whichever action a Monte Carlo chunk critic scores higher: its own action or a replay-buffer action, which is often an intervention. The target therefore shifts from corrections to the policy’s own behavior as it improves. On real USB insertion, it reaches 99% success after half an hour, whereas HIL-SERL needs about five hours to reach its 100% ceiling (each at its best checkpoint). SiLRI ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) treats human interventions as possibly suboptimal: it poses real-world RL as a constrained problem whose bound at each state is set by the uncertainty of the interventions, solved with a state-wise Lagrange multiplier, and reaches 90% success on real manipulation tasks in at most half the time HIL-SERL needs. The same recorded transition can become a value target, a weighted action target, or a conditioning variable, as RAPolicy ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , SI-EFM, and RECAP illustrate, and which of these the learner receives changes what it learns.
paragraphs.zh: 纠正走的是第二条路线。 HIL-SERL（Luo 等，2025）建立在 SERL（Luo 等，2024）之上，后者结合了离策略学习、习得的奖励分类器和重置策略，并增加了人类在线干预，使纠正性转移能够为引导智能体的评论家提供信息。 RECAP（Physical Intelligence 等，2026）让策略以每个动作的优势为条件，该优势由部署轨迹和专家纠正拟合得到。 Max-Q 选择性模仿（Wang 和 Wang，2026）将智能体向蒙特卡洛分块评论家评分更高的那个动作回归：即它自己的动作或回放缓冲区中的动作，而后者往往是一次干预。 因此，随着策略的改进，目标从纠正转向策略自身的行为。 在真实的 USB 插入任务上，它在半小时内达到 99% 的成功率，而 HIL-SERL 需要约五小时才能达到其 100% 的上限（各自取其最佳检查点）。 SiLRI（Zhao 等，2025）将人类干预视为可能次优的：它把真实世界强化学习表述为一个约束问题，其在每个状态的界限由该次干预的不确定性设定，并通过逐状态的拉格朗日乘子求解，在至多 HIL-SERL 所需时间的一半内于真实操作任务上达到 90% 的成功率。 同一条记录的转移可以成为价值目标、加权动作目标或条件变量，正如 RAPolicy（Yang 等，2026a）、SI-EFM 和 RECAP 所展示的那样，而学习者接收到的是其中哪一种，会改变它学到的东西。

paragraphs.en: Two studies keep a pretrained VLA frozen during online learning and train an added module alongside it. BEE ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) uses the consistency of human corrections to constrain RL updates to a residual policy around a frozen VLA. On three real tasks and one simulated task, it reaches 91.2% average success against 57.5% for an RL baseline at a matched online-data budget. RL Token ( Xu et al., 2026b ) instead adapts a VLA to expose a compact readout, keeps it frozen, and trains a small actor–critic on that readout online. On four real tasks, minutes to a few hours of practice speed up the hardest phase by up to 3 × \times and raise success as judged by a human operator, for example from 20% to 65% on screw installation. Outside manipulation, SELFI ( Hirose et al., 2024 ) fine-tunes a pretrained navigation policy with online model-free RL whose Q-values keep the model-based objective of its offline pretraining, improving collision avoidance and, in a user study, social compliance in real environments.
paragraphs.zh: 两项研究在在线学习过程中保持预训练的 VLA 冻结，并在其旁边训练一个新增模块。 BEE（Zhao et al., 2026b）利用人类修正的一致性来约束 RL 更新，使其作用于冻结 VLA 周围的残差策略。 在三个真实任务和一个仿真任务上，在相同的在线数据预算下，该方法达到 91.2% 的平均成功率，而 RL 基线为 57.5%。 RL Token（Xu et al., 2026b）则改为将 VLA 调整为暴露一个紧凑的读出接口，保持其冻结，并在该读出接口上在线训练一个小型 actor–critic。 在四个真实任务上，几分钟到几小时的练习可使最难的阶段加速至多 3 × \times 倍，并由人类操作员评判提升成功率，例如螺丝安装从 20% 提高到 65%。 在操作领域之外，SELFI（Hirose et al., 2024）用在线无模型 RL 微调预训练的导航策略，其 Q 值保持其离线预训练的基于模型的目标，从而改善碰撞规避，并在用户研究中提高了真实环境中的社交合规性。

paragraphs.en: Reward-guided post-training of VLAs has scaled mainly in simulation, while its most reliable results come from smaller hardware studies. VLA-RL ( Lu et al., 2025 ) on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) and π RL \pi_{\texttt{RL}} ( Chen et al., 2025b ) run in simulation, and FLaRe ( Hu et al., 2025a ) and SimpleVLA-RL ( Li et al., 2026c ) add real-robot results. In eight-task hardware studies, ConRFT ( Chen et al., 2025d ) reaches 96.3% average success after 45–90 minutes of online fine-tuning and RL-100 ( Lei et al., 2025a ) succeeds in 1,000 of 1,000 evaluation episodes. Task-specific hardware studies such as GR-RL ( Li et al., 2025b ) for shoe lacing and VLA-Precision ( Su et al., 2026 ) for chemistry tasks push precision further (Appendix B ). Autonomous real-world RL also reaches beyond tabletop arms: on Spot mobile manipulators, task-relevant autonomy, behavior priors, and generic rewards reach 80% average success on four tasks ( Mendonca et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: VLA 的奖励引导后训练主要在仿真中扩展，而其最可靠的结果来自较小规模的硬件研究。 VLA-RL（Lu et al., 2025）在 LIBERO（Liu et al., 2023a）上运行，π_RL（Chen et al., 2025b）也在仿真中运行，而 FLaRe（Hu et al., 2025a）和 SimpleVLA-RL（Li et al., 2026c）补充了真机结果。 在八任务的硬件研究中，ConRFT（Chen et al., 2025d）经过 45–90 分钟的在线微调后达到 96.3% 的平均成功率，RL-100（Lei et al., 2025a）在 1,000 次评估回合中成功 1,000 次。 诸如用于系鞋带的 GR-RL（Li et al., 2025b）和面向化学任务的 VLA-Precision（Su et al., 2026）等任务特定硬件研究进一步提升了精度（附录 B）。 自主真实世界强化学习也已超越桌面机械臂：在 Spot 移动操作平台上，任务相关自主性、行为先验和通用奖励在四个任务上达到 80% 的平均成功率（Mendonca et al., 2024）。

sents.zh: 自主真实世界强化学习也已超越桌面机械臂：在 Spot 移动操作平台上，任务相关自主性、行为先验和通用奖励在四个任务上达到 80% 的平均成功率（Mendonca et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Without per-task success checks, such training needs rewards that generalize, and the stricter test of a learned reward is the behavior it teaches rather than its prediction accuracy. Pretrained vision and language models supply them as zero-shot similarities in VLM-RM ( Rocamonde et al., 2024 ) and RoboCLIP ( Sontakke et al., 2023 ) , both evaluated in simulation, or as embedding distances learned from human video in VIP ( Ma et al., 2023b ) and LIV ( Ma et al., 2023a ) , both with real-robot evaluations. ReWiND ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , RoboReward ( Lee et al., 2026b ) , and VLAC ( Zhai et al., 2025 ) judge learned rewards by how they transfer and by the behavior they teach; VLAC raises real success on four tasks from about 30% to 90% within 200 episodes. Finer progress distinctions preserve more of what incomplete attempts teach: SARM2 ( Chen et al., 2026e ) conditions its reward model on the estimated task stage, adapts it once, and holds it fixed while the SPIRAL loop learns residual corrections to a frozen VLA. On crumpled garments, three SPIRAL rounds raise success from 4/12 to 8/12, while the matched loop with only a sparse success reward falls from 4/12 to 2/12.
paragraphs.zh: 若缺乏针对每个任务的成功检测，这类训练就需要能够泛化的奖励，而对学习到的奖励更严格的检验是它所教会的行为，而非其预测准确度。 预训练的视觉与语言模型在 VLM-RM（Rocamonde et al., 2024）和 RoboCLIP（Sontakke et al., 2023）中将这些相似度作为零样本相似度提供，两者均在仿真中评估；或在 VIP（Ma et al., 2023b）和 LIV（Ma et al., 2023a）中作为从人类视频学习到的嵌入距离提供，两者均有真机机器人评估。 ReWiND（Zhang et al., 2025c）、RoboReward（Lee et al., 2026b）和 VLAC（Zhai et al., 2025）通过学习到的奖励的迁移能力及其所教会的行为来评判它们；VLAC 在 200 个回合内将四个任务的真实成功率从约 30% 提升到 90%。 更细致的进度区分能更多保留不完整尝试所提供的信息：SARM2（Chen et al., 2026e）将其奖励模型以估计的任务阶段为条件，进行一次自适应调整后将其固定，同时 SPIRAL 循环学习针对冻结的 VLA 的残差修正。 在皱缩衣物上，三轮 SPIRAL 将成功率从 4/12 提升到 8/12，而仅使用稀疏成功奖励的对照循环则从 4/12 下降到 2/12。

paragraphs.en: Feedback that can rank behavior leaves a second choice: where the improvement should live. Choosing among proposals can improve execution without retraining, as V-GPS ( Nakamoto et al., 2024 ) does by reranking a frozen policy’s proposals with an offline value function; PA-RL ( Mark et al., 2024 ) also improves sampled actions under a critic and trains the policy on them with a supervised loss. Learned judges can steer a frozen policy in the same way. UF-OPS ( Attarian et al., 2026 ) trains success and time-to-success verifiers once on the policy’s labeled rollouts and selects among sampled action chunks at run time, with reported gains of 25 to 80 percentage points on five real Aloha tasks. World-Coherent Decoding ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) learns during deployment to rank a frozen world action model’s sampled futures by the mismatch between predicted and observed frames. In RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, under the authors’ limited-randomization protocol, it raises Hard-split success from 55.80% to 60.90%. Keeping scoring, improvement, and policy change separate avoids the need to adapt policy gradients to each action representation, whether iteratively denoised chunks in Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) , discretized tokens in OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , or flow matching in π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2025 ) . Selection gains can stay in the selector or be absorbed into the generator. VERITAS ( Zhang and Shah, 2026 ) behavior-clones trajectories steered toward agreement with a visual path proposed by a VLM. Q-Planning ( Giridhar et al., 2026 ) instead leaves the cloned policy unchanged and updates a Q-function from successful and failed rollouts. On its two real-robot tasks, terminal rewards come from human episode labels and success is measured on the collection episodes themselves.

sents.en: Feedback that can rank behavior leaves a second choice: where the improvement should live.
