paragraphs.en: Both routes stay bounded by their proposals: if the generator never produces a grasp that avoids the slip, no selector can recover one. A residual policy modifies the proposed motion while keeping the base policy as a prior. ResiP ( Ankile et al., 2025 ) trains one in simulation and then distills it into a vision policy co-trained with real demonstrations. DSRL ( Wagenmaker et al., 2025 ) instead steers the input noise of a frozen diffusion policy, searching only within its learned distribution. DPPO ( Ren et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes the diffusion policy itself and transfers a simulation-trained assembly policy to hardware. Expanding proposals helps only if the resulting experience teaches the policy where it needs help, which PLD ( Xiao et al., 2026a ) tests directly. A residual-RL specialist takes over after the generalist has run for a sampled number of steps, and the hybrid trajectories are distilled back. In real cube pickup, a PLD specialist and an RLPD ( Ball et al., 2023 ) specialist both reach full success within two hours from the same initialization, and each supplies 200 successful trajectories to the same distillation. The resulting generalists nevertheless differ, succeeding in 30 and 16 of 30 trials, respectively, because only the PLD data include recoveries from the corner states that the learner itself visits; collector success alone therefore does not reveal training value. Delay creates a further mismatch: Real-Time EXPO-FT ( Dong et al., 2026 ) edits the action chunks of a slower VLA with the latest observation and selects among candidates with a critic, because an action can become wrong between prediction and execution. Selection suffices when useful behavior already lies in the proposal set; otherwise the generator must be optimized, corrected, steered, or fine-tuned, and distillation retains corrections that should become habitual (Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两条路线都受限于各自的提议：如果生成器从不产生能避免滑脱的抓取，任何选择器都无法挽救。 残差策略在保留基础策略作为先验的同时修改提议的动作。 ResiP（Ankile 等，2025）在仿真中训练一个残差策略，然后将其蒸馏到一个与真实演示共同训练的视觉策略中。 DSRL（Wagenmaker 等，2025）则改为引导冻结扩散策略的输入噪声，仅在其学到的分布内进行搜索。 DPPO（Ren 等，2025）对扩散策略本身进行微调，并将仿真训练的装配策略迁移到硬件上。 只有当扩展提议所产生的经验能让策略知道自己在何处需要帮助时，扩展提议才有用，PLD（Xiao 等，2026a）对此进行了直接检验。 在通用智能体运行采样的步数之后，残差强化学习专家接管控制，随后将混合轨迹蒸馏回通用智能体。 在真实的方块抓取任务中，PLD 专家和 RLPD（Ball 等，2023）专家从相同的初始化出发都在两小时内达到完全成功，并且各自向同一次蒸馏提供了 200 条成功轨迹。 然而由此得到的通用智能体表现不同，分别在 30 次试验中成功 30 次和 16 次，因为只有 PLD 数据包含对学习者自身会到达的角落状态的恢复；因此仅凭采集者的成功率并不能揭示其训练价值。 延迟带来了进一步的不匹配：Real-Time EXPO-FT（Dong 等，2026）用最新观测编辑较慢 VLA 的动作块，并用评论家在候选动作中做选择，因为动作在预测与执行之间可能变得不再正确。 当有用行为已经存在于提议集合中时，选择就足够了；否则必须对生成器进行优化、纠正、引导或微调，而蒸馏能保留那些应当成为习惯的纠正（表 6）。

paragraphs.en: At scale, RoboNet ( Dasari et al., 2020 ) pools trajectories across laboratories and embodiments, and Learning While Deploying ( Wang et al., 2026j ) repeatedly updates one generalist from rollouts and interventions across sixteen robots. SOP ( Pan et al., 2026 ) streams on-policy experience and human interventions from a fleet to a cloud learner and reports real-world performance that scales near-linearly with the number of robots. OpenBot-Fleet ( Müller et al., 2024 ) sends learned navigation policies back to user-operated robots. More sources widen coverage only where observations, actions, and task definitions align. Practice also needs a way back to a useful starting state: Leave No Trace ( Eysenbach et al., 2018 ) learns forward and reset policies in simulation, ReLMM ( Sun et al., 2022 ) learns reset-free on a physical mobile manipulator, and MEDAL++ ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) and RoboFuME ( Yang et al., 2024a ) need only occasional manual resets on real robots.
paragraphs.zh: 在大规模层面，RoboNet（Dasari et al., 2020）汇集了跨实验室、跨机器人形态的轨迹，而 Learning While Deploying（Wang et al., 2026j）则利用十六台机器人的推演与人工干预数据，持续更新同一个通用智能体。 SOP（Pan et al., 2026）将机器人集群的在线策略经验与人类干预数据流式传输到云端学习器，并报告了随机器人数量近似线性扩展的真实世界性能。 OpenBot-Fleet（Müller et al., 2024）将学习到的导航策略回传至由用户操作的机器人。 只有当观测、动作和任务定义相互对齐时，更多的数据来源才能扩大覆盖范围。 实践还需要一条返回有用初始状态的途径：Leave No Trace（Eysenbach et al., 2018）在仿真中学习前向策略与重置策略，ReLMM（Sun et al., 2022）在物理移动机械臂上进行免重置学习，而 MEDAL++（Sharma et al., 2023）和 RoboFuME（Yang et al., 2024a）在真实机器人上只需偶尔进行手动重置。

paragraphs.en: Against forgetting, capacity can be allocated or routed, as AtomicVLA ( Zhang et al., 2026g ) grows expert modules for atomic skills and CLARE ( Römer et al., 2026b ) expands and selects adapters without task labels, or adaptation can be combined with rehearsal, as in LifelongVLA ( He et al., 2026b ) and iManip ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , or with targeted replay, as in Memory Anchors ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Separation costs capacity and routing; retaining experience, as in gradient episodic memory ( Lopez-Paz and Ranzato, 2017 ) , costs storage but can also speed later tasks ( Xie and Finn, 2022 ) . CIDER ( Li et al., 2026d ) freezes the accumulated policy as a teacher before each new task and alternates current-task RL with distillation on archived states; over six real tasks and three runs each, the retained policy needs no more training steps to reach the success criterion than the same RL agent from the common initialization, and fewer on some tasks. Replay and distillation assume a fixed action interface: FAN ( Hong et al., 2026a ) shows that updating action-normalization statistics between tasks shifts the coordinates shared by training and execution; statistics frozen after a small task-independent calibration give the highest average score across four real task streams.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对抗遗忘，可以为容量进行分配或路由，如 AtomicVLA（Zhang et al., 2026g）为原子技能扩展专家模块、CLARE（Römer et al., 2026b）在无任务标签的情况下扩展并选择适配器；也可以将适应与复演相结合，如 LifelongVLA（He et al., 2026b）和 iManip（Zheng et al., 2025），或与针对性重放相结合，如 Memory Anchors（Du et al., 2026）。 分离要付出容量与路由的代价；保留经验，如梯度情景记忆（Lopez-Paz and Ranzato, 2017），要付出存储的代价，但也可能加速后续任务（Xie and Finn, 2022）。 CIDER（Li et al., 2026d）在每项新任务之前将已积累的策略冻结为教师模型，并在当前任务的强化学习与对存档状态的蒸馏之间交替进行；在六项真实任务、每项运行三次的实验中，被保留的策略达到成功标准所需的训练步数不超过从同一初始状态出发的相同强化学习智能体，在某些任务上甚至更少。 重放与蒸馏都假设动作接口固定不变：FAN（Hong et al., 2026a）表明，在任务之间更新动作归一化统计量会改变训练与执行所共享的坐标系；在小规模、与任务无关的校准后冻结统计量，可在四条真实任务流上取得最高的平均得分。

sents.zh: 重放与蒸馏都假设动作接口固定不变：FAN（Hong et al., 2026a）表明，在任务之间更新动作归一化统计量会改变训练与执行所共享的坐标系；在小规模、与任务无关的校准后冻结统计量，可在四条真实任务流上取得最高的平均得分。

paragraphs.en: Physical trials are slow and costly, so a natural way to stretch them is to learn a model of the world and practice inside it. A world model predicts how a physical state may change after an action; for a grasp, it might predict whether the object will stay between the fingers when the gripper closes. The prediction can serve as a plan that must be translated into motion, as imagined experience from which a policy is trained, or as predicted features supplied to a policy. Each role tests a different form of usability : success in one role says little about the others. Generative video models offer all three interfaces: a generated video serves as a plan in UniPi ( Du et al., 2023 ) , as a controllable simulator in UniSim ( Yang et al., 2024b ) and, learned without action labels, in Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) , and as policy-training data in DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) . Cosmos ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) develops world foundation models for physical applications, WISA ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and PISA ( Li et al., 2025a ) target physical consistency, and SPIRAL ( Yang et al., 2026d ) (unrelated to the SPIRAL policy loop of Section 3.1.1 ) updates its generator with a critic that checks action adherence and physical realism. A world model can also enter the learning procedure by judging candidate policies or changes before they reach hardware (Sections 3.2.2 and 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 物理试验既缓慢又昂贵，因此一个自然的扩展方法是学习一个世界模型并在其中练习。 世界模型预测物理状态在执行某个动作后可能如何变化；对于一个抓取动作，它可以预测当夹爪闭合时物体是否会停留在手指之间。 该预测可以作为必须转化为运动的计划，可以作为训练策略的想象经验，也可以作为提供给策略的预测特征。 每种角色检验的是不同形式的可用性：在一种角色上取得成功并不能说明其他角色的表现。 生成式视频模型提供了全部三种接口：生成的视频在 UniPi（Du et al., 2023）中作为计划，在 UniSim（Yang et al., 2024b）中作为可控模拟器，在无动作标签下学习的 Genie（Bruce et al., 2024）中同样如此，以及在 DreamGen（Jang et al., 2025）中作为策略训练数据。 Cosmos（NVIDIA et al., 2025）面向物理应用开发世界基础模型，WISA（Wang et al., 2025a）和 PISA（Li et al., 2025a）针对物理一致性，而 SPIRAL（Yang et al., 2026d）（与 3.1.1 节的 SPIRAL 策略循环无关）则使用一个检查动作依从性和物理真实性的评论器来更新其生成器。 世界模型还可以通过在候选策略或改动部署到硬件之前对其进行评判，从而参与学习过程（3.2.2 节和 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Classical model-based methods supplied the main ingredients. Dyna ( Sutton, 1990 ) interleaves real and modeled experience, PILCO ( Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011 ) and PETS ( Chua et al., 2018 ) account for model uncertainty, MBPO ( Janner et al., 2019 ) keeps imagined rollouts short to limit compounding error, self-supervised visual planning ( Ebert et al., 2017 ) plans through learned video prediction, and latent world models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ) train policies in compact dynamics, as DayDreamer ( Wu et al., 2023 ) did on physical robots. A model’s value for control need not track its prediction accuracy ( Lambert et al., 2020 ; Farahmand et al., 2017 ; Grimm et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 经典的基于模型的方法提供了主要要素。 Dyna（Sutton, 1990）交替使用真实经验与模型生成的经验，PILCO（Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011）和 PETS（Chua et al., 2018）考虑模型的不确定性，MBPO（Janner et al., 2019）保持想象 rollout 较短以限制误差累积，自监督视觉规划（Ebert et al., 2017）通过学习到的视频预测进行规划，而潜变量世界模型（Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020）在紧凑的动力学模型中训练策略，正如 DayDreamer（Wu et al., 2023）在实体智能体机器人上所做的那样。 模型对控制的价值未必与其预测精度相关（Lambert et al., 2020; Farahmand et al., 2017; Grimm et al., 2020）。

paragraphs.en: Planning first exposes an interface problem: a predicted video of the gripper closing is not yet a robot command. SILVR ( Luo et al., 2026a ) translates video plans through a separately trained inverse-dynamics model, and on hardware its successful executions update only the task video planner. In its simulated Meta-World ( Yu et al., 2019 ) ablation over twelve unseen tasks, updating both planner and translator reaches 44.2% success, against 26.8% with the translator frozen: an improving planner can be held back by a translator that cannot express its new motions. The hardware counterpart of this comparison remains to be run.
paragraphs.zh: 规划首先暴露出一个接口问题：一段预测出的夹爪闭合视频还不等于机器人指令。 SILVR（Luo 等，2026a）通过一个单独训练的逆动力学模型来转译视频规划，而在真实硬件上，其成功执行只更新任务视频规划器。 在其模拟的 Meta-World（Yu 等，2019）中对十二个未见任务的消融实验中，同时更新规划器与转译器达到 44.2% 的成功率，而冻结转译器时仅为 26.8%：一个不断进步的规划器可能被一个无法表达其新动作的转译器所拖累。 这一对比的硬件版本实验尚待进行。

paragraphs.en: A model used for training shifts the burden to policy optimization, and its gain depends on how far the policy may optimize against the model. RISE ( Yang et al., 2026b ) freezes its learned dynamics and value models, limits imagined interactions to two steps, and updates an advantage-conditioned VLA; its hardware comparison reimplements RECAP ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) with the same π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) initialization, because the π 0.6 \pi_{0.6} model used by RECAP is not available. PlayWorld ( Yin et al., 2026b ) trains only the small DSRL ( Wagenmaker et al., 2025 ) policy that chooses its generator’s input noise against the fitted world model, rewarded by a progress estimator trained on demonstrations; with twenty hardware trials per checkpoint, its best reported task improves by 65 percentage points over the base policy, yet later optimization inside the model can reduce real success. WMPO ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) , Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , ProphRL ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , and World-Gymnast ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) likewise improve VLAs with imagined rollouts. Fine-tuning on imagined successes raises Ctrl-World’s policy success by 44.7 percentage points, and ProphRL, which runs flow-policy GRPO inside an action-conditioned video model pretrained on more than 31M trajectories, raises overall success on four real UR30e tasks by 24.6 to 30.0 percentage points over the starting policies of three VLA backbones (Appendix B ). Whether new physical experience should also repair the practice model is a further choice, one that changes what later updates learn from; Section 3.2.3 follows VLAW’s loop of this kind. Figure 6 separates these decisions, and Table 7 records what the main model-assisted studies update, hold fixed, and compare.
paragraphs.zh: 用于训练的模型将负担转移至策略优化，其收益取决于策略能针对模型优化到何种程度。 RISE（Yang et al., 2026b）冻结其学习到的动力学模型与价值模型，将想象交互限制为两步，并更新一个以优势为条件的 VLA；其硬件对比实验以相同的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}（Physical Intelligence et al., 2025）初始化重新实现了 RECAP（Physical Intelligence et al., 2026），因为 RECAP 所使用的 π 0.6 \pi_{0.6} 模型不可用。 PlayWorld（Yin et al., 2026b）仅训练选择其生成器输入噪声的小型 DSRL（Wagenmaker et al., 2025）策略，使其对抗拟合的世界模型，并由一个在演示数据上训练的进度估计器提供奖励；在每个检查点进行二十次硬件试验的条件下，其报告的最佳任务相对基础策略提升了 65 个百分点，但在模型内部的后续优化可能降低真实成功率。 WMPO（Zhu et al., 2025b）、Ctrl-World（Guo et al., 2025）、ProphRL（Zhang et al., 2025b）和 World-Gymnast（Sharma et al., 2026）同样通过想象 rollout 改进 VLA。 在想象的成功轨迹上微调使 Ctrl-World 的策略成功率提升 44.7 个百分点，而 ProphRL 在一个于超过 3100 万条轨迹上预训练的动作条件视频模型内运行流策略 GRPO，使三个 VLA 骨干的初始策略在四个真实 UR30e 任务上的整体成功率提升 24.6 至 30.0 个百分点（附录 B）。 新的物理经验是否也应修复练习模型是另一个选择，这一选择会改变后续更新所能学习的内容；第 3.2.3 节遵循 VLAW 的此类循环。 图 6 区分了这些决策，表 7 记录了各主要模型辅助研究所更新、保持固定以及对比的内容。

paragraphs.en: Whether new rollouts can repair a model depends on what they cover for the component that consumes them. A contact model needs partial contacts, slips, and recoveries, not only successes: PlayWorld collects such evidence through autonomous play, SILVR through task-directed rollouts from its current planner, and Motus2 ( Bi et al., 2026 ) routes curated successes to action generation and failed or suboptimal interactions to dynamics or value prediction, freezing its video backbone and evaluator during later policy optimization. When natural failures miss the needed corrections, XPACE ( Wei et al., 2026a ) constructs them: its world model renders deviations from expert demonstrations followed by recoveries, and fine-tuning on a mixture containing 8% of these examples yields hardware gains across three tasks evaluated with twenty trials per method. A failed contact may be valuable for predicting consequences, while only a validated recovery should supervise the action policy.
paragraphs.zh: 新的部署数据能否修复一个模型，取决于它们对消费这些数据的组件覆盖了什么。 接触模型需要部分接触、打滑和恢复过程，而不仅仅是成功案例：PlayWorld 通过自主游戏收集这类证据，SILVR 通过其当前规划器生成的任务导向部署收集证据，而 Motus2（Bi et al., 2026）将精选的成功交互分配给动作生成，将失败或次优的交互分配给动力学或价值预测，并在后续的策略优化过程中冻结其视频骨干网络和评估器。 当自然失败缺少所需的纠正样本时，XPACE（Wei et al., 2026a）会主动构造它们：其世界模型渲染出与专家演示的偏差以及随后的恢复过程，在包含 8% 此类样本的混合数据上进行微调，在三个任务（每个方法进行二十次试验评估）上带来了硬件层面的提升。 一次失败的接触可能对预测后果有价值，而只有经过验证的恢复过程才应监督动作策略。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics can also change. Roughly 100 seconds of real quadrotor flight support online identification of a residual dynamics model and in-flight policy updates ( Ren et al., 2026 ) ; Variational Neural Dynamics ( Xing et al., 2026 ) instead infers which recurring operating condition applies from recent interaction; and Self-adapting Robotic Agents ( Domberg and Schildbach, 2026 ) detect out-of-distribution events from prediction residuals and trigger fine-tuning. D-World ( Wen and Wang, 2026 ) , which its authors describe as recursive self-improvement, keeps an explicit digital twin that a frozen language model revises after each executed action chunk and accepts a revision only when replayed residuals do not grow; on a real dual-arm robot, one revision reduced a rendered-depth residual from 22.4 to 1.5 mm. After damage, Bongard et al. (2006) revise a model of the robot’s body and search it for a new gait, Intelligent Trial and Error ( Cully et al., 2015 ) searches a precomputed repertoire of behaviors, and GrBAL ( Nagabandi et al., 2019 ) adapts a meta-learned dynamics prior (Section 2.3 ). Which route saves physical trials depends on what useful structure survives the change.

paragraphs.en: For control, a representation must distinguish futures that imply different actions, which pixel-accurate prediction neither guarantees nor requires. Joint-embedding predictive architectures predict in learned feature spaces and plan toward goals there, as V-JEPA 2-AC ( Assran et al., 2025 ) and DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) do, and D-JEPA ( Liu et al., 2026e ) aligns competing predicted futures with the candidate that executes best. Physical properties must remain readable: in PokeWorld ( Tan et al., 2026a ) , predicting touch makes stiffness decodable whereas merely supplying touch as an input does not, and PSG-JEPA ( Yan et al., 2026 ) adds proprioceptive objectives where forward prediction alone omits such structure. DreamerV3 ( Hafner et al., 2025 ) , which reconstructs observations, and TD-MPC2 ( Hansen et al., 2024 ) , which does not, bracket the design space. Retrieved history in Mem-World ( Zheng et al., 2026b ) , force–torque prediction in MuSe ( Clark et al., 2026 ) , and predicted fingertip wrenches in TORL-VLA ( Zheng et al., 2026a ) supply distinctions that camera data alone can miss.
paragraphs.zh: 就控制而言，一种表征必须区分那些隐含不同动作的未来，而像素级精确的预测既不能保证这一点，也不要求这一点。 联合嵌入预测架构在学习到的特征空间中进行预测并在其中朝目标规划，如 V-JEPA 2-AC（Assran et al., 2025）和 DINO-WM（Zhou et al., 2025a）所做的，而 D-JEPA（Liu et al., 2026e）则将相互竞争的预测未来与执行效果最佳的候选未来对齐。 物理属性必须保持可读性：在 PokeWorld（Tan et al., 2026a）中，预测触觉能使刚度可解码，而仅仅将触觉作为输入提供则不能；PSG-JEPA（Yan et al., 2026）则添加了本体感觉目标，以弥补仅靠前向预测所缺失的这类结构。 重建观测的 DreamerV3（Hafner et al., 2025）与不重建观测的 TD-MPC2（Hansen et al., 2024）框定了这一设计空间的两端。 Mem-World（Zheng et al., 2026b）中检索到的历史、MuSe（Clark et al., 2026）中的力矩预测，以及 TORL-VLA（Zheng et al., 2026a）中预测的指尖扳手，都提供了仅靠相机数据可能遗漏的区分信息。

paragraphs.en: The information must also reach the policy through a usable interface, and the model must respond correctly to commands. GigaBrain-0.5M* ( GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ) conditions action learning on predicted future-state tokens, whereas VLAW turns predicted futures into reward-filtered training data; a conditioned policy may ignore or over-rely on auxiliary tokens, whereas synthetic data may amplify prediction errors. WorldEcho ( Chen et al., 2026f ) shows that models trained only on expert trajectories, given commands outside that distribution, either ignore the commanded motion or produce visually invalid rollouts, and CausalWorld ( Ahmed et al., 2021 ) lets physical and visual variables be changed independently. Across embodiments, particle-based action representations ( He et al., 2026c ) offer a shared geometric interface, while XEWorld ( Chen et al., 2026i ) finds that current models bind joint commands more readily to familiar appearance than to transferable kinematics. A visually plausible model may still lack decision-relevant state, a usable interface, or correct responses to intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 信息还必须通过可用的接口传递给策略，且模型必须对命令作出正确响应。 GigaBrain-0.5M*（GigaBrain Team et al., 2026）将动作学习条件化于预测的未来状态令牌，而 VLAW 则将预测的未来转化为经奖励过滤的训练数据；被条件化的策略可能忽略或过度依赖辅助令牌，而合成数据可能放大预测误差。 WorldEcho（Chen et al., 2026f）表明，仅在专家轨迹上训练的模型在接收到分布外命令时，要么忽略所命令的运动，要么产生视觉上无效的推演，而 CausalWorld（Ahmed et al., 2021）允许物理变量与视觉变量被独立更改。 跨具身形态来看，基于粒子的动作表示（He et al., 2026c）提供了一个共享的几何接口，而 XEWorld（Chen et al., 2026i）发现当前模型更容易将关节命令绑定到熟悉的外观而非可迁移的运动学。 一个视觉上可信的模型仍可能缺乏与决策相关的状态、可用的接口或对干预的正确响应。

paragraphs.en: Failure can enter at four links between a model and its policy: transition prediction, outcome scoring, policy optimization, or translation into executable motion. End-to-end hardware results, as in RISE and PlayWorld, measure joint usefulness but do not say which link broke, so evaluation needs both final performance and comparisons that change one link at a time. DexTouch-WM ( Qin et al., 2026 ) shows why. Its world model trained on mixed human and robot data improves held-out prediction and, on average, agreement between policy rankings in imagination and on hardware, yet replacing 100 of 200 real training trajectories with synthetic counterparts generated by this model lowers the mean physical partial-credit score for each of three policy families (FTP-1, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and X-VLA) across four tasks. A model can become a better surrogate evaluator and still produce a worse training mixture.
paragraphs.zh: 失败可能从模型与其策略之间的四个环节进入：转移预测、结果评分、策略优化，或转化为可执行动作。 像 RISE 和 PlayWorld 这样的端到端硬件结果衡量的是整体有用性，但无法说明哪个环节出了问题，因此评估既需要最终性能，也需要每次只改变一个环节的对比实验。 DexTouch-WM（Qin et al., 2026）说明了原因。 其在人类与机器人混合数据上训练的世界模型提升了留出集上的预测表现，并且在平均意义上提升了想象中的策略排名与硬件上策略排名的一致性，然而用该模型生成的合成轨迹替换 200 条真实训练轨迹中的 100 条，会使三个策略家族（FTP-1、π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 X-VLA）在四个任务上的平均物理部分得分均下降。 一个模型可以成为更好的代理评估器，同时却产生更差的训练混合数据。

paragraphs.en: Other methods change how predictions are consumed. WISE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) calls a frozen world model only at states where interaction matters and bounds the imagined horizon, and HaWMPO ( Chen et al., 2026j ) trains a hallucination estimator on discrepancies between generated and observed outcomes and uses it to soften rewards from unreliable action chunks. How prediction is queried also matters: in CaliBench ( Sadeghi et al., 2026 ) , individually plausible videos can have poorly calibrated outcome frequencies, and in a simulated differential-drive study ( Raghavan and Singh, 2026 ) , a 20-step rollout without intermediate measurements picks a different state estimator than closed-loop tracking in 18 of 24 sensing conditions, whereas replay error under the recorded schedule disagrees in five. Evaluation should reproduce the actions, horizon, and observation schedule of the policy’s use.
paragraphs.zh: 其他方法改变了预测被使用的方式。 WISE（Zhang et al., 2026a）仅在交互重要的状态上调用冻结的世界模型并限制想象视野的长度；HaWMPO（Chen et al., 2026j）基于生成结果与观测结果之间的差异训练一个幻觉估计器，并用它来削弱来自不可靠动作块的奖励。 预测的查询方式同样重要：在 CaliBench（Sadeghi et al., 2026）中，单独看似乎合理的视频其结果频率可能校准不佳；在一项模拟差速驱动研究中（Raghavan and Singh, 2026），在 24 种感知条件中有 18 种，无中间测量的 20 步 rollout 所选择的状态估计器与闭环跟踪所选的估计器不同，而按记录的观测计划重放时的误差仅在五种条件下不一致。 评估应复现策略使用时的动作、视野长度与观测计划。

sents.zh: 其他方法改变了预测被使用的方式。

paragraphs.en: Not every useful change needs to enter a policy’s weights or a world model. A robot that misses grasps might remember that a particular object tends to slip, save a regrasp routine that worked, or add a monitor that interrupts the policy when slip is detected. We use memory for stored information that must be interpreted when it is used, skill for a callable behavior with an execution interface, and runtime or software for the logic that retrieves, composes, monitors, or repairs those behaviors (Figure 7 ). The same artifact can cross these boundaries (a recovery written down as text becomes a skill once a controller can execute it), but the distinction identifies who uses the change next; for all three, the question is whether a change kept outside model weights is usable . On the path to RSI, external knowledge is also where a system can keep the repair knowledge that recursion requires (Section 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 并非每一项有用的改变都需要进入策略的权重或世界模型。 一个抓取经常失败的机器人可以记住某个特定物体容易打滑，保存一个曾经有效的重新抓取例程，或者添加一个在检测到打滑时中断策略的监控器。 我们用记忆指代那些在使用时必须被解读的存储信息，用技能指代具有执行接口的可调用行为，用运行时或软件指代检索、组合、监控或修复这些行为的逻辑（图 7）。 同一产物可以跨越这些边界（一段以文本写下的恢复方法一旦控制器能够执行它就变成了技能），但这种区分标明了下一步谁来使用这一改变；对于这三者而言，问题是保存在模型权重之外的改变是否可用。 在通往 RSI 的道路上，外部知识也是系统存放递归所需的修复知识的地方（第 2.2 节）。

sents.en: Not every useful change needs to enter a policy’s weights or a world model.
sents.zh: 并非每一项有用的改变都需要进入策略的权重或世界模型。

sents.zh: 我们用记忆指代那些在使用时必须被解读的存储信息，用技能指代具有执行接口的可调用行为，用运行时或软件指代检索、组合、监控或修复这些行为的逻辑（图 7）。

sents.en: The same artifact can cross these boundaries (a recovery written down as text becomes a skill once a controller can execute it), but the distinction identifies who uses the change next; for all three, the question is whether a change kept outside model weights is usable .
sents.zh: 同一产物可以跨越这些边界（一段以文本写下的恢复方法一旦控制器能够执行它就变成了技能），但这种区分标明了下一步谁来使用这一改变；对于这三者而言，问题是保存在模型权重之外的改变是否可用。

sents.en: On the path to RSI, external knowledge is also where a system can keep the repair knowledge that recursion requires (Section 2.2 ).
sents.zh: 在通往 RSI 的道路上，外部知识也是系统存放递归所需的修复知识的地方（第 2.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Earlier systems kept different kinds of artifacts. Options ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) encode temporally extended behaviors that a higher-level controller can call, and Horde ( Sutton et al., 2011 ) learns many sensorimotor predictions in parallel. RoboEarth ( Waibel et al., 2011 ) shares models and action recipes among robots. Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) writes programs against perception and control APIs, and Inner Monologue ( Huang et al., 2023 ) feeds execution feedback back into planning. In digital environments, including games ( Luo et al., 2026b ) , Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024a ) accumulates executable skills and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) stores written reflections on earlier failures, showing how a frozen model can still take part in an agent that improves; the Weights or Skills? survey ( Jena et al., 2026 ) reviews this broader choice. Physical reuse additionally needs valid sensing, control, and conditions of applicability.
paragraphs.zh: 更早的系统保存了不同类型的人工产物。 Options（Sutton et al., 1999）对可以被更高层控制器调用的时间上延展的行为进行编码，而 Horde（Sutton et al., 2011）并行学习大量感觉运动预测。 RoboEarth（Waibel et al., 2011）在机器人之间共享模型和动作配方。 Code as Policies（Liang et al., 2023）基于感知与控制 API 编写程序，Inner Monologue（Huang et al., 2023）将执行反馈重新输入规划。 在包括游戏在内的数字环境中（Luo et al., 2026b），Voyager（Wang et al., 2024a）积累可执行的技能，Reflexion（Shinn et al., 2023）存储对早期失败的书面反思，展示了冻结模型如何仍能参与一个会自我改进的智能体；Weights or Skills? 综述（Jena et al., 2026）回顾了这一更广泛的选择。 物理层面的复用还需要有效的感知、控制以及适用条件。

paragraphs.en: Memory systems differ in what they store, how strongly they abstract it, through which interface it is read, and how long it persists, and a memory helps only if these choices preserve a relation that a later decision can exploit. Some systems keep the scene and past interaction themselves: RoboMemory ( Lei et al., 2025b ) and AllDayNav ( Yin et al., 2026a ) preserve continuity of the environment and of past interaction, and PhyAgentOS ( Liu et al., 2026h ) keeps sessions, evidence, recovered lessons, and capability descriptions as versioned records inside a runtime that also checks compatibility, supervises execution, and invokes recovery, so its gains belong to the integrated package.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆系统在存储什么、以多强的抽象程度存储、通过哪种接口读取、以及能持续多久等方面各不相同，而记忆只有在这些选择保留了后续决策能够利用的某种关系时才会有所帮助。 有些系统自行保存场景与过去的交互：RoboMemory（Lei et al., 2025b）与 AllDayNav（Yin et al., 2026a）保持环境和过去交互的连续性，而 PhyAgentOS（Liu et al., 2026h）则会话、证据、恢复的经验教训以及能力描述作为版本化记录保存在一个运行时中，该运行时还会检查兼容性、监督执行并调用恢复，因此它的收益属于整个集成包。

paragraphs.en: Others distill experience into reusable guidance, which must then be checked against later conditions. Robo-Cortex ( Chan et al., 2026 ) distills progress and failure histories into principles and induced navigation heuristics, evaluated mainly in unseen settings of the Habitat simulator ( Savva et al., 2019 ) with a preliminary physical study of ten navigation goals. RoboHarn-Evo ( Bao et al., 2026 ) also revises what it stores: physical feedback updates task- and action-level entries together with their stated applicability, and knowledge acquired in simulation reaches 41.7% mean zero-shot success on real tasks, rising to 62.5% after updates from real interaction. PhysMem ( Li et al., 2026b ) makes the check explicit: a frozen VLM planner commits a hypothesis about physical properties to memory only after targeted interaction verifies it. On simulated medium-difficulty brick insertion this reaches 76% success against 53% without memory and 23% when raw experience is retrieved directly (100 episodes per condition, three seeds), so retrieving raw experience can do worse than having no memory; its real xArm6 experiments report plan quality over 30-minute deployment sessions. PragmaBot ( Qu et al., 2025 ) summarizes the successful episodes of a real legged manipulator into a retrievable memory, raising single-trial success over twelve scenarios, eight of them new but structurally similar, from 22% for a planner without memory to 80%. Storage is only half of reuse: a retriever must select the record, and a recipient must assign it the right role.
paragraphs.zh: 另一些方法则将经验蒸馏为可复用的指导，而这些指导随后必须根据后续条件加以检验。 Robo-Cortex（Chan 等，2026）将成功与失败的历史记录蒸馏为原则和归纳出的导航启发式规则，主要在 Habitat 模拟器（Savva 等，2019）的未见过的环境中进行评估，并对十个导航目标进行了初步的物理实验。 RoboHarn-Evo（Bao 等，2026）同样会修订其存储内容：物理反馈会更新任务级和动作级的条目及其声明的适用范围，在模拟中获得的知识在真实任务上达到 41.7% 的平均零样本成功率，经过真实交互的更新后提升至 62.5%。 PhysMem（Li 等，2026b）将这种检验显式化：一个冻结的 VLM 规划器只有在通过针对性交互验证之后，才会将关于物理属性的假设提交到记忆中。 在中等难度的模拟积木插入任务上，该方法达到 76% 的成功率，而不用记忆时为 53%，直接检索原始经验时仅为 23%（每个条件 100 个回合、三个随机种子），因此检索原始经验可能比没有记忆更差；其真实 xArm6 实验报告了 30 分钟部署会话中的规划质量。 PragmaBot（Qu 等，2025）将一台真实腿式操作机器人的成功回合总结为可检索的记忆，在十二个场景（其中八个是新的但结构相似）中，将单次尝试成功率从无记忆规划器的 22% 提升到 80%。 存储只是复用的一半：检索器必须选出记录，而接收方必须为记录分配合适的角色。

paragraphs.en: How long a memory lives also limits what it can show. With the foundation policy of Zeva ( Chen et al., 2026a ) fixed, removing its interaction memory lowers success by 10–20 percentage points on five real ChemLab-Evo tasks, but the store is cleared before each episode, so the benefit is adaptation across retries within an episode.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆存续的时间长短也限制了它所能呈现的内容。 在 Zeva（Chen et al., 2026a）的基础策略固定不变的情况下，移除其交互记忆会使五个真实 ChemLab-Evo 任务的成功率下降 10–20 个百分点，但由于存储在每个回合开始前都会被清空，因此其收益体现在回合内多次重试之间的适应能力上。

paragraphs.en: A one-off recovery becomes a reusable skill only when it is detached from the incident that produced it, with an implementation, a callable interface, and stated conditions and effects that let a planner place it in a new sequence. Implementations come from demonstrations in LOTUS ( Wan et al., 2024 ) and Uni-Skill ( Xie et al., 2026b ) , and from a person when the library cannot carry out the plan in HaLP ( Parakh et al., 2024 ) . The robot’s own execution supplies them in MobiAgent ( Liu et al., 2026a ) and ReSYNC ( Li et al., 2026a ) . MobiAgent clusters verified deployment rollouts into atomic skills and raises real success on an Astribot S1 from 32.5% to 57.5%, and ReSYNC learns recovery policies together with the symbolic predicates and operators that let a planner compose them.
paragraphs.zh: 一次性的恢复只有当它从产生它的事件中剥离出来，具备了具体实现、可调用接口以及声明的适用条件与效果，使规划器能将其置于新的序列中时，才会成为可复用的技能。 具体实现来自 LOTUS（Wan et al., 2024）和 Uni-Skill（Xie et al., 2026b）中的演示，当技能库无法执行 HaLP（Parakh et al., 2024）中的规划时，则来自人。 在 MobiAgent（Liu et al., 2026a）和 ReSYNC（Li et al., 2026a）中，由机器人自身的执行提供具体实现。 MobiAgent 将验证过的部署轨迹聚类为原子技能，使 Astribot S1 上的真实成功率从 32.5% 提升到 57.5%；ReSYNC 则将恢复策略与使规划器能够组合它们的符号谓词和算子一同学习。

paragraphs.en: Code-writing agents often call two artifacts “skills”: a callable routine and guidance for constructing one. LRLL ( Tziafas and Kasaei, 2024 ) distills simulated instruction–program pairs into callable Python APIs under a curriculum. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026a ) retrieves guidance distilled from earlier program repairs when debugging a new controller; on three physical tasks whose embodiment and API differ from the simulation source, retrieval reduces the reasoning tokens spent on the real robot, and held-out success is unchanged on one task and improves on two. Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real ( Wang et al., 2026i ) revises symbolic skills and its system prompt during simulated practice, keeps a change only after a cross-task check, and reaches 95.0% against 75.5% for ASPIRE on held-out initializations of 22 simulated tasks; the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials.
paragraphs.zh: 编写代码的智能体常把两类产物称为“技能”：可调用的例程，以及用于构造例程的指导。 LRLL（Tziafas and Kasaei, 2024）在课程设置下，将模拟的指令–程序对蒸馏为可调用的 Python API。 ASPIRE（Lu et al., 2026a）在调试新控制器时检索从早期程序修复中蒸馏出的指导；在三个具身形态与 API 均不同于模拟来源的物理任务上，检索减少了在真实机器人上花费的推理 token，其中留出任务的成功率在一个任务上不变，在两个任务上有所提升。 Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real（Wang et al., 2026i）在模拟练习中修订符号技能及其系统提示词，只有通过跨任务检验才保留改动，并在 22 个模拟任务的留出初始化上达到 95.0%，而 ASPIRE 为 75.5%；冻结后的系统在全部 30 次物理试验中均获成功。

paragraphs.en: Libraries can also be built in advance and frozen, and the clearest results come from passing a frozen library to fresh or weaker agents. RATs ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) distills successful play into a code-skill library for simulated LIBERO-PRO tasks. EmbodiedEvo ( Li et al., 2026g ) keeps code skills and written lessons that raise fresh agents’ success on unseen layouts of the RoboDojo simulation benchmark ( Chen et al., 2026g ) from 8.50% to 30.17%, with similar success at 53.0% lower execution cost than the raw interaction history. Its frozen library also raises a weaker executor that failed to acquire it by 8.86 percentage points over no experience. PhysRSI-eval ( Li et al., 2026j ) freezes GPT-6 Astra workspaces after six rounds of revision on six RoboDojo tasks and tests each on five unseen layouts with no further revision; across 12 workspaces, the stored files alone succeed in 25 of 60 tests. Workspaces pooled from the other tasks also bring the first success earlier in three cases, for example from round 14 to round 7 for Claude Opus 5.5 on the Organize Table task. RoboSkill ( Xie et al., 2026c ) reports real-robot gains on its hard tasks, and Agent as Policy ( Jia et al., 2026 ) shortens execution across repeated real trials. Embodied Turing Machines ( Hu et al., 2026b ) make every decision in code on simulated bimanual tasks (Table 11 ). A frozen library can also be written from demonstrations rather than practice. In an evaluation of GPT-6-Astra ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , the model studies a task’s training demonstrations and writes task guidance, motion references, executable helpers, and recovery procedures into a package that is frozen before testing and given to every fresh test session. On four simulated humanoid tasks of the SIMPLE benchmark, the package raises success from 70.8% to 90.8% (120 episodes per condition), with gains that depend on how closely the demonstrations cover the test tasks.

paragraphs.en: Studies that vary the retained artifact while holding its user fixed show most clearly what the artifact must encode. ReTrace ( Yu et al., 2026a ) lets a model controlling a real Franka arm trace a late failure to an earlier decision, test one correction per attempt, and keep supported corrections as a text skill. With skills that one model learned in a few attempts, a second executing model raises plug insertion and ball pouring from 0% to 80% and 100%, respectively, over ten real trials each. In a code-transfer study ( Kuroki and Tang, 2026 ) , with the coding model, cases, interfaces, and per-session limits held fixed, mean success on nine new tasks in the simulated RoboCasa environment ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) is 45.2% without references, 41.5% with initial source programs, and 57.0% with execution-optimized ones: a retained artifact helps only if it encodes distinctions that the next synthesizer can exploit. Table 8 summarizes selected external-artifact updates of this section and their outcome checks.

paragraphs.en: Even a correct skill fails if it is called under the wrong conditions, and some systems revise those conditions directly. VASO ( Yang et al., 2026e ) model-checks skill-based plans against temporal-logic specifications and turns counterexample traces into updates of each skill’s semantic contract. Across tasks for a Jackal ground robot and the PX4 autopilot, eleven specifications, and 400 generated plans, the optimized skills reach 97.2% (handcrafted alignment) or 96.8% (automatic) specification compliance; compliance holds relative to the encoded propositions, and unmodeled sensing or contact errors lie outside it. The conditions can also concern the robot itself. KnowBody ( Lou et al., 2026 ) keeps an explicit, revisable model of how the robot’s body produces effects, with the VLM frozen, and rechecks knowledge that depends on a revised body estimate before reusing it. Over 32 fixed-budget trials on four real-robot tasks, it completes 75% against 25% for the native harness. With persistent updates, its planner rounds fall by 29–53% from the first to the fifth recorded success. Composition also creates handoffs, as when a placed mug hides the next object from the camera, so a skill’s stated effects should include the state it hands to its successor.
paragraphs.zh: 即使技能本身正确，如果在错误的条件下被调用也会失败，因此一些系统直接修订这些条件。 VASO（Yang et al., 2026e）针对时序逻辑规约对基于技能的计划进行模型检测，并将反例轨迹转化为对每个技能语义契约的更新。 在 Jackal 地面机器人与 PX4 自动驾驶仪的任务、十一项规约和 400 个生成计划上，优化后的技能达到 97.2%（手工对齐）或 96.8%（自动）的规约符合率；符合率是相对于已编码的命题成立的，未建模的感知或接触误差则在其范围之外。 这些条件也可能涉及机器人自身。 KnowBody（Lou et al., 2026）在冻结 VLM 的前提下，维护一个显式且可修订的模型，用以描述机器人的身体如何产生效果，并在复用依赖已修订身体估计的知识之前对其进行重新检验。 在四个真实机器人任务上各进行 32 次固定预算试验中，它完成了 75%，而原生框架仅为 25%。 在持续更新的情况下，其规划器轮次从第一次记录的成功到第五次记录的成功下降了 29–53%。 组合还会产生交接，例如放置的马克杯遮挡了摄像头对下一个物体的视野，因此技能所声明的效果应包含它交给后继技能的状态。

paragraphs.en: The runtime selects context, monitors progress, interrupts, routes control to recoveries, and decides when the nominal policy may resume; revising it can change the effective agent while the weights of planner and controller stay fixed. The reported comparisons show that runtime components interact, and most of them are measured in simulation. SHAPER ( Wang et al., 2026e ) edits textual procedural guidance and a Python harness around a frozen planner and executor, and on VLABench ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) the two edits are not additive: the full configuration scores 34.50% against 28.25% for the seed, less than the skill-only and harness-only gains combined. Zetta ( Ding et al., 2026 ) grows code-based critics that detect local failure signatures such as a slipping grasp and promotes a critic–recovery patch only after diagnostic replay and a fresh closed-loop rollout. Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026j ) keeps a VLA frozen as a retryable contact primitive and learns from execution traces when it and a few analytic primitives apply. SHAPER and Zetta are evaluated in simulation; Harness VLA measures its gains in simulation, with demonstrations on two dual-arm Franka setups. Baton ( Xu et al., 2026a ) explores each subtask separately around a frozen VLA and stores memories of the transitions between subtasks; with exploration on one scene seed and evaluation on ten held-out seeds of 26 simulated RoboMemArena tasks, it reaches 63.5% task success against 46.1% for the strongest prior method, and the system is also run on a real PiPER-X arm.

paragraphs.en: Several systems revise programs and tools around a frozen model and gate what they admit. DynaHarness ( Deng et al., 2026 ) admits a revision of the capabilities around a frozen π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} only after paired regression checks, and its frozen final system reaches 75.2% on 800 newly sampled simulated LIBERO-PRO initial states against 17.5% for the bare policy. HarnessPAI ( Wang et al., 2026g ) , evaluated only in simulation, has a coding agent revise a task program around a frozen action model and reaches 96.5% on simulated LIBERO-PRO tasks, on evaluation seeds that include its development seeds; fine-tuning π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on the harness’s successful rollouts raises held-out-seed success from 34.9% to 73.7%. URAI ( Ge et al., 2026 ) has a frozen agent call validated tools one complete motion at a time, raising pooled success on simulated RoboDojo tasks from 18.0% under direct fingertip control to 53.0%; tool revision by its programming agent appears in an author-steered case study. paragraphs.en: Moving knowledge to another robot can fail at each level of description. Saved as a task, the regrasp transfers only if the receiving robot can ground it in skills of its own, and saved as a named skill, it transfers only if that robot implements the same effect. Saved as an end-effector motion, it transfers only if both robots interpret the motion alike; saved as joint commands, it transfers only to an arm of the same kind. SayCan ( Ichter et al., 2023 ) grounds skills by combining their usefulness for the task with their estimated chance of success, while Open X-Embodiment ( Open X-Embodiment Collaboration et al., 2024 ) standardizes data from twenty-two embodiments but maps actions to a coarse common end-effector format that leaves coordinate frames unaligned, so the same numerical action can induce different motions on different robots. RoboFoundry ( Liang et al., 2026 ) separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution so that evolved memories and recovery skills can transfer, and PhyAgentOS checks observations, action semantics, timing, capabilities, and safety configuration before building adapters; its validation on Franka, PIPER, and Dobot arms tests whether the interface carries over, not whether a saved lesson does. ASPIRE tests a lesson on a single receiving robot: guidance from simulated Franka repairs helps a coding agent debug programs for a bimanual robot with a different API, on which no simulated program runs unchanged. SHAPER, Zetta, and the code-transfer study move artifacts across simulated tasks but not across robots. Evaluation should hold the artifact or the adapter fixed while varying the other.
paragraphs.zh: 将知识迁移到另一台机器人时，在每一个描述层级上都可能失败。 若保存为任务，重抓取（regrasp）只有在接收机器人能将其落实到自身技能时才能迁移；若保存为命名的技能，则只有在该机器人实现了相同效果时才能迁移。 若保存为末端执行器运动，只有在两台机器人对该运动的解释一致时才能迁移；若保存为关节命令，则只能迁移到同类型的机械臂。 SayCan（Ichter et al., 2023）通过将技能对任务的有用性与估计的成功概率相结合来落实技能，而 Open X-Embodiment（Open X-Embodiment Collaboration et al., 2024）将来自二十二种具身形态的数据标准化，但将动作映射到一种粗粒度的通用末端执行器格式，未对齐坐标系，因此同一个数值动作在不同机器人上可能引发不同的运动。 RoboFoundry（Liang et al., 2026）将具身形态无关的决策与具身形态相关的执行分离开来，以便演化出的记忆和恢复技能能够迁移；PhyAgentOS 则在构建适配器之前检查观测、动作语义、时序、能力和安全配置；其在 Franka、PIPER 和 Dobot 机械臂上的验证测试的是接口能否沿用，而不是保存的经验能否迁移。 ASPIRE 在单台接收机器人上测试经验：来自模拟 Franka 修复的指导帮助一个编码智能体调试双臂机器人的程序，该机器人具有不同的 API，且没有任何模拟程序能不经修改直接运行。 SHAPER、Zetta 和代码迁移研究在模拟任务之间迁移工件，但没有跨机器人迁移。 评估应当固定工件或适配器之一，同时改变另一个。

paragraphs.en: The changes reviewed so far also alter what the next round of learning starts from. An improved policy reaches states that were previously inaccessible, so the data available for the next update change too. The resulting experience can expose distinctions missing from supervision; revised supervision changes what an update teaches; and the repair that follows can become evidence for constructing later updates. Along this chain, a change of any form can take on a new role in the learning procedure (Figure 4 ). Improving that procedure is where RSI would begin, because it changes how the robot learns rather than only what it does.
paragraphs.zh: 目前所审查的这些改动也会改变下一轮学习的起点。 一个改进后的策略能够到达先前无法到达的状态，因此下一次更新可用的数据也会随之改变。 由此产生的经验可以揭示监督中缺失的区别；修订后的监督会改变一次更新所教的内容；而随后的修复又可以成为构建后续更新的证据。 在这条链上，任何形式的改动都可能在学习过程中承担新的角色（图 4）。 改进这一过程正是递归自我改进（RSI）的起点，因为它改变的是智能体如何学习，而不仅仅是它做什么。

paragraphs.en: Reuse and procedure change can overlap, but they answer different questions: reuse asks whether a change is carried forward, whereas procedure change asks whether it alters collection, judgment, or updating for a later learner. We take the procedure’s decisions in turn: where the next experience comes from ( c c , Section 3.2.1 ), how outcomes are judged ( e e , Section 3.2.2 ), what an update learns from ( d d , Section 3.2.3 ), and how the update is made ( u u , Section 3.2.4 ). Section 3.2.5 then turns to how whole experimental loops are run, which can change several of these decisions at once, and Table 10 summarizes representative systems. A changed procedure is not yet an improved one: improvement requires that a learner guided by the revised procedure learn better than a matched learner guided by the earlier one (Section 2.2 ; Figure 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 复用与流程变更可以重叠，但它们回答的是不同的问题：复用关注的是某项变更是否被延续下来，而流程变更关注的是它是否改变了后续智能体的收集、判断或更新。 我们依次考察该流程的各项决策：下一个经验来自哪里（c c，第 3.2.1 节）、结果如何被评判（e e，第 3.2.2 节）、更新从什么中学习（d d，第 3.2.3 节），以及更新如何进行（u u，第 3.2.4 节）。 第 3.2.5 节随后讨论整个实验循环如何运行，这可以同时改变上述多项决策，表 10 总结了代表性系统。 变更后的流程还不等于改进后的流程：改进要求由修订后流程引导的智能体比由先前流程引导的匹配智能体学得更好（第 2.2 节；图 8）。

paragraphs.en: Once a recovery removes a coarse grasp failure, the remaining errors may concentrate on subtle contact events. More demonstrations of the old kind may then be less useful than tactile checks, a finer reward, or a new rule for editing skills. Better execution has changed the learning problem, and the system now has to find the experience that teaches what is still missing. The most useful experience for an improved policy need not come from the distribution that served its predecessor, and choosing it involves three decisions: which tasks or states to practice, what supervision an attempt needs, and when collection is safe. Active learning ( Cohn et al., 1996 ) selects observations for their expected contribution to learning; in robotics, however, selecting an observation often means choosing a behavior, task, environment, or trajectory that must actually be executed. SAC-X ( Riedmiller et al., 2018 ) schedules auxiliary behaviors that help the robot reach sparse rewards; automatic domain randomization ( OpenAI et al., 2019 ) widens the range of simulated conditions as the policy becomes competent; and Enhanced POET ( Wang et al., 2020 ) co-evolves environments together with the policies that solve them. In each case, what the learner can already do helps determine what it encounters next.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦某次恢复消除了粗抓取失败，剩余的错误可能会集中在细微的接触事件上。 此时，相比再提供更多旧类型的演示，触觉检查、更精细的奖励或一条新的技能编辑规则可能更有用。 更好的执行已经改变了学习问题，系统现在必须去寻找能教会它仍缺失内容的经验。 对改进后的策略而言，最有用的经验不必来自服务其前身的分布，而选择经验涉及三个决策：练习哪些任务或状态、一次尝试需要什么监督，以及何时采集是安全的。 主动学习（Cohn 等，1996）根据观测对学习的预期贡献来选择观测；然而在机器人学中，选择一个观测往往意味着选择一个必须实际执行的行为、任务、环境或轨迹。 SAC-X（Riedmiller 等，2018）调度有助于机器人达成稀疏奖励的辅助行为；自动域随机化（OpenAI 等，2019）随着策略变得胜任而扩大模拟条件的范围；而 Enhanced POET（Wang 等，2020）则让环境与解决它们的策略共同演化。 在每种情况下，学习者已经能做到的事情都有助于决定它接下来会遇到什么。

sents.en: Once a recovery removes a coarse grasp failure, the remaining errors may concentrate on subtle contact events.
sents.zh: 一旦某次恢复消除了粗抓取失败，剩余的错误可能会集中在细微的接触事件上。

sents.en: More demonstrations of the old kind may then be less useful than tactile checks, a finer reward, or a new rule for editing skills.
sents.zh: 此时，相比再提供更多旧类型的演示，触觉检查、更精细的奖励或一条新的技能编辑规则可能更有用。

sents.en: Better execution has changed the learning problem, and the system now has to find the experience that teaches what is still missing.
sents.zh: 更好的执行已经改变了学习问题，系统现在必须去寻找能教会它仍缺失内容的经验。

sents.en: The most useful experience for an improved policy need not come from the distribution that served its predecessor, and choosing it involves three decisions: which tasks or states to practice, what supervision an attempt needs, and when collection is safe.
sents.zh: 对改进后的策略而言，最有用的经验不必来自服务其前身的分布，而选择经验涉及三个决策：练习哪些任务或状态、一次尝试需要什么监督，以及何时采集是安全的。

sents.en: Active learning ( Cohn et al., 1996 ) selects observations for their expected contribution to learning; in robotics, however, selecting an observation often means choosing a behavior, task, environment, or trajectory that must actually be executed.
sents.zh: 主动学习（Cohn 等，1996）根据观测对学习的预期贡献来选择观测；然而在机器人学中，选择一个观测往往意味着选择一个必须实际执行的行为、任务、环境或轨迹。

sents.en: SAC-X ( Riedmiller et al., 2018 ) schedules auxiliary behaviors that help the robot reach sparse rewards; automatic domain randomization ( OpenAI et al., 2019 ) widens the range of simulated conditions as the policy becomes competent; and Enhanced POET ( Wang et al., 2020 ) co-evolves environments together with the policies that solve them.
sents.zh: SAC-X（Riedmiller 等，2018）调度有助于机器人达成稀疏奖励的辅助行为；自动域随机化（OpenAI 等，2019）随着策略变得胜任而扩大模拟条件的范围；而 Enhanced POET（Wang 等，2020）则让环境与解决它们的策略共同演化。

sents.en: In each case, what the learner can already do helps determine what it encounters next.
sents.zh: 在每种情况下，学习者已经能做到的事情都有助于决定它接下来会遇到什么。

paragraphs.en: At the task level, the frontier worth targeting is learnable challenge: tasks hard enough to teach something and easy enough to be learned. Methods based on intrinsic motivation ( Oudeyer et al., 2007 ) , automatic curriculum learning ( Portelas et al., 2020 ) , and autotelic agents that set their own goals ( Colas et al., 2022 ) track learning progress across goals or environment parameters. Systems built on language models enlarge the space of candidate lessons by generating tasks and environments, as in GenSim ( Wang et al., 2024b ) and RoboGen ( Wang et al., 2024d ) ; OMNI ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) combines estimated learning progress with a model of what humans find interesting, while Eurekaverse ( Liang et al., 2025 ) generates environments that become progressively more challenging while remaining diverse and learnable. AutoRT ( Ahn et al., 2024 ) proposes tasks with language models, filters them against a written robot constitution, and over seven months collected about 77,000 episodes on 53 robots. Generation supplies possibilities, but a signal that depends on the learner’s current capability is still needed to decide which possibility should become the next lesson.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务层面，值得瞄准的前沿是可学习的挑战：任务既要难到能教会一些东西，又要容易到能够被学会。 基于内在动机（Oudeyer et al., 2007）、自动课程学习（Portelas et al., 2020）以及设定自身目标的自主目标智能体（Colas et al., 2022）的方法，会跨目标或环境参数追踪学习进度。 基于语言模型的系统通过生成任务和环境来扩大候选课程的空间，如 GenSim（Wang et al., 2024b）和 RoboGen（Wang et al., 2024d）；OMNI（Zhang et al., 2024）将估计的学习进度与人类觉得有趣之处的模型相结合，而 Eurekaverse（Liang et al., 2025）生成的环境会逐渐变得更具挑战性，同时保持多样性和可学习性。 AutoRT（Ahn et al., 2024）用语言模型提出任务，并依据一份成文的机器人宪章对其进行筛选，在七个月时间里于 53 台机器人上收集了约 77,000 个回合的数据。 生成提供了可能性，但仍需要一个取决于学习者当前能力的信号，来决定哪个可能性应当成为下一课。

paragraphs.en: FIND ( Fang et al., 2026 ) supplies such a signal on hardware: a VLM agent selects feasible tasks with low recent success and judges each attempt by comparing observations before and after execution, and residual RL on a frozen π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} raises success on eight real tasks from 55% to 71.9%, while people still reset scenes when needed. InSight ( Wang et al., 2026c ) lets a VLM name the primitives a steerable VLA lacks for a new task, practices them with VLM-parameterized single-axis control, and retrains the VLA on successful segments; on a real xArm, twisting and pouring reach 92% and 96% against 32% and 16% for a zero-shot code-as-policy baseline with the same VLM (25 trials each). Agentic Skill Discovery ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) has a language model propose the next task from its skill library and a pool of failed tasks, and keeps a skill only after a VLM confirms it; in simulation, RL reaches at least 90% success on 17 of 22 tabulated tasks. EmbodiedRSI ( Song et al., 2026b ) applies a related signal to an agent harness: it keeps competing code and skill hypotheses, selects the experiments expected to distinguish them, and learns which memories to keep according to their value for later improvement. It is evolved entirely in simulation (Table 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: FIND（Fang et al., 2026）在硬件层面提供了这样一种信号：一个 VLM 智能体选取近期成功率较低的可行任务，并通过比较执行前后的观测来判断每次尝试，随后在冻结的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 上进行残差 RL，将八个真实任务的成功率从 55% 提升到 71.9%，同时人们在需要时仍会重置场景。 InSight（Wang et al., 2026c）让一个 VLM 指出可引导 VLA 在新任务上缺失的基元，用 VLM 参数化的单轴控制进行练习，并在成功的片段上重新训练 VLA；在一台真实 xArm 上，拧转和倾倒分别达到 92% 和 96%，而使用同一 VLM 的零样本代码即策略基线仅为 32% 和 16%（各 25 次试验）。 Agentic Skill Discovery（Zhao et al., 2024）让一个语言模型从其技能库和失败任务池中提出下一个任务，并且只有在 VLM 确认之后才保留该技能；在仿真中，RL 在 22 个表列任务中的 17 个上达到至少 90% 的成功率。 EmbodiedRSI（Song et al., 2026b）将一种相关信号应用于智能体框架：它保留相互竞争的代码与技能假设，选择有望区分这些假设的实验，并根据记忆对后续改进的价值来学习保留哪些记忆。 它完全在仿真中演化（表 11）。

paragraphs.en: Goal exploration shows what such a signal should track. SAGG-RIAC ( Baranes and Oudeyer, 2013 ) selects regions of the goal space where competence is changing, rather than repeatedly sampling the goals with the lowest success. Its experiments on learning inverse models move practice away from both mastered and unreachable regions. Failure prediction and learning-progress estimation answer different questions: where is the policy weak, and where is another attempt likely to change what it can do? ALAN ( Mendonca et al., 2023 ) applies a related signal on hardware, exploring two real-world play-kitchen setups by favoring changes it can cause to objects and its uncertainty about predicted change. Practice Makes Perfect ( Kumar et al., 2024 ) makes the choice explicit for parameterized skills. It estimates each skill’s competence, extrapolates the gain from another attempt, and weighs that gain by planned task success. Over one to three hours of reset-free practice on a Spot arm, the fraction of evaluation tasks solved rises from 0.0 to 0.8 in one environment and from 0.53 to 0.93 in the other.
paragraphs.zh: 目标探索展示了这种信号应当追踪什么。 SAGG-RIAC（Baranes and Oudeyer, 2013）选择能力正在变化的目标空间区域，而不是反复采样成功率最低的目标。 其在学习逆模型上的实验使练习远离已精通和无法企及的区域。 失败预测与学习进度估计回答的是不同的问题：策略在哪里薄弱，以及在哪里再尝试一次可能会改变它所能做到的事情？ ALAN（Mendonca et al., 2023）在真实硬件上应用了相关信号，通过偏向其能对物体造成的变化以及对预测变化的不确定性，探索了两个真实世界的游戏厨房场景。 Practice Makes Perfect（Kumar et al., 2024）将这种选择显式化，用于参数化技能。 它估计每个技能的能力，外推再尝试一次的收益，并用计划的任务成功率对该收益加权。 在 Spot 机械臂上历时一到三小时的无重置练习中，一个环境中评测任务解决的比例从 0.0 上升到 0.8，另一个环境中从 0.53 上升到 0.93。

paragraphs.en: At the level of states and datasets, failure becomes useful when it can be converted into appropriate supervision, and the clearest comparisons fix the demonstration budget while varying where it is spent. A criticality model trained on policy outcomes ( He et al., 2026a ) can bias collection toward scenarios that are likely to end in failure, such as hard initial states. The method uses importance-sampled experience for RL and criticality-selected expert demonstrations for imitation learning. In its two multi-round simulated runs the predictor is retrained on the current policy’s rollouts each round. Its evaluations span simulated locomotion and manipulation, VLA benchmarks, and a physical banana-placement task. A high criticality score still leaves open whether a state calls for autonomous exploration, expert correction, or avoidance. A world model can rank the gaps instead: RoboCoach ( Liu et al., 2026d ) imagines where each skill expert first times out and requests demonstrations for the highest-ranked subtask–expert pairs, and with matched demonstration budgets success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on a Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on an AgileX platform, against 30.0% and 47.5% for uniform collection into one adapter. SAVE ( Römer et al., 2026a ) sends each expert demonstration to the task and initial state where an ensemble’s velocity fields disagree most, reaching 47% average success on three real Franka tasks at a fixed budget of 150 demonstrations, 8 to 25 percentage points above the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在状态与数据集层面上，当失败能够被转化为恰当的监督信号时，它就变得有用，而最清晰的比较方式是固定示范预算，同时改变预算的花费位置。 基于策略结果训练的临界性模型（He et al., 2026a）可以将数据采集偏向那些可能以失败告终的场景，例如困难的初始状态。 该方法将重要性采样的经验用于强化学习，并将临界性筛选的专家示范用于模仿学习。 在其两轮多轮模拟运行中，预测器每轮都会在当前策略的轨迹采样上重新训练。 其评估涵盖模拟的 locomotion 与操作任务、VLA 基准测试，以及一个真实的香蕉摆放任务。 高临界性评分仍然无法说明某个状态是需要自主探索、专家纠正，还是应当回避。 世界模型则可以对差距进行排序：RoboCoach（Liu et al., 2026d）设想每个技能专家最早在何处超时，并针对排名最高的子任务–专家对请求示范，在示范预算匹配的情况下，Franka 平台上的成功率从 13.3% 提升到 75.0%，AgileX 平台上从 40.0% 提升到 83.8%，而均匀采集并汇入单个适配器的方法分别仅为 30.0% 和 47.5%。 SAVE（Römer et al., 2026a）将每条专家示范发送到集成模型速度场分歧最大的任务和初始状态，在 150 条示范的固定预算下，在三个真实 Franka 任务上取得 47% 的平均成功率，比基线高出 8 到 25 个百分点。

sents.zh: SAVE（Römer et al., 2026a）将每条专家示范发送到集成模型速度场分歧最大的任务和初始状态，在 150 条示范的固定预算下，在三个真实 Franka 任务上取得 47% 的平均成功率，比基线高出 8 到 25 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Failures can also be rebuilt or searched for in simulation. F4R ( Yu et al., 2026b ) rebuilds each diagnosed failure as a simulated scene for targeted practice and gains 18.75 percentage points out of distribution on four real tasks over a budget-matched targeted imitation baseline, and EmbodiRSI ( Lang et al., 2026 ) builds task-specific simulations from deployment scenes for corrections and demonstrations aimed at current weaknesses (Table 11 ). SEES ( Li et al., 2026l ) restores, in simulation, the states before the sub-skill that most often stalls a long-horizon task and trains that skill family with PPO against an LLM-written success check, gaining over three rounds on RoboCasa365 (Appendix B ). Q-DEG ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) searches over object placement, camera, and lighting for diverse simulated scenes in which a VLA sometimes fails and fine-tunes it on its own successes there, raising average success on held-out adversarial LIBERO-Spatial scenes from 67.2% to 80.9% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , with a small drop on the default scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 失败案例也可以在仿真中重建或搜索。 F4R（Yu et al., 2026b）将每个诊断出的失败重建为仿真场景以进行针对性练习，在四个真实任务上相比预算匹配的针对性模仿基线，分布外性能提升了 18.75 个百分点；EmbodiRSI（Lang et al., 2026）则从部署场景构建任务特定的仿真，用于针对当前弱点进行纠正和示范（表 11）。 SEES（Li et al., 2026l）在仿真中恢复长时程任务中最常卡住的子技能之前的状态，并使用 PPO 针对由 LLM 编写的成功判据训练该技能族，在 RoboCasa365 上经过三轮训练获得了提升（附录 B）。 Q-DEG（Zhao et al., 2026a）搜索物体摆放、相机和光照设置，生成多样化的、某个 VLA 偶尔会失败的仿真场景，并在该智能体自身在这些场景中的成功案例上对其进行微调，使 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 在留出的对抗性 LIBERO-Spatial 场景上的平均成功率从 67.2% 提高到 80.9%，而在默认场景上仅有小幅下降。

paragraphs.en: Supervision is the second decision: when experience must be acquired physically, selection must also determine when autonomy should yield to an expert. SAGE ( Hu et al., 2026a ) estimates short-horizon cost and uncertainty with an ensemble of world models and combines them into a “fear” signal, and world-model prediction error adjusts the threshold at which an expert takes over. The resulting interventions provide targeted data for imitation and risk-constrained learning. Most of its evidence comes from driving simulation and replay of Waymo driving data, while the hardware evaluation covers four controlled indoor settings for a ground robot with twenty trials per setting. The mechanism times expert takeover by predicted risk; long-term, unrestricted deployment remains untested. Human-in-the-loop deployment concentrates human attention in the same way. Sirius ( Liu et al., 2023b ) lets people intervene during deployment and learns from those interventions, whereas Fleet-DAgger ( Hoque et al., 2022b ) allocates a limited number of human supervisors across multiple robots. HIL-UMI ( Han et al., 2026 ) carries the same idea into demonstrations collected with the handheld Universal Manipulation Interface ( Chi et al., 2024 ) : it queries the current policy without executing it, collects human actions where policy–human discrepancy indicates unfamiliar behavior, and separately refines a progress-based advantage estimator. It takes the robot out of demonstration collection, while human action supervision and final hardware evaluation remain necessary. Genie Centurion ( Wang et al., 2025b ) also updates the component that decides when to ask. Its task sentinel flags steps not completed in time, after which the robot rewinds for an operator’s correction, and the sentinel is fine-tuned together with the policy each round. Across four real tasks at matched trajectory counts, the final-round step-completion score is 0.93, against 0.53 for adversarial data collection and 0.38 for teleoperation.
paragraphs.zh: 监督是第二个决策：当经验必须通过物理方式获取时，选择机制还必须决定自主性何时应当让位于专家。 SAGE（Hu 等，2026a）利用世界模型集成来估计短程成本与不确定性，并将其组合为一个「恐惧」信号，同时世界模型的预测误差会调整专家接管智能体的阈值。 由此产生的干预为模仿学习和风险约束学习提供了有针对性的数据。 其证据大多来自驾驶仿真和 Waymo 驾驶数据的回放，而硬件评估则覆盖一台地面机器人在四个受控室内场景下的测试，每个场景进行二十次试验。 该机制依据预测风险来安排专家接管时机；长期的无限制部署仍未得到验证。 人在回路中的部署以同样的方式集中人的注意力。 Sirius（Liu 等，2023b）允许人在部署过程中进行干预并从这些干预中学习，而 Fleet-DAgger（Hoque 等，2022b）则将数量有限的人类监督者分配到多台机器人之间。 HIL-UMI（Han 等，2026）将同样的思想引入用手持式通用操作界面（Universal Manipulation Interface，Chi 等，2024）采集的演示数据中：它查询当前策略但不执行，在策略与人类动作差异表明行为陌生之处采集人类动作，并单独改进基于进度的优势估计器。 它让机器人从演示采集工作中解放出来，但人类动作监督和最终硬件评估仍然必不可少。 Genie Centurion（Wang 等，2025b）同样会更新决定何时求助的组件。 其任务哨兵会标记未按时完成的步骤，随后机器人回退以便操作员纠正，且哨兵与策略在每一轮中共同微调。 在轨迹数量匹配的四个真实任务中，最后一轮的步骤完成得分为 0.93，而对抗性数据采集为 0.53，遥操作为 0.38。

paragraphs.en: Some desired experience cannot be demonstrated at first. GLIDE ( Song et al., 2026c ) converts anticipated and observed teleoperation failures into executable guardrails on commands and reuses the revised guardrails during both data collection and policy execution. Across three physical tasks, its ten-trial collection tests rise from zero or one successes without guardrails to seven to nine with the selected refined guardrails. Crossed policy experiments separate the contribution of guarded training data from that of guarded execution. Here, selection extends to constructing the conditions under which a demonstration can be produced at all.
paragraphs.zh: 某些期望的经验在最初无法被演示。 GLIDE（Song et al., 2026c）将预期和观察到的遥操作失败转化为命令上可执行的护栏，并在数据采集和策略执行期间复用修订后的护栏。 在三个物理任务中，其十次试验的采集测试从没有护栏时的零或一次成功，提升到使用所选精炼护栏时的七到九次成功。 交叉策略实验将受护栏保护的训练数据与受护栏保护的执行的贡献区分开来。 在这里，选择延伸到构建能够产出演示的条件本身。

paragraphs.en: Safety is the third decision. A learned runtime monitor ( Liu et al., 2024 ) can request human supervision before a predicted failure, and safe online system identification ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) keeps informative trajectories within certified constraints. No single score resolves all three decisions: states with similar failure probabilities may represent a missing skill, an unreachable target, or an unsafe transition, so a useful rule for physical data acquisition must combine expected learning benefit with recoverability, the available source of supervision, and the costs of time, resets, wear, and risk.
paragraphs.zh: 安全是第三个决策。 学习型运行时监控器（Liu et al., 2024）可以在预测到故障发生之前请求人类监督，而安全的在线系统辨识（Zhang et al., 2025a）能让有信息量的轨迹保持在经过认证的约束范围内。 没有单一分数能够解决全部三个决策：具有相似失败概率的状态可能表示缺失的技能、无法到达的目标或不安全的转移，因此用于物理数据采集的有效规则必须将预期学习收益与可恢复性、可用的监督来源以及时间、重置、损耗和风险的成本相结合。

paragraphs.en: A policy that reaches new states also strains its supervision: a reward or evaluator learned on earlier behavior may not score those states correctly. The least invasive response is to update the judge and rescore existing data. PEBBLE ( Lee et al., 2021 ) learns a reward model from preferences between pairs of behaviors (supplied by a scripted teacher in its quantitative experiments) and relabels the entire replay buffer whenever that model changes, so that off-policy learning in its simulated locomotion and manipulation tasks always sees one current interpretation of stored experience. RL-VLM-F ( Wang et al., 2024c ) keeps this preference-based loop but takes the labels from a vision-language model that compares pairs of images against a text goal, so that its simulated tasks need no human or scripted teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 一个能到达新状态的策略也会给其监督带来压力：基于较早行为学到的奖励或评估器可能无法正确地为这些新状态打分。 侵入性最小的应对方式是更新评判模型并对已有数据重新打分。 PEBBLE（Lee 等，2021）从行为对之间的偏好（在其定量实验中由脚本化教师提供）中学习奖励模型，并且每当该模型发生变化时就对整个重放缓冲区重新标注，从而使其模拟运动控制与操作任务中的离策略学习始终面对对已存储经验的一种当前解读。 RL-VLM-F（Wang 等，2024c）保留了这种基于偏好的循环，但从视觉-语言模型获取标注，该模型将图像对与文本目标进行比较，因此其模拟任务无需人类或脚本化教师。

paragraphs.en: FIERCE ( Tan et al., 2026b ) applies this response on hardware: it fits and calibrates an evaluator of progress and failure on local successes and failures. Each refinement round freezes a versioned snapshot of the evaluator, consistently relabels the replay buffer, updates the policy, and later refreshes the evaluator with newer rollouts. On physical peg-in-hole and cup-stacking tasks, the reported single-seed comparisons favor periodic refresh over a frozen task evaluator, although total acquisition cost is not equalized. Feedback thus stays stable during each policy update and can be revised between updates. RLER ( Wu et al., 2026 ) refits a success-probability reward model on the policy’s own rollouts between rounds of offline RL; on two real Franka tasks, two rounds raise success from 64% to 84% and from 60% to 86% over the starting policy, 8 to 12 percentage points above keeping the same reward model fixed. EvoHIL ( Zhang et al., 2026h ) retrains its reward classifier during human-in-the-loop RL from operator-confirmed successes and deploys each version only after a held-out accuracy gate; under a lighting shift on six real tasks, success reaches 0.73 to 1.00 against 0.13 to 0.50 for HIL-SERL, in a comparison the authors describe as not resource-matched. VeriFine ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) revises the judge itself when policy gains plateau: an agent edits the judge’s rubric and asks human experts to settle disagreements, which on driving-reasoning data raises the judge’s correlation with human ratings from 0.55 to 0.85 and the policy’s reasoning score from 68.05 to 83.13 under matched training budgets.

sents.en: FIERCE ( Tan et al., 2026b ) applies this response on hardware: it fits and calibrates an evaluator of progress and failure on local successes and failures.

sents.en: Each refinement round freezes a versioned snapshot of the evaluator, consistently relabels the replay buffer, updates the policy, and later refreshes the evaluator with newer rollouts.
sents.zh: 每一轮细化都会冻结一个带版本号的评估器快照，一致性地重新标注回放缓冲区，更新策略，并在之后用更新的 rollout 刷新评估器。

sents.en: On physical peg-in-hole and cup-stacking tasks, the reported single-seed comparisons favor periodic refresh over a frozen task evaluator, although total acquisition cost is not equalized.
sents.zh: 在实体插孔与叠杯任务上，报告的单种子对比结果表明周期性刷新优于冻结的任务评估器，尽管总体采集成本并未对等。

paragraphs.en: A learned world model can also act as a judge, and it inherits the blind spots of its training data. On a physical arm, a scene-adapted Ctrl-World model fine-tuned on successes scored 90% of held-out failing sequences as success-like under a latent-distance diagnostic, and fine-tuning on execution-checked counterfactual failures lowered this to 33% ( Xu et al., 2026c ) . Judges that only rank a frozen policy’s candidate actions at run time, without supervising an update, appear with action selection in Section 3.1.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 学习得到的世界模型也可以充当裁判，而它会继承训练数据中的盲点。 在实体机械臂上，一个针对场景适配、在成功数据上微调的 Ctrl-World 模型，在潜在距离诊断下将 90% 的保留失败序列判为类似成功；而在经过执行检验的反事实失败数据上微调后，这一比例降至 33%（Xu et al., 2026c）。 只在运行时对冻结策略的候选动作进行排序、而不监督更新的裁判，将与动作选择一起在第 3.1.1 节中出现。

paragraphs.en: A larger change is to revise the reward specification itself. Language models first entered this role as proxy reward functions. Kwon et al. (2023) prompt a language model with a task description and an episode outcome and use its answer as the reward in negotiation and matrix games. Language to Rewards ( Yu et al., 2023 ) has a language model translate instructions into reward parameters that a model-predictive controller optimizes for a simulated quadruped, a simulated dexterous manipulator, and a real robot arm. Text2Reward ( Xie et al., 2024 ) turns a natural-language goal and an abstract description of the environment into executable dense-reward code; after users inspect policy rollouts, their feedback can prompt another version of the code. Its main evaluations use simulated manipulation and locomotion, with policies trained in simulation demonstrated on two tasks with a Franka arm. Eureka ( Ma et al., 2024a ) removes the human from this editing loop by training policies under candidate rewards and returning task fitness, together with statistics of each reward component, to the language model. In Text2Reward and Eureka, the language model’s weights remain fixed; improvement comes from new context and externally supplied evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个更大的改动是修改奖励规范本身。 语言模型最初是以代理奖励函数的角色进入这一领域的。Kwon 等人 （2023）向语言模型提供任务描述和回合结果作为提示，并将其回答用作谈判博弈和矩阵博弈中的奖励。 Language to Rewards（Yu 等人，2023）让语言模型将指令翻译成奖励参数，由模型预测控制器为一只仿真四足机器人、一个仿真灵巧操作手和一个真实机械臂进行优化。 Text2Reward（Xie 等人，2024）将自然语言目标和环境的抽象描述转化为可执行的稠密奖励代码；在用户查看策略回放之后，他们的反馈可以提示生成另一版本的代码。 它的主要评估使用仿真的操作和运动任务，其中在仿真中训练的策略在两个任务上用一台 Franka 机械臂进行了演示。 Eureka（Ma 等人，2024a）通过在候选奖励下训练策略，并将任务适配度连同每个奖励分量的统计信息一起返回给语言模型，从而把人从这一编辑循环中移除。 在 Text2Reward 和 Eureka 中，语言模型的权重保持固定；改进来自新的上下文和外部提供的评估。

sents.zh: 一个更大的改动是修改奖励规范本身。

paragraphs.en: Later systems vary this loop mainly to cut its cost or to check candidates before training. STRIDE ( Wu et al., 2025 ) refines humanoid-locomotion rewards from training statistics and reports a best success score about 2.5 times Eureka’s on random terrain in simulation, although the two methods use different language models. CARD ( Sun et al., 2024 ) first checks whether a candidate reward ranks recorded successes above failures and skips RL training when it does not. It matches or exceeds expert rewards on 10 of 12 simulated tasks with about 14K tokens per task against about 663K for Eureka. MEMENTO ( Sygkounas et al., 2026 ) evolves the evaluator before the policy, so that code-policy search in simulation solves Tower of Hanoi in 0.97 of episodes, whereas the same search under the unevolved evaluator solves none.
paragraphs.zh: 后续系统主要通过对这一循环进行改动来降低其成本，或在训练前对候选方案进行筛选。 STRIDE（Wu et al., 2025）根据训练统计信息对人形运动奖励进行改进，并报告其最佳成功分数约为 Eureka 在仿真中随机地形上的 2.5 倍，尽管这两种方法使用的是不同的语言模型。 CARD（Sun et al., 2024）首先检查候选奖励是否能将记录的成功案例排在失败案例之前，如果不能，则跳过强化学习训练。 在 12 个仿真任务中的 10 个上，它达到或超过了专家奖励的水平，每个任务约使用 14K 个词元，而 Eureka 约使用 663K 个词元。 MEMENTO（Sygkounas et al., 2026）先对评估器进行演化，再对策略进行演化，从而使得在仿真中的代码-策略搜索能以 0.97 的比例解决汉诺塔问题，而使用未演化评估器的相同搜索则一例都无法解决。

paragraphs.en: These loops also need a criterion that stays outside the quantity being optimized. A reward program can score demonstrations sensibly yet induce shortcut behavior during training; a quicker lift can coexist with excessive grip force, jerky motion, or a fragile final state. Text2Reward uses human interpretation as an anchor, while Eureka relies on a task-fitness function specified by researchers. Without such an independent reference, iterating on the reward can amplify a misspecification. Revising supervision has to ask two questions: does the new signal accelerate learning, and does the resulting behavior still satisfy the original objective?
paragraphs.zh: 这些循环还需要一个独立于被优化量之外的标准。 一个奖励程序可以对演示给出合理的评分，却在训练中诱发走捷径的行为；更快的抓取可能与过大的握力、急促的动作或脆弱的最终状态并存。 Text2Reward 以人类解读作为锚点，而 Eureka 依赖于由研究者指定的任务适应度函数。 缺少这样一个独立的参照，对奖励的迭代可能会放大错误的设定。 修订监督必须提出两个问题：新信号是否加速学习，以及由此产生的行为是否仍然满足最初的目标？

paragraphs.en: Training conditions can be revised as well as rewards. DrEureka ( Ma et al., 2024b ) runs Eureka to write a reward, evaluates the resulting policy under perturbed simulator parameters to find the ranges in which it still performs well, and then asks a language model to choose a domain-randomization configuration (the ranges of physical parameters varied during simulated training) within those ranges. The resulting policies transfer to physical quadruped and dexterous-manipulation platforms without further real-world training. Here the policy probes its own later training distribution, but only in simulation; deployment experience does not feed back into that distribution. Broadening variation can increase robustness, yet overly wide ranges consume rollouts and can make the task unnecessarily hard to learn.
paragraphs.zh: 训练条件与奖励一样可以被修改。 DrEureka（Ma 等，2024b）运行 Eureka 来编写奖励，在扰动的模拟器参数下评估所得到的策略，以找出策略仍然表现良好的参数范围，然后让一个语言模型在这些范围内选择一个域随机化配置（模拟训练中变化的物理参数范围）。 所得到的策略无需进一步的真实世界训练即可迁移到物理四足平台和灵巧操作平台上。 在这里，策略探索的是自己后续的训练分布，但仅在模拟中进行；部署经验不会反馈到该分布中。 扩大变化范围可以增强鲁棒性，但过宽的范围会消耗回合采样，并可能使任务变得不必要地难以学习。

paragraphs.en: Physical verification can instead become memory for later judgments. REVOLVE ( Liu et al., 2026b ) stores cases in which a VLM’s judgment of an outcome disagrees with human verification and retrieves similar mismatches as context for future judgments. In parallel, it updates the policy from successful rollouts and from failure–correction data. Across four physical tasks, policy success rises over five iterations and judgment accuracy over four memory updates, supported by task-specific automated correction and reset routines. Because mismatch memory, policy data, and behavior change together, the study demonstrates a functioning dual loop without separating the contribution of each loop.
paragraphs.zh: 物理验证反而可以成为后续判断的记忆。 REVOLVE（Liu et al., 2026b）存储视觉语言模型（VLM）对结果的判断与人工验证不一致的案例，并检索相似的不匹配情况作为后续判断的上下文。 与此同时，它从成功的回滚和失败—纠正数据中更新策略。 在四项物理任务中，经过五次迭代，策略成功率持续上升；经过四次记忆更新，判断准确率持续提升，这得益于针对具体任务的自动化纠正与重置流程。 由于不匹配记忆、策略数据和行为共同变化，该研究展示了一个有效的双重循环，但未分离每个循环各自的贡献。

sents.en: Physical verification can instead become memory for later judgments.
sents.zh: 物理验证反而可以成为后续判断的记忆。

sents.en: REVOLVE ( Liu et al., 2026b ) stores cases in which a VLM’s judgment of an outcome disagrees with human verification and retrieves similar mismatches as context for future judgments.

sents.en: In parallel, it updates the policy from successful rollouts and from failure–correction data.
sents.zh: 与此同时，它从成功的回滚和失败—纠正数据中更新策略。

sents.en: Across four physical tasks, policy success rises over five iterations and judgment accuracy over four memory updates, supported by task-specific automated correction and reset routines.

sents.en: Because mismatch memory, policy data, and behavior change together, the study demonstrates a functioning dual loop without separating the contribution of each loop.
sents.zh: 由于不匹配记忆、策略数据和行为共同变化，该研究展示了一个有效的双重循环，但未分离每个循环各自的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval can alter the effective procedure even when model weights stay fixed: ASPIRE uses earlier repairs to construct controllers, whereas REVOLVE uses earlier judgment errors to interpret later outcomes. FailBench ( Navasardyan et al., 2026 ) measures how far such judges can be trusted: across 2,197 real and simulated manipulation attempts, the best of 13 VLM success detectors reaches 0.77 balanced accuracy, and none exceeds 0.60 on contact-intensive assembly. Every loop above that revises behavior against a learned judge is exposed to errors of this kind, so part of the success evaluation must stay outside the loop (Section 4.3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 检索即使模型权重保持不变，也能改变有效过程：ASPIRE 利用早先的修复来构建控制器，而 REVOLVE 利用早先的判断错误来解释后续结果。 FailBench（Navasardyan et al., 2026）衡量这类评判器能被信任到何种程度：在 2,197 次真实与模拟的操作尝试中，13 个 VLM 成功检测器中最好的平衡准确率为 0.77，而在接触密集型装配任务上没有超过 0.60 的。 上述每一个依据学习到的评判器来修订行为的循环都会暴露于此类错误，因此部分成功评估必须留在循环之外（第 4.3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Once experience is collected and judged, the procedure must decide what the next update learns from: which retained data, corrections, demonstrations, or teacher outputs, and from which model. Several examples below run a fixed procedure and report a later-learning benefit; they appear here because they change where the procedure’s training data come from. Acquired competence first changes who can supply the next learner’s evidence. In RoboCat ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) (Section 3.1.1 ), an adapted specialist collects data for the next generalist; the study demonstrates one completed cycle of this transfer. PLD ( Xiao et al., 2026a ) (Section 3.1.1 ) instead distills a specialist’s recoveries from the generalist’s own deployment states back into the generalist. The useful output in both cases is data that cover a task, a state, or a correction that the next learner would otherwise lack.
paragraphs.zh: 当经验被收集并判定后，该流程必须决定下一次更新从什么内容中学习：哪些保留数据、纠错信息、示范或教师输出，以及来自哪个模型。 下文的若干例子运行固定的流程并报告后续学习的收益；它们被列入此处，是因为它们改变了流程的训练数据的来源。 获得的能力首先改变了谁能够为下一个学习器提供证据。 在 RoboCat（Bousmalis 等，2024）（第 3.1.1 节）中，一个经过适配的专用模型为下一个通用模型收集数据；该研究展示了这种迁移的一个完整循环。 PLD（Xiao 等，2026a）（第 3.1.1 节）则是将专用模型在通用模型自身部署状态上的恢复动作蒸馏回通用模型。 两种情况中有用的输出都是覆盖某个任务、某个状态或某项纠错的数据，而这些内容是下一个学习器原本无法获得的。

paragraphs.en: Acquired competence can also lower the cost of later learning in roles other than physical collection: VLAW ( Guo et al., 2026 ) amplifies scarce real rollouts through a refreshed world model (below), ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026a ) avoids rediscovering a working program on a new robot API (Section 3.1.3 ), and CIDER ( Li et al., 2026d ) keeps earlier skills by reusing the accumulated policy as a teacher (Section 3.1.1 ). Verified solutions of coding agents can also become training data: EmbodiedSWE ( Shen et al., 2026 ) expands one simulated solution into diverse demonstrations for a VLA, which then completes a long-horizon task on a real robot, and HexaAnything ( Gao et al., 2026 ) trains a model on the verified execution traces of its own agent. Table 9 adds related cases from Sections 3.1 and 3.2 and lists, for each retained artifact, what is held fixed, the reported comparison and effort, and the scope of the result.
paragraphs.zh: 已获得的这类能力还能降低后续在其他角色中学习的成本：VLAW（Guo et al., 2026）通过一个持续刷新的世界模型（见下文）来放大稀缺的真实 rollout 数据，ASPIRE（Lu et al., 2026a）避免了在新的机器人 API 上重新发现一套可行的程序（第 3.1.3 节），而 CIDER（Li et al., 2026d）通过把已积累的策略作为教师加以复用来保留早先的技能（第 3.1.1 节）。 经验证的编程智能体解决方案也可以成为训练数据：EmbodiedSWE（Shen et al., 2026）把一个仿真中得到的解决方案扩展为面向 VLA 的多样演示，随后该 VLA 在真实机器人上完成了长时程任务，而 HexaAnything（Gao et al., 2026）则用其自身智能体经过验证的执行轨迹来训练模型。 表 9 汇总了来自第 3.1 节和第 3.2 节的相关案例，并针对每个被保留的成果列出所固定不变的因素、所报告的对比与工作量，以及该结果的适用范围。

paragraphs.en: A model that supplies training experience can itself be refreshed from new physical experience. VLAW ( Guo et al., 2026 ) returns both successful and failed rollouts to world-model training, alongside retained data from the DROID dataset ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , and fine-tunes a VLM-based reward model on first-round outcomes. The updated world model then generates closed-loop trajectories, and the VLA is trained on reward-filtered imagined successes together with real successes. Over two rounds and five real task categories, this full loop outperforms behavior cloning on filtered successes (Filtered BC) and DSRL while holding the number of physical rollouts fixed at fifty per category per round. Because model refresh, reward calibration, and synthetic data change together, the gain belongs to the pipeline as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 提供训练经验的模型本身可以通过新的物理经验得到更新。 VLAW（Guo et al., 2026）将成功和失败的 rollout 连同 DROID 数据集（Khazatsky et al., 2024）中保留的数据一并用于世界模型训练，并在第一轮结果上微调基于 VLM 的奖励模型。 更新后的世界模型随后生成闭环轨迹，VLA 则在经奖励过滤的想象成功与真实成功上训练。 在两轮和五个真实任务类别上，这一完整闭环在物理 rollout 数量固定为每类别每轮五十次的条件下，优于基于过滤成功的的行为克隆（Filtered BC）和 DSRL。 由于模型刷新、奖励校准和合成数据是同时变化的，这一增益属于整个流程整体。

paragraphs.en: Other systems refresh the practice model in the same way, and some isolate parts of the effect. World-VLA-Loop ( Liu et al., 2026g ) refits its video model and reward head on success and near-success rollouts of each new policy and restarts the policy from its fine-tuned starting point every round; on two real Franka tasks, two rounds raise success from 13.3% to 50.0% and from 26.7% to 53.3%, the second round adding 13.3 percentage points on both. WoVR ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) refits its world model on rollouts of the already improved policy and, at the same 2,500-trajectory budget in LIBERO, beats adding base-policy data by 5.0 percentage points; its real-robot gains were obtained without this refresh. WorldSample ( Xue et al., 2026b ) refits a video model on accumulating real rollouts and admits its synthetic transitions into critic training by value balance and policy entropy, reaching 82% average success on five real tasks against 56% for HIL-SERL with the same demonstrations. MeRL ( Li et al., 2026h ) measures how far its updated world model diverges from stored real continuations and uses that error to set how much imagined data enters each update, gaining 3.5 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO over the same simulator updated without this trust layer. RIWANav ( Xie et al., 2026a ) , which calls itself recursive self-improvement, lets the improved navigation policy choose which recorded action–video pairs refit its world model, adding 7.94 percentage points of success over a frozen world model on an offline urban-navigation benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 其他系统以同样的方式刷新实践模型，部分系统则隔离了其中部分效果。 World-VLA-Loop（Liu et al., 2026g）在每个新策略的成功与接近成功的 rollout 上重新拟合其视频模型和奖励头，并每轮从微调后的起点重启策略；在两个真实 Franka 任务上，两轮将成功率从 13.3% 提升到 50.0%，以及从 26.7% 提升到 53.3%，第二轮在两个任务上均增加了 13.3 个百分点。 WoVR（Jiang et al., 2026）在已有改进策略的 rollout 上重新拟合其世界模型，并在 LIBERO 中同样 2,500 条轨迹的预算下，比添加基策略数据高出 5.0 个百分点；其在真机上的收益是在没有这种刷新的情况下获得的。 WorldSample（Xue et al., 2026b）在持续累积的真实 rollout 上重新拟合视频模型，并通过价值平衡和策略熵将其合成转移数据纳入 critic 训练，在五个真实任务上以相同的演示达到 82% 的平均成功率，而 HIL-SERL 为 56%。 MeRL（Li et al., 2026h）度量其更新后的世界模型与存储的真实后续轨迹的偏离程度，并利用该误差设定每次更新中进入多少想象数据，在 LIBERO-PRO 上比没有这一信任层的同一模拟器更新方式高出 3.5 个百分点。 RIWANav（Xie et al., 2026a）自称实现了递归自我改进，让改进后的导航策略选择哪些记录的动作—视频对用于重新拟合其世界模型，在一个离线城市导航基准上比冻结世界模型高出 7.94 个百分点的成功率。

paragraphs.en: Corrective actions can also come from outside the robot: dynamics models learned from human video propose them at failed states, and training on them raises success on seven real tasks across two robots from 40% to 81% ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . A fixed multimodal agent can serve as that outside teacher in a recurring loop: Local Recovery Supervision ( Zhang et al., 2026k ) audits each round’s policy for unresolved failures, has the agent generate recovery demonstrations at those states, and trains the policy that drives the next round of collection. In a preliminary simulated study on LIBERO-Goal, recovery-augmented post-training of a π 0 \pi_{0} checkpoint succeeds in 88 of 100 validation scenes, against 78 for continuing on the original data with the same additional optimization steps.
paragraphs.zh: 纠正性动作也可以来自机器人之外：从人类视频中学到的动力学模型会在失败状态处提出这些动作，而在这些动作上进行训练，将两台机器人上七项真实任务的成功率从 40% 提升至 81%（Chen et al., 2026b）。 一个固定的多模态智能体可以在循环往复的流程中充当那个外部教师：局部恢复监督（Zhang et al., 2026k）审计每一轮策略中未解决的失败，让该智能体在这些状态处生成恢复示范，然后训练策略以驱动下一轮的数据收集。 在 LIBERO-Goal 上的初步模拟研究中，对 π 0 \pi_{0} 检查点进行恢复增强的后训练，在 100 个验证场景中成功 88 个，而在相同额外优化步数下继续在原始数据上训练则为 78 个。
