paragraphs.en: Selection also applies to experience that has already been retained, as when Memory Anchors ( Du et al., 2026 ) (Section 3.1.1 ) enriches replay with selected old transitions. Criticality-guided sampling (Section 3.2.1 ) asks where new learning is most needed; Memory Anchors asks which earlier distinctions must remain visible while that learning occurs. Together they expose a trade-off between learning new behavior and keeping old behavior, one that the simpler instruction to “collect hard cases” hides.
paragraphs.zh: 选择同样适用于已被保留的经验，例如记忆锚点（Du et al., 2026）（第 3.1.1 节）通过被选中的旧转移来丰富重放。 临界性引导的采样（第 3.2.1 节）追问新学习最需要发生在哪里；记忆锚点则追问在该学习进行时，哪些更早的区分必须保持可见。 二者共同揭示了一种在学习新行为与保留旧行为之间的权衡，而「收集困难样本」这一更简单的指令恰恰掩盖了这种权衡。

paragraphs.en: Which gap matters also depends on the component that receives the data, as a world-model example shows. ConfAL-WM ( Liu et al., 2026f ) uses a confidence probe to allocate the post-training data budget of a world model across tasks, sampling episodes at random within each task, and gives larger training weight to frames and image patches where the model is least reliable. Under a fixed budget of selected data on the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark ( Chen et al., 2025c ) , confidence-guided selection improves scene consistency and trajectory metrics, and confidence weighting improves reconstruction, relative to alternative acquisition scores. Whether the same samples most improve control is a different question, since a transition that is informative about visual prediction may differ from one that supplies the policy with a missing action.
paragraphs.zh: 哪种差距重要还取决于接收数据的组件，一个世界模型的例子可以说明这一点。 ConfAL-WM（Liu et al., 2026f）使用一个置信度探针来为世界模型的训练后数据预算在各个任务之间进行分配，在每个任务内随机采样片段，并在模型最不可靠的帧和图像块上给予更大的训练权重。 在 RoboTwin 2.0 基准（Chen et al., 2025c）上固定所选数据预算的条件下，相对于其他获取评分，置信度引导的选择改善了场景一致性和轨迹指标，而置信度加权改善了重建效果。 同样的样本是否最能提升控制是另一个问题，因为一个对视觉预测有信息量的转移，可能与一个能为策略提供缺失动作的转移有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Rollouts can also decide which demonstrations to keep. Demo-SCORE ( Chen et al., 2025a ) trains a success classifier on the robot’s rollouts and removes demonstrations that resemble failures. On real ALOHA tasks, this improves success by about 30 percentage points on average over training on all demonstrations. CUPID ( Agia et al., 2025 ) attributes closed-loop outcomes to individual demonstrations with influence functions and raises success on a real Franka task from 44% to 84% with 25 curation rollouts. Both curate once rather than as the policy changes. A model can also generate or vet its own training data. LACY ( Hong et al., 2026b ) uses one VLM to map language to actions, describe actions back, and judge their agreement, and filters its own generated data with that judge. RSI-Nav ( Li et al., 2026f ) , described as data-centric recursive self-improvement, writes instructions for unlabeled trajectories, keeps those it can follow to the goal, and retrains before labeling the next shard. With about 2.5M generated samples, it raises simulated R2R-CE success from 52.9% to 68.6%. RE-0 ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) admits a stronger teacher’s code patches into a student’s training data only when paired rollouts from the same simulator snapshot show a gain, which lifts robosuite restacking from 4/50 to 31/50. Its ablations credit the admitted patches rather than the weighting of its distillation loss: on restacking, success-filtered teacher demonstrations stay at the base level, and on a lifting task the paired admission rule beats unfiltered and sign-only selection in every trainer seed.
paragraphs.zh: Rollout 还可以决定保留哪些演示。 Demo-SCORE（Chen et al., 2025a）在机器人的 rollout 上训练一个成功分类器，并移除与失败相似的演示。 在真实的 ALOHA 任务上，与使用所有演示训练相比，这种方法平均将成功率提高约 30 个百分点。 CUPID（Agia et al., 2025）利用影响函数将闭环结果归因到单个演示，仅用 25 条筛选性 rollout 就将一个真实 Franka 任务的成功率从 44% 提升到 84%。 这两种方法都只做一次性筛选，而不是随策略变化持续筛选。 模型也可以生成或审查自己的训练数据。 LACY（Hong et al., 2026b）使用一个 VLM 将语言映射为动作、把动作描述回语言并判断两者是否一致，再用该评判器过滤自己生成的数据。 RSI-Nav（Li et al., 2026f）被称为以数据为中心的递归自我改进，它为无标注轨迹撰写指令，保留那些自己能据此到达目标的指令，并在标注下一个数据分片之前先重新训练。 在约 250 万条生成样本的规模下，它将仿真中 R2R-CE 的成功率从 52.9% 提升到 68.6%。 RE-0（Zhang et al., 2026e）只有在来自同一仿真器快照的成对 rollout 显示出提升时，才允许将更强教师模型的代码补丁纳入学生模型的训练数据，这将 robosuite 重新堆叠任务的成功率从 4/50 提升到 31/50。 其消融实验将效果归功于被纳入的补丁本身，而非其蒸馏损失的加权方式：在重新堆叠任务上，经成功过滤的教师演示仍停留在基线水平；在一个搬举任务上，成对准入规则在所有训练随机种子下都优于未过滤和仅看符号的筛选方式。

paragraphs.en: These later-learning benefits do not require the robot to learn how to revise its learning procedure; often a fixed collection, filtering, or distillation recipe performs the transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 这些后续学习的收益并不要求机器人学习如何修改其学习过程；通常，一组固定的收集、过滤或蒸馏方案即可完成这种迁移。

paragraphs.en: Once the data and supervision for an update are chosen, the update itself is usually still computed by a fixed rule. A further step is to change the procedure that produces the update. We use updater for a procedure that maps the learner’s current state, experience, and objective to an operation such as a parameter step, a loss function, an edit to a skill library, or a code patch. Section 2.3 reviews precedents that learn initializations, losses, and update rules, mostly in computation. Robot data have already trained part of an update mechanism. Meier et al. (2018) learn online a memory of learning rates that scales the gradient steps of inverse-dynamics models on a real Kuka LWR IV arm. They reuse it as the payload changes from none to light and heavy and reach lower prediction error early in each task. The memory’s own learning rule stays fixed, however, and the gain is measured in model error rather than in control. Here we follow updaters that act on robot learners and their artifacts. AdaRSI ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , named for on-demand recursive self-improvement, decides where an update should go. A coding agent first refines its harness and fine-tunes the executor only on sub-steps that stay unreliable after retries from saved states. In RoboCasa365 simulation, this raises unseen composite-task success from 4.6% to 13.8%, slightly above fine-tuning every sub-step (12.6%) at 28% of its GPU time. Its agent also writes, from pilot tasks, an experience document and a training budget that guide later tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦为一次更新选定了数据和监督信号，更新本身通常仍由固定规则计算得出。 更进一步的做法是改变产生更新的过程。 我们用「更新器」指代这样一种过程：它将学习器的当前状态、经验和目标映射为某种操作，例如一次参数步进、一个损失函数、对技能库的一次编辑，或一个代码补丁。 第 2.3 节回顾了学习初始化、损失和更新规则的先例，这些工作大多在计算领域。 机器人数据已经被用于训练部分更新机制。Meier 等人 （2018）在线学习了一个学习率记忆，用于缩放真实 Kuka LWR IV 机械臂上逆动力学模型的梯度步长。 当负载从无负载变为轻负载和重负载时，他们复用该记忆，并在每个任务的早期阶段取得更低的预测误差。 然而，该记忆自身的学习规则保持固定，且其收益是以模型误差而非控制性能来衡量的。 在此，我们关注作用于机器人学习器及其产物的更新器。 AdaRSI（Wang et al., 2026d）得名于按需递归自我改进，它决定更新应该作用于何处。 一个编码智能体先完善其运行环境，然后仅在那些从保存状态重试后仍不可靠的子步骤上微调执行器。 在 RoboCasa365 仿真中，这将未见复合任务的成功率从 4.6% 提升到 13.8%，略高于微调所有子步骤的结果（12.6%），但只用了其 28% 的 GPU 时间。 其智能体还会根据试点任务撰写一份经验文档和一份训练预算，用以指导后续任务。

paragraphs.en: PRACTICE ( Bai et al., 2026 ) instantiates a related idea for an external skill library. Given trajectories and the current library, its learned editor can add, revise, merge, or remove skill entries, while a frozen executor uses the resulting library. The editor’s training progresses from successful oracle trajectories, through paired success and failure examples, to on-policy distillation from a stronger frozen teacher on the student’s own editing contexts. On the simulated EB-ALFRED household tasks from EmbodiedBench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , the failure-aware stage reaches 45.3% average success, compared with 42.7% for a control trained only on successes, supporting the value of failures for training the editor. The broader gains across stages are harder to attribute, because the editor, its training data, and the accumulated library change together. What has improved is the editor; the executor, the external teacher, and the staged procedure that trains the editor all remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: PRACTICE（Bai 等，2026）将一个相关思路实现于外部技能库。 给定轨迹和当前技能库，其训练得到的编辑器可以添加、修改、合并或删除技能条目，而一个冻结的执行器使用由此产生的技能库。 该编辑器的训练从成功的预言轨迹开始，经过成对的成功与失败示例，再到在学生自身编辑情境上从更强的冻结教师进行在策略蒸馏。 在 EmbodiedBench（Yang 等，2025）的模拟 EB-ALFRED 家务任务上，失败感知阶段达到 45.3% 的平均成功率，而仅在成功样本上训练的对照组为 42.7%，这支持了失败样本对训练编辑器的价值。 跨阶段的更广泛收益则难以归因，因为编辑器、其训练数据和累积的技能库是共同变化的。 得到改进的是编辑器；执行器、外部教师以及训练编辑器的分阶段流程都保持固定。

sents.en: PRACTICE ( Bai et al., 2026 ) instantiates a related idea for an external skill library.
sents.zh: PRACTICE（Bai 等，2026）将一个相关思路实现于外部技能库。

sents.en: Given trajectories and the current library, its learned editor can add, revise, merge, or remove skill entries, while a frozen executor uses the resulting library.
sents.zh: 给定轨迹和当前技能库，其训练得到的编辑器可以添加、修改、合并或删除技能条目，而一个冻结的执行器使用由此产生的技能库。

sents.en: The editor’s training progresses from successful oracle trajectories, through paired success and failure examples, to on-policy distillation from a stronger frozen teacher on the student’s own editing contexts.
sents.zh: 该编辑器的训练从成功的预言轨迹开始，经过成对的成功与失败示例，再到在学生自身编辑情境上从更强的冻结教师进行在策略蒸馏。

sents.en: On the simulated EB-ALFRED household tasks from EmbodiedBench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , the failure-aware stage reaches 45.3% average success, compared with 42.7% for a control trained only on successes, supporting the value of failures for training the editor.
sents.zh: 在 EmbodiedBench（Yang 等，2025）的模拟 EB-ALFRED 家务任务上，失败感知阶段达到 45.3% 的平均成功率，而仅在成功样本上训练的对照组为 42.7%，这支持了失败样本对训练编辑器的价值。

sents.en: The broader gains across stages are harder to attribute, because the editor, its training data, and the accumulated library change together.
sents.zh: 跨阶段的更广泛收益则难以归因，因为编辑器、其训练数据和累积的技能库是共同变化的。

sents.en: What has improved is the editor; the executor, the external teacher, and the staged procedure that trains the editor all remain fixed.
sents.zh: 得到改进的是编辑器；执行器、外部教师以及训练编辑器的分阶段流程都保持固定。

paragraphs.en: When the value of a proposed change can only be established through robot interaction, constructing updates becomes inseparable from safe execution, resets, measurement, and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 当拟议变更的价值只能通过与机器人交互来确立时，构建更新就与安全执行、重置、测量和恢复密不可分。

paragraphs.en: An updater can propose a new policy, loss, or training routine, but a physical system can judge that proposal only by running another experiment. Each candidate must begin from a known state, remain within safety limits, be deployed under recorded conditions, and receive an outcome that is sufficiently independent of the code being tested. Resets make successive trials comparable; verification supplies the selection signal; and logging connects a measured change to the hypothesis that produced it. These services belong to the learning loop itself.
paragraphs.zh: 更新器可以提出新的策略、损失函数或训练流程，但物理系统只能通过运行另一次实验来评判该提案。 每个候选方案必须从已知状态开始，保持在安全限制之内，在记录在案的条件下部署，并接收一个与被测代码充分独立的结果。 重置使 successive 试验具有可比性；验证提供选择信号；日志将测量到的变化与产生该变化的假设联系起来。 这些服务属于学习循环本身。

paragraphs.en: ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026b ) instantiates this loop for research on robot policies. In a human-guided construction stage, coding agents build task-specific services for safety, resets, and verification. The finalized services are then exposed as interfaces that cannot be modified, while coding agents revise the permitted training infrastructure or policy code, launch robot rollouts, inspect trajectories and videos, and retain or abandon hypotheses based on the resulting measurements. This covers more of the research process than executing a fixed fine-tuning script, while keeping the main outcome check outside the policy code that can be changed. Its autonomy still depends on the supplied task objective, demonstrations, hardware, and interface boundaries, and a misspecified verifier could consistently select the wrong revision.
paragraphs.zh: ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026b）在机器人策略研究中实例化了这一循环。 在人类引导的构建阶段，编码智能体构建面向特定任务的安全、重置和验证服务。 最终确定的服务随后被暴露为不可修改的接口，而编码智能体可以修改允许的训练基础设施或策略代码、启动机器人执行、检查轨迹和视频，并根据由此得到的测量结果保留或放弃假设。 这比执行固定的微调脚本覆盖了研究流程的更多部分，同时把主要结果检验保持在可被更改的策略代码之外。 其自主性仍然依赖于所提供的任务目标、演示、硬件和接口边界，而一个设定不当的验证器可能会持续选择错误的修改。

sents.zh: ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026b）在机器人策略研究中实例化了这一循环。

paragraphs.en: ENPIRE studies two ways to extend a single experimental loop. Running more agent–robot pairs in parallel buys throughput at a resource cost; whether it also improves the updater is a separate question. In a separate transfer, agents distill their search on a pin-insertion task into a written summary and append it to the instructions for a GPU-insertion task, while removing prior trajectories, logs, and checkpoints. The result shows that procedural knowledge can be carried between related experiments; measuring how much that knowledge improves the later search would need a matched run without the summary.
paragraphs.zh: ENPIRE 研究了扩展单个实验循环的两种方式。 并行运行更多智能体–机器人组合能以资源成本换取吞吐量；这是否也能改进更新器则是另一个问题。 在另一项迁移中，智能体将其在针插入任务上的搜索蒸馏成一份书面总结，并将其附加到 GPU 插入任务的说明中，同时移除先前的轨迹、日志和检查点。 结果表明程序性知识可以在相关实验之间传递；要衡量这些知识对后续搜索的提升程度，需要一次没有该总结的对照运行。

sents.en: ENPIRE studies two ways to extend a single experimental loop.

paragraphs.en: Agents increasingly run the training pipeline itself. In simulation, a coding agent ran more than 70 quadruped-locomotion experiments in fourteen waves under human high-level direction ( Khandelwal and Gupta, 2026 ) . HARBOR ( Li et al., 2026i ) stages simulator setup, reward design, and tuning through gated sub-agents and appends distilled lessons to an experience memory, reaching 0.885 success on three-cube stacking in IsaacLab where Eureka and REvolve reach 0.0 under the same model and wall-clock budget. AURA ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) has language-model agents write staged curricula that specify rewards, domain randomization, and PPO settings, trains each stage in MJX simulation, and refines the next stage from its analysis, retrieving earlier curricula and feedback from a database; its hardware deployment on a custom humanoid is reported qualitatively. RoboClaw ( Li et al., 2026e ) pairs each forward manipulation with an inverse recovery behavior so that a dual-arm mobile manipulator can reset itself and keep collecting data, while one VLM agent coordinates collection, policy learning, and execution. It reports about 25% higher long-horizon success than its baselines, without stating whether the gain is absolute. It also reports that a manual baseline needs about 2.16 times its human time for the same amount of data. The RoboCoach system ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , unrelated to the world-model coach of Section 3.2.1 , pairs a coding agent with a video-reading feedback agent: on RoboCoach-Bench, a set of 32 simulated tasks, the seven-model mean success reaches 0.730 against 0.602 for expert codebases, and on four real tasks in two laboratories the resulting policies reach 0.68 against 0.51 for matched human configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体越来越多地运行训练流水线本身。 在仿真中，一个编程智能体在人类高层指导下，分十四波运行了超过70个四足运动实验（Khandelwal and Gupta, 2026）。 HARBOR（Li et al., 2026i）通过带门控的子智能体分阶段完成仿真器搭建、奖励设计与调参，并将提炼出的经验追加到经验记忆中，在IsaacLab的三立方体堆叠任务上达到0.885的成功率，而在相同的模型和时钟时间预算下，Eureka和REvolve为0.0。 AURA（Zhu et al., 2025a）让语言模型智能体编写分阶段的课程，指定奖励、域随机化和PPO设置，在MJX仿真中训练每个阶段，并根据其分析细化下一阶段，从数据库中检索更早的课程和反馈；其在定制人形机器人上的硬件部署只有定性报告。 RoboClaw（Li et al., 2026e）为每次前向操作配对一个逆向恢复行为，使双臂移动操作臂能够自我复位并持续采集数据，同时由一个VLM智能体协调数据采集、策略学习与执行。 它报告称长时程成功率比其基线高约25%，但未说明该提升是绝对值。 它还报告，为获取等量数据，人工基线需要约2.16倍于其的人类时间。 RoboCoach系统（Lei et al., 2026）与3.2.1节的世界模型教练无关，它将一个编程智能体与一个读取视频的反馈智能体配对：在RoboCoach-Bench（一组32个仿真任务）上，七个模型的平均成功率达到0.730，而专家代码库为0.602；在两个实验室的四个真实任务上，所得策略达到0.68，而匹配的人类配置为0.51。

paragraphs.en: Two studies measure what such loops still need. An agentic loop with evidence-gated promotion ( Yu, 2026 ) cuts false promotions in LIBERO-10 simulation to 0.001 per run. Yet on its one measured lineage, its selections trail simply taking the final checkpoint (about 50–54% against 60% held-out success). Coding agents in RLE-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) likewise gain on the development evaluations they can query but lose verifier score on hidden robustness perturbations in simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 两项研究衡量了此类循环仍欠缺什么。 一种采用证据门控晋升的智能体循环（Yu, 2026）将 LIBERO-10 仿真中的错误晋升率降至每次运行 0.001。 然而在其唯一测量的谱系上，其选择落后于简单地取最终检查点（约 50–54% 对 60% 的保留集成功率）。 RLE-Bench 中的编程智能体（Ma et al., 2026）同样在其可查询的开发评估上获得提升，但在仿真中面对隐藏的鲁棒性扰动时验证器得分下降。

paragraphs.en: EndoRSI ( Ng et al., 2026 ) brings a human-governed coding agent to an endoscopic robot: benchtop phantom trials rejected an insertion strategy that offline data had supported, and benchtop insertion success rose from 2/21 to 17/21 over four generations of revised policies.
paragraphs.zh: EndoRSI（Ng et al., 2026）将一个由人类监督的编码智能体应用于内窥镜机器人：台架模型试验否决了一种离线数据曾支持的插入策略，并且经过四代修订策略后，台架插入成功率从 2/21 提升至 17/21。

paragraphs.en: Neighboring fields have automated other parts of the experimental loop. The AI Scientist ( Lu et al., 2024 ) automates proposal, execution, analysis, and reporting in digital experiments. Robotic chemistry closes a physical loop within more structured apparatus: a mobile robotic chemist ( Burger et al., 2020 ) and the A-Lab ( Szymanski et al., 2023 ) select experiments, manipulate materials, and incorporate measured synthesis or characterization outcomes, while Coscientist ( Boiko et al., 2023 ) adds planning and tool use by a language model. Across these settings, a reusable finding requires the candidate version, initial conditions, operating configuration, measurements, and failed trials to remain attributable.
paragraphs.zh: 邻近领域已经实现了实验循环其他环节的自动化。 The AI Scientist（Lu 等，2024）实现了数字实验中提案、执行、分析和报告的自动化。 机器人化学在结构化程度更高的装置中闭合了物理循环：移动机器人化学家（Burger 等，2020）和 A-Lab（Szymanski 等，2023）能够选择实验、操作材料，并将测得的合成或表征结果纳入其中，而 Coscientist（Boiko 等，2023）则增加了语言模型的规划与工具使用能力。 在这些场景中，一项可复用的发现要求候选版本、初始条件、运行配置、测量结果和失败试验都保持可追溯性。

paragraphs.en: This section discusses mechanisms through which an improver could improve and the evidence offered for them. An improver’s knowledge may reside in weights, retrieved memory, code, or prompts (Section 2.2 ). After stating what would count as improvement, we group mechanisms by where that knowledge lives.
paragraphs.zh: 本节讨论改进者可以通过哪些机制进行改进，以及为这些机制提供的证据。 改进者的知识可能存在于权重、检索到的记忆、代码或提示中（见 2.2 节）。 在阐明什么才算作改进之后，我们根据这些知识所在的位置对各种机制进行分类。

sents.en: This section discusses mechanisms through which an improver could improve and the evidence offered for them.
sents.zh: 本节讨论改进者可以通过哪些机制进行改进，以及为这些机制提供的证据。

sents.zh: 改进者的知识可能存在于权重、检索到的记忆、代码或提示中（见 2.2 节）。

sents.en: After stating what would count as improvement, we group mechanisms by where that knowledge lives.
sents.zh: 在阐明什么才算作改进之后，我们根据这些知识所在的位置对各种机制进行分类。

paragraphs.en: As Section 2.2 notes, successively better procedures can come from a fixed outer searcher. One example is a loop that its authors call policy-level recursive self-improvement: a criticality model updated from each round’s outcomes guides the next collection, but the update rule stays fixed ( He et al., 2026a ) . An improver can also revise its own selection rules, such as how strict its admission gate is or which failures it debugs next; such a change alters the procedure that improves the system, yet it counts toward recursion only if the revised rules produce better later revisions than the earlier ones.
paragraphs.zh: 正如第 2.2 节所述，越来越好的流程可以来自一个固定的外层搜索器。 一个例子是其作者称为策略级递归自我改进的循环：由每一轮的结果更新的关键性模型指导下一轮的收集，但更新规则保持固定（He et al., 2026a）。 改进器还可以修订它自己的选择规则，例如它的准入门槛有多严格，或接下来调试哪些失败；这样的改变会改动改进系统的流程，但只有当修订后的规则能产生比之前修订更好的后续修订时，它才算作递归。

paragraphs.en: The missed grasp illustrates the difference between procedure improvement and recursion. Suppose a rollout reveals a visual signature of slip in an attempt that the reward program scored as a success. Using that signature to correct the reward and training a better policy under it would demonstrate procedure improvement. Here the reward program belongs to the learning procedure, the editor that writes it is the improver, and the records it keeps from such edits are its repair knowledge. The recursive route must also retain which failure distinction motivated the edit, under what conditions the edit was valid, and whether the downstream learner benefited. Those records could revise the reward editor’s parameters, retrieval memory, or rule-selection policy. The first link is present if the revised editor’s rewards for new failures teach matched learners better than the earlier editor’s rewards do. The second link is present if, given the same new repair histories, a revision of the editor proposed with what it has learned outperforms both the unrevised editor and a revision of the same editor proposed with that knowledge frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 这次抓取失败说明了过程改进与递归之间的区别。 假设一次 rollout 展现出某种滑脱的视觉特征，而这次尝试被奖励程序评定为成功。 利用该特征来修正奖励，并在其下训练出更好的策略，这就体现了过程改进。 在这里，奖励程序属于学习过程，编写它的编辑器是改进者，而它从这类编辑中保留的记录就是其修复知识。 递归路径还必须保留是哪种失败区别促成了这次编辑、该编辑在何种条件下有效，以及下游学习者是否从中受益。 这些记录可以用来修订奖励编辑器的参数、检索记忆或规则选择策略。 如果修订后的编辑器对新失败给出的奖励比先前编辑器的奖励能更好地教导匹配的学习者，则第一条链路成立。 如果在相同的新的修复历史条件下，利用编辑器所学内容提出的编辑器修订版本，既优于未修订的编辑器，也优于在知识被冻结的情况下对同一编辑器提出的修订版本，则第二条链路成立。

paragraphs.en: The test leaves room for people and fixed machinery: human-specified goals, a fixed experiment runner, and an independently controlled safety boundary may remain in place. What must be traced is the source of the useful revision. If the gains came only from more trials, compute, or human assistance, a frozen-knowledge control given the same resources would match the updated version.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试为人员和固定设备留出了空间：人类指定的目标、固定的实验执行器，以及独立受控的安全边界可以保留在原处。 必须追溯的是有用修订的来源。 如果收益仅来自更多的试验、算力或人类协助，那么在给定相同资源的情况下，一个知识冻结的对照版本将能与更新后的版本相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Against this standard, the physical systems covered by this review offer mechanisms and uncontrolled results for R1. We have not found sufficient evidence that freezes the acquired revision knowledge, matches the conditions of later learning, and isolates an R1 gain on new failures (Sections 4.1 and 4.4 ); the closest results, described next, come from simulation and do not yet meet all three conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 以此标准衡量，本综述所涵盖的物理系统为 R1 提供了机制与未受控的结果。 我们尚未找到足以证明以下点的证据：冻结已习得的修正知识、匹配后续学习的条件，并在新的失败上分离出 R1 增益（第 4.1 节和第 4.4 节）；下文所述的最接近的结果来自仿真，尚未同时满足这三个条件。

paragraphs.en: Several systems already keep records of earlier revisions and consult them when revising again, which places knowledge in the improver’s memory. AdaRSI’s ( Wang et al., 2026d ) coding agent writes, after pilot tasks, an experience document recording which sub-steps benefited from training and how much data sufficed, together with a training budget, and both guide later tasks (Section 3.2.4 ). HARBOR ( Li et al., 2026i ) distills recurring patterns from tuning rounds into an experience memory that later reward design and tuning retrieve (Section 3.2.5 ). Drawing on its accumulated experience in a separate run, it redesigns the reward for simulated three-cube stacking in 30 minutes rather than 4 hours, but on the same task and without a frozen-memory control; its ablation without experience removes templates, references, and heuristics, so the contribution of the lessons it accumulates on its own is not separated. AURA ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) stores earlier curricula, metrics, and human feedback in a database that conditions later curriculum, reward, and training-configuration generation (Section 3.2.5 ); without the database, the share of its generated curricula that launch training in simulation falls from 99% to 38% with GPT-4.1, but what AURA acquired itself is not separated from the human feedback. EmbodiedRSI ( Song et al., 2026b ) learns which memories to keep according to their value for later improvement (Section 3.2.1 ); on unseen RoboCasa365 composite tasks in simulation, this learned rule reaches 71.3% success against 61.7% for retrieval-based selection, a comparison of memory rules rather than of acquired knowledge. ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026b ) carries a written summary of one search into the instructions for a related task (Section 3.2.5 ). In each case the improver’s knowledge changes; what remains to be shown is that this change, rather than added trials, compute, or human input, makes the next procedure better.
paragraphs.zh: 一些系统已经保存早期修订版本的记录，并在再次修订时加以参考，这将知识置于改进者的记忆之中。 AdaRSI（Wang et al., 2026d）的智能体在试点任务之后撰写一份经验文档，记录哪些子步骤受益于训练以及多少数据足够，并附上训练预算，二者共同指导后续任务（第 3.2.4 节）。 HARBOR（Li et al., 2026i）从多轮调优中提炼出反复出现的模式，存入一个经验记忆，供后续的奖励设计与调优检索使用（第 3.2.5 节）。 在另一次运行中借助其积累的经验，它在 30 分钟而非 4 小时内为仿真中的三立方体堆叠重新设计了奖励，但任务相同且没有冻结记忆的对照；其去除经验的消融实验同时移除了模板、参考和启发式规则，因此它自身积累的经验教训的贡献并未被分离出来。 AURA（Zhu et al., 2025a）将早期的课程、指标和人类反馈存储在一个数据库中，该数据库为后续的课程、奖励和训练配置生成提供条件（第 3.2.5 节）；若没有该数据库，在使用 GPT-4.1 时，其生成的课程中能启动仿真训练的比例会从 99% 降至 38%，但 AURA 自身习得的内容与人类反馈并未被区分开。 EmbodiedRSI（Song et al., 2026b）根据记忆对后续改进的价值来学习保留哪些记忆（第 3.2.1 节）；在仿真中未见过的 RoboCasa365 复合任务上，这一习得的规则达到 71.3% 的成功率，而基于检索的选择为 61.7%，这是记忆规则之间的比较，而非对习得知识的比较。 ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026b）将一次搜索的书面总结带入相关任务的指令中（第 3.2.5 节）。 在每个案例中，改进者的知识都发生了变化；尚待证明的是，正是这一变化——而非额外的试验、算力或人类输入——使下一次流程变得更好。

paragraphs.en: Two kinds of reuse sit close to R1 without reaching it. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026a ) retrieves guidance from earlier program repairs, and the code-transfer study ( Kuroki and Tang, 2026 ) supplies optimized programs as references; both improve how a fixed coding model constructs later task controllers (Section 3.1.3 ), which is evidence about constructing behavior rather than about revising collection, supervision, or updates. LMPC ( Liang et al., 2024 ) trains the model that writes reward code for a model-predictive controller on past teaching sessions, so that teaching needs fewer turns. In simulation, a successful session on unseen tasks takes 1.9 rather than 2.4 chat turns (Section 2.3 ). That reward code drives real-time control rather than an RL training run, and the recipe that trains the model stays fixed. HarnessPAI’s ( Wang et al., 2026g ) growing library of failure-to-repair notes plays the role of ASPIRE’s guidance for its program writer: in simulation, three LIBERO-Object tasks reach full success within two rounds with the library rather than several without it, but no frozen-library comparison on new failures separates what the writer has gained (Section 3.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 有两类复用与 R1 相近但未达到它。 ASPIRE（Lu et al., 2026a）从早期的程序修复中检索指导，而代码迁移研究（Kuroki and Tang, 2026）提供优化的程序作为参考；二者都改进固定的编程模型构建后续任务控制器的方式（第 3.1.3 节），这是关于构建行为的证据，而非关于修订集合、监督或更新的证据。 LMPC（Liang et al., 2024）在过去的教学会话上训练为模型预测控制器编写奖励代码的模型，从而使教学所需轮次更少。 在仿真中，在未见任务上一次成功的会话需要 1.9 而非 2.4 个对话轮次（第 2.3 节）。 该奖励代码驱动实时控制而非强化学习训练过程，且训练模型的方案保持固定。 HarnessPAI（Wang et al., 2026g）不断增长的故障修复笔记库扮演了其程序编写者版的 ASPIRE 指导角色：在仿真中，有了该库，三个 LIBERO-Object 任务在两轮内达到完全成功，而没有它则需要多轮；但没有针对新故障的冻结库对比来区分编写者究竟获得了什么（第 3.1.3 节）。

sents.en: Two kinds of reuse sit close to R1 without reaching it.
sents.zh: 有两类复用与 R1 相近但未达到它。

sents.zh: HarnessPAI（Wang et al., 2026g）不断增长的故障修复笔记库扮演了其程序编写者版的 ASPIRE 指导角色：在仿真中，有了该库，三个 LIBERO-Object 任务在两轮内达到完全成功，而没有它则需要多轮；但没有针对新故障的冻结库对比来区分编写者究竟获得了什么（第 3.1.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: PhysEvo ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , which its authors describe as physical recursive self-improvement, keeps a single frozen model but lets a meta-agent revise the task agent’s tools and skills and also its own diagnostic tools. In simulation it reaches 62.0% on held-out RoboDojo layouts, an equal-weight average over five capability dimensions, against 47.2% computed from public evaluation records for the strongest published comparison; on a real arm it succeeds in 84% of 25 trials while skill revision continues. It is the clearest physical case of an improver that edits its own instruments; the comparison that would attribute part of the gain to those edits, the same meta-agent with its diagnostic tools frozen, remains to be run.
paragraphs.zh: PhysEvo（Tian 等，2026）被其作者描述为物理递归自我改进，它保持单个冻结模型不变，但允许一个元智能体修订任务智能体的工具与技能，同时也修订其自身的诊断工具。 在仿真中，它在留出的 RoboDojo 布局上达到 62.0%，这是对五个能力维度的等权平均，相比之下，根据公开评测记录计算得到的最强已发表对比方法为 47.2%；在真实机械臂上，它在 25 次试验中取得 84% 的成功率，且技能修订仍在持续进行。 它是一个改进者编辑自身工具的最清晰的物理案例；而能将部分收益归因于这些编辑的对比实验——即同一元智能体但其诊断工具被冻结——仍有待进行。

paragraphs.en: Admission rules are another instrument an improver uses. When an optimizer agent revises a robot agent’s harness in simulated LIBERO tasks, a champion–challenger rule avoids the degradation that accepting every revision causes ( Wei et al., 2026b ) . RegenHarness ( Wang et al., 2026b ) forbids its updater to weaken its own acceptance rule. In both cases the designers set the admission rule, so these results show which instrument an improver should use rather than an improver that improves it. MEMENTO ( Sygkounas et al., 2026 ) evolves its rollout evaluator once before policy search, and VeriFine ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) revises its judge’s rubric with human calibration (Section 3.2.2 ); both change an instrument through a fixed process, which places them at procedure improvement unless the process that revises the instrument itself improves. STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) is the digital reference point for such self-application. It applies a language-model-driven improver program to itself; with GPT-4, the self-improved improver raises held-out performance over a few rounds and transfers to new tasks without further optimization, whereas weaker models degrade, and the authors note that the unchanged language model makes this less than full recursive self-improvement. SICA ( Robeyns et al., 2025 ) removes the split between meta-agent and target agent: the best agent so far edits its own codebase, and in one fifteen-iteration run with Claude 3.5 Sonnet, peak accuracy on a fixed 50-question SWE-bench Verified subset rose from 17% to 53%, with the same benchmarks used for selection and for reporting. A fixed base agent that makes every edit is the control that would separate better task tools from a better editor. VERSE ( Wang et al., 2026k ) lets a harness optimizer revise its own prompts, skills, tools, and notes as well as the executor’s harness, with model weights fixed. In its controlled study on held-out SWE-rebench tasks (one run per condition), self-revision without execution-based checks produced no harness that beat the initial one on validation, whereas with such checks it reached 41.05% against 39.20% for a fixed optimizer and 39.81% for checks alone; revising the reviser helped only when its edits could be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 准入规则是改进者使用的另一种工具。 当优化智能体在模拟 LIBERO 任务中修改机器人智能体的 harness 时，冠军—挑战者规则避免了接受每一次修改所导致的性能退化（ Wei et al., 2026b ）。 RegenHarness（ Wang et al., 2026b ）禁止其更新器削弱自身的接受规则。 在这两种情况中，准入规则都是由设计者设定的，因此这些结果表明的是改进者应当使用哪种工具，而不是改进者改进该工具本身。 MEMENTO（ Sygkounas et al., 2026 ）在策略搜索之前对其 rollout 评估器进行一次演化，VeriFine（ Zhou et al., 2026b ）则通过人工校准修改其评判器的评分细则（Section 3.2.2 ）；两者都是通过固定流程改变工具，因此属于流程改进，除非修改该工具的流程本身也在改进。 STOP（ Zelikman et al., 2024 ）是这类自我应用的数字化参照点。 它将一个由语言模型驱动的改进者程序应用于自身；使用 GPT-4 时，自我改进后的改进者在几轮内提升了留出集上的性能，并且无需进一步优化即可迁移到新任务，而较弱的模型则出现退化；作者指出，由于语言模型本身未变，这还算不上完全的递归自我改进。 SICA（ Robeyns et al., 2025 ）取消了元智能体与目标智能体之间的划分：迄今最优的智能体编辑自己的代码库，在使用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的一次十五轮迭代运行中，固定 50 题 SWE-bench Verified 子集上的峰值准确率从 17% 升至 53%，且同一基准既用于选择也用于报告。 由一个固定的基础智能体完成所有编辑，正是能够区分“更好的任务工具”与“更好的编辑者”的对照设置。 VERSE（ Wang et al., 2026k ）允许 harness 优化器修改自身的提示词、技能、工具和笔记，以及执行器的 harness，模型权重保持不变。 在其针对留出 SWE-rebench 任务的对照研究（每种条件运行一次）中，没有基于执行的检查时，自我修订未产生任何在验证上超过初始版本的 harness；而有了这类检查后达到 41.05%，相比之下固定优化器为 39.20%，仅使用检查为 39.81%；只有当修订者的修改可以被测试时，修订修订者才有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: Predict Before You Modify ( Xie et al., 2026d ) adds to a self-modifying agent an editable model that predicts the outcome of each proposed modification and is revised from earlier modifications and their observed results; its robotics domain is quadruped reward design in the Genesis simulator, and its control with the predictor frozen, run on coding tasks, has bootstrap intervals that include zero.
paragraphs.zh: 在修改前先预测（Xie et al., 2026d）为自我修改的智能体增加了一个可编辑的模型，该模型可预测每项拟议修改的结果，并根据先前的修改及其观察到的结果进行修正；其机器人领域为 Genesis 模拟器中的四足机器人奖励设计，而在预测器冻结状态下运行于编码任务上的控制结果表明，其自助法（bootstrap）置信区间包含零。

paragraphs.en: R1 needs repair knowledge that transfers beyond the failures that produced it (Section 4.4 ), and the evidence so far concerns mostly task-level artifacts. ASPIRE carries guidance from simulated Franka repairs to a bimanual robot with a different API (Section 3.1.3 ), and ENPIRE’s written summary moves from pin insertion to GPU insertion on real robots without a matched control. A simulated study of 123 rounds of agentic skill discovery ( Wang, 2026 ) shows how accumulated revisions can stall: deployed changes kept passing their tests while the target task never succeeded. MC-EvoBench ( Song et al., 2026a ) sets out the controls a transfer claim needs: the target world and inventory are reset, only a declared artifact carries over, and related experience is compared with no-prior, unrelated, and shuffled sources at matched environment steps. In Minecraft, over five seeds, a memory-based agent showed no stable transfer, and related experience lowered stone-tool stage success from 0.150 to 0.050. Applying the frozen-knowledge comparison of Section 4.4 across failure families or robots remains to be run.
paragraphs.zh: R1 需要能迁移到产生该知识的失败之外的知识（见第 4.4 节），而目前的证据大多涉及任务层面的产物。 ASPIRE 将模拟 Franka 修复中获得的经验指导迁移到 API 不同的双臂机器人上（见第 3.1.3 节），而 ENPIRE 的书面总结从插针任务迁移到真实机器人上的 GPU 插入任务，且缺少匹配的对照组。 一项对 123 轮智能体技能发现的模拟研究（Wang, 2026）展示了累积修订如何陷入停滞：已部署的修改一直能通过各自的测试，而目标任务却始终未能成功。 MC-EvoBench（Song et al., 2026a）设定了迁移主张所需的对照条件：目标世界和物品栏被重置，只有声明的产物可以带入，并且在与先前经验相关的经历会在相同的环境步数下，与无先验、无关经验以及打乱来源的经验进行比较。 在 Minecraft 中，在五个随机种子上，一个基于记忆的智能体没有表现出稳定的迁移，而相关经验反而使石器阶段的成功率从 0.150 降至 0.050。 将第 4.4 节的冻结知识比较方法应用于不同失败类别或不同机器人上，仍有待实验验证。

paragraphs.en: R2 asks for the last step: the improver, once improved and using what it has acquired, must help produce a next version that is better than itself (Section 2.2 ). Digital systems supply the closest precedents, because executable tests make each candidate cheap to judge, while physical systems supply boundary cases; the gap between the two points to the paths ahead. In the physical systems covered by this review, we have not found a controlled comparison that isolates an R2 contribution; the closest controlled evidence comes from a simulated reward-design task in a digital system, discussed below.
paragraphs.zh: R2 要求最后一步：改进者在被改进并利用其所得之后，必须帮助产出一个优于自身的下一版本（见 2.2 节）。 数字系统提供了最接近的先例，因为可执行的测试使每个候选方案的成本低廉、易于评判，而物理系统则提供了边界情形；两者之间的差距指明了前方的路径。 在本综述所涵盖的物理系统中，我们尚未找到能分离出 R2 贡献的受控比较；最接近的受控证据来自数字系统中一个模拟的奖励设计任务，下文将予以讨论。

paragraphs.en: Digital systems also separate applying a fixed update recipe from making the updater itself an object of search. Expert Iteration ( Anthony et al., 2017 ) alternates tree search with training a network to imitate the search, then uses that network to guide the next search; STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) repeatedly generates rationales, keeps those that lead to correct answers, and fine-tunes on them. Both repeat a fixed loop. Promptbreeder ( Fernando et al., 2024 ) evolves both task prompts and the mutation prompts that change them. ADAS ( Hu et al., 2025b ) searches over agent designs written as code, and ALMA ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) searches over memory designs written as code and finds designs that outperform human-crafted ones in four sequential decision-making domains. AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) couples code proposals from language models to executable evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 数字系统还能把“应用固定的更新配方”与“让更新器本身成为搜索对象”分离开来。 专家迭代（Anthony et al., 2017）交替进行树搜索与训练网络来模仿该搜索，然后用该网络引导下一次搜索；STaR（Zelikman et al., 2022）反复生成推理依据，保留那些能得出正确答案的依据，并据此进行微调。 两者都重复一个固定的循环。 Promptbreeder（Fernando et al., 2024）同时演化任务提示词和用于改变它们的变异提示词。 ADAS（Hu et al., 2025b）在以代码形式编写的智能体设计上进行搜索，而 ALMA（Xiong et al., 2026）在以代码形式编写的记忆设计上进行搜索，并在四个序贯决策领域中找到了优于人工设计的方案。 AlphaEvolve（Novikov et al., 2025）将来自语言模型的代码提案与可执行的评估器相结合。

sents.zh: Promptbreeder（Fernando et al., 2024）同时演化任务提示词和用于改变它们的变异提示词。

sents.en: ADAS ( Hu et al., 2025b ) searches over agent designs written as code, and ALMA ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) searches over memory designs written as code and finds designs that outperform human-crafted ones in four sequential decision-making domains.
sents.zh: ADAS（Hu et al., 2025b）在以代码形式编写的智能体设计上进行搜索，而 ALMA（Xiong et al., 2026）在以代码形式编写的记忆设计上进行搜索，并在四个序贯决策领域中找到了优于人工设计的方案。

sents.en: AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) couples code proposals from language models to executable evaluators.
sents.zh: AlphaEvolve（Novikov et al., 2025）将来自语言模型的代码提案与可执行的评估器相结合。

paragraphs.en: The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , which comes closest to the second link, modifies its own agent code and keeps an archive of variants. In an ablation in which a fixed base agent performs every modification, gains taper off quickly, whereas letting improved agents modify themselves sustains improvement on its coding benchmarks. That ablation is the closest analogue of the second link that we found. It differs from the physical case in three ways: the improver and the task solver are the same agent; the benchmark that selects each modification also measures it, although the discovered improvements also transfer to a held-out benchmark and to other foundation models; and executable tests reject candidates cheaply.
paragraphs.zh: 达尔文哥德尔机（DGM）（Zhang et al., 2026c）与第二个环节最为接近，它会修改自身的智能体代码，并保留一个变体档案库。 在一项消融实验中，由一个固定的基础智能体执行所有修改时，收益很快趋于平缓；而让改进后的智能体自行修改，则能在其编码基准上持续带来提升。 该消融实验是我们所找到的与第二个环节最接近的类比。 它与物理情形有三点不同：改进者与任务求解者是同一个智能体；用于筛选每次修改的基准同时也度量该修改，尽管所发现的改进也能迁移到保留基准以及其他基础模型上；可执行的测试能够以低成本淘汰候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Other digital systems extend the pattern. Gödel Agent ( Yin et al., 2025 ) lets an agent rewrite the code that performs its own improvement (Section 2.3 ). SelfSearch ( Yang et al., 2026c ) has agents modify themselves using records of earlier self-modification episodes, without downstream reward during the search, and improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model–benchmark settings it reports. HyperAgents ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) make the meta agent itself editable and run the fixed-improver control. With the initial meta agent held fixed for the same number of iterations, the median test score in simulated quadruped reward design reaches 0.213 against 0.372 when the meta agent improves itself (five runs each). Hyperagents transferred to Olympiad-level math grading and run with their meta agent fixed yield an improvement of 0.630 where the initial agent yields none. In AIDE 2 ( Srikanth et al., 2026 ) , a fixed outer-loop agent rewrites a research agent’s code, and the seven accepted improvements transfer to four held-out benchmarks. When the evolved agent instead drives the outer loop, its final grade is close to that of the human-designed driver (0.780 against 0.782 over three seeds), a result its authors call inconclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 其他数字系统扩展了这一模式。 Gödel Agent（Yin et al., 2025）允许智能体重写执行其自身改进的代码（第 2.3 节）。 SelfSearch（Yang et al., 2026c）让智能体利用先前自我修改过程的记录来修改自身，在搜索过程中不使用下游奖励，并且在其报告的全部六个模型–基准设置中，种群平均成功率均高于初始智能体。 HyperAgents（Zhang et al., 2026d）使元智能体本身可被编辑，并运行固定改进器的对照实验。 在元智能体保持固定、迭代次数相同的条件下，模拟四足动物奖励设计中的测试分数中位数为 0.213，而元智能体改进自身时为 0.372（各五次运行）。 Hyperagents 迁移到奥林匹克级别的数学评分任务并以元智能体固定方式运行时，可获得 0.630 的提升，而初始智能体的提升为零。 在 AIDE 2（Srikanth et al., 2026）中，一个固定的外层循环智能体重写研究智能体的代码，其七项被采纳的改进可迁移到四个保留基准上。 当改由演化出的智能体驱动外层循环时，其最终成绩接近人类设计的驱动者（三个随机种子下为 0.780 对 0.782），其作者称该结果尚无定论。

paragraphs.en: Other routes make the improver a learned component. Randomly initialized learned optimizers can train one another and, once better, speed up their own training ( Metz et al., 2021 ) , and a self-referential weight matrix modifies its own weights, including the transformations that generate later modifications, although its authors leave a dedicated measurement of self-improvement to future work ( Irie et al., 2022 ) . MASS ( Lee et al., 2026a ) fine-tunes one model that proposes, executes, and judges multi-agent workflows on its own traces; when workflows from two generations are run by the same base executor, those of the newer generation win 64% of comparisons, although discovery still used each generation’s own executor and judge, and its robotics tasks are simulated. SpecRSI ( Xu et al., 2026d ) trains its improver on completed searches with the outer update rule fixed and runs the original and the updated improver on the same released artifact, where the updated improver yields a gain of 6.9 against 5.7 percentage points; some of its joint-update conditions have unequal training cost.
paragraphs.zh: 另一些路线将改进器作为一个可学习的组件。 随机初始化的可学习优化器可以相互训练，并在变得更好之后加速自身的训练（Metz et al., 2021）；自引用权重矩阵可以修改自身的权重，包括生成后续修改的变换，尽管其作者将对自我提升的专门测量留待未来工作（Irie et al., 2022）。 MASS（Lee et al., 2026a）在一个模型上做微调，该模型在自己的轨迹上提出、执行并评判多智能体工作流；当两代工作流由同一基础执行器运行时，较新一代的工作流在 64% 的比较中胜出，不过其发现过程仍使用了每一代自己的执行器和评判器，且其机器人任务是在模拟环境中进行的。 SpecRSI（Xu et al., 2026d）在外层更新规则固定的情况下，用已完成的搜索训练其改进器，并在同一已发布工件上运行原始改进器和更新后的改进器，更新后的改进器取得了 6.9 对 5.7 个百分点的提升；其部分联合更新条件存在训练成本不相等的问题。

paragraphs.en: Two recent systems sharpen what an R2 test must measure. The Huxley-Gödel Machine ( Wang et al., 2026f ) reports that an agent’s own benchmark score only weakly predicts how good its self-modified descendants will be (weighted correlations of 0.27 to 0.44), whereas a score pooled over its descendants predicts it better (0.63 to 0.78). Selecting by that pooled score, with the starting agent and an 800-evaluation budget held fixed, its best agent reaches 56.7% on a 60-task SWE-bench Verified subset against 53.3% for DGM and 50.0% for SICA in single runs, and improves from 34.8% to 40.1% on 207 held-out SWE-bench Lite tasks. The Red Queen Gödel Machine ( Iacob et al., 2026 ) lets learned evaluators evolve alongside the agents they score and promotes an evaluator only when it beats the incumbent on a fixed ground-truth anchor. Against frozen evaluators, in one run per arm, its coder passes 82.1% against 75.0% of 28 held-out tasks (a winner found with more search tokens); in a simulated Unitree Go2 reward-design task, its mean held-out jump height is 0.365 against 0.306 m over five runs per arm. Its comparison isolates evaluator co-evolution while the meta-agent is editable in both arms, so, unlike DGM and HyperAgents, neither the Huxley-Gödel Machine nor the Red Queen Gödel Machine compares improved agents modifying themselves with a fixed base agent making every modification at a matched budget.
paragraphs.zh: 两个近期的系统进一步明确了 R2 测试必须测量什么。 Huxley-Gödel 机器（Wang et al., 2026f）报告称，智能体自身的基准分数对其自我修改后代的表现预测能力很弱（加权相关性为 0.27 到 0.44），而对其后代汇总后的分数则预测得更好（0.63 到 0.78）。 在起始智能体和 800 次评估预算保持不变的情况下，按该汇总分数进行选择，其最佳智能体在 60 个任务的 SWE-bench Verified 子集上单次运行达到 56.7%，而 DGM 为 53.3%，SICA 为 50.0%；并且在 207 个留出的 SWE-bench Lite 任务上从 34.8% 提升到 40.1%。 Red Queen Gödel 机器（Iacob et al., 2026）让学习得到的评估器与其所评估的智能体共同演化，并且只有当某个评估器在固定的真值锚点集合上胜过现有评估器时才会晋升该评估器。 在与冻结评估器的对比中，每个配置各运行一次，其编码器在 28 个留出任务上通过 82.1%，而对照组为 75.0%（获胜者使用了更多搜索算力）；在模拟的 Unitree Go2 奖励设计任务中，每个配置各运行五次，其留出的平均跳跃高度为 0.365 米，对照组为 0.306 米。 其对比实验在两种配置下元智能体均可编辑的前提下隔离了评估器共同演化的作用，因此，与 DGM 和 HyperAgents 不同，无论是 Huxley-Gödel 机器还是 Red Queen Gödel 机器，都没有将改进后的智能体修改自身的情况与固定基础智能体在匹配预算下做出每次修改的情况进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Several robot systems, some evaluated only in simulation, are described by their authors as recursive self-improvement or recursive improvement: the criticality model’s policy-level RSI, EndoRSI, EmbodiRSI, Local Recovery Supervision, MobiAgent, RegenHarness, Embodied Turing Machines, RE-0, AdaRSI, PhysEvo, D-World, RIWANav, and RSI-Nav; EmbodiedRSI and RoboRSI use the term in their names. Table 11 lists what each changes, where it was tested, and where this review discusses it. Judged by the claims of Section 2.2 , they revise policies, models, skills, data, or procedures, and several also accumulate knowledge that guides their next revision (Section 3.3 ). PhysEvo, whose meta-agent edits its own diagnostic tools, comes closest in mechanism (Section 3.3 ). Turning any of them into evidence for R2 would require the R2 comparison of Section 2.2 , run on held-out failures with matched learners.

paragraphs.en: Four design requirements follow from the physical constraints discussed above. First, a protected success evaluation, with an outcome check that stays outside what the improver can change (Section 4.3.2 ). Second, staged evaluation: candidate revisions are screened in simulation or on stored traces, and hardware trials go to matched learners for the few that survive (Section 4.4 ). Third, repair records that carry their conditions of applicability, so that the improver can tell when an earlier lesson no longer holds (Section 4.4 ). Fourth, a budget that counts trials, resets, wear, and supervision, because revision histories accumulate slowly when each entry costs physical rounds (Section 2.4 ). A roadmap of autonomy levels ( Duan et al., 2026 ) separates structural recursion, in which a revised improver, verifier, or successor generator is merely inherited, from effective recursion, in which it produces better later improvements. In its own scheme of levels, the roadmap places embodied intelligence at the frontier of choosing improvement strategies and acquiring experience, with deployment adaptation shown mainly in simulation. Reaching the top level of the concurrent scheme in Section 2.2 ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) would require comparisons such as those designed in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 由上述物理约束可以得出四项设计要求。 第一，受保护的成败评估，其结果检查位于改进者无法改变的范围内（第 4.3.2 节）。 第二，分阶段评估：候选修订先在仿真或存储的轨迹上进行筛选，只有少数通过者才在硬件上进行针对匹配学习器的试验（第 4.4 节）。 第三，携带其适用条件的修复记录，使改进者能够判断早期的经验教训何时不再成立（第 4.4 节）。 第四，对试验、重置、磨损和监督进行计数的预算，因为当每次记录都要耗费物理轮次时，修订历史会积累得很慢（第 2.4 节）。 一个自主性等级路线图（Duan et al., 2026）区分了结构递归与有效递归：前者中修订后的改进者、验证器或后继生成器只是被继承，后者中它们能产生更好的后续改进。 在其自身的等级体系中，该路线图将具身智能置于选择改进策略和获取经验的前沿，而部署自适应主要在仿真中展示。 要达到第 2.2 节中并行方案的最高等级（Zhou et al., 2026a），将需要类似第 4.4 节所设计的那些比较。

paragraphs.en: This section turns to what stands in the way of physical RSI. Section 4.1 asks what current evaluation cannot yet measure and how judges can stay aligned as behavior improves; Section 4.2 explains why observed gains saturate, regress, or fail to carry forward, and how retained improvements can survive system change and finite resources; and Section 4.3 asks how practice can stay safe across rounds. Section 4.4 sets out what stands between current results and verified recursion, from locating the bottleneck and choosing a usable experiment to learning a transferable repair principle and testing whether it makes improvement recursive. Table 12 lists, for each open problem, the conditions it serves, its central question, and a starting benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 本节转向讨论是什么阻碍了物理化的递归自我改进（RSI）。 第4.1节探讨当前的评估还无法测量什么，以及随着行为改进，裁判如何保持对齐；第4.2节解释为什么观察到的增益会饱和、回退或无法延续，以及被保留的改进如何在系统变更和有限资源下存活；第4.3节探讨实践如何在整个轮次中保持安全。 第4.4节阐明从当前结果到已验证的递归之间还欠缺什么，从定位瓶颈、选择可用的实验，到学习可迁移的修复原则，并检验它能否使改进变得递归。 表12为每个开放问题列出其所服务的条件、核心问题以及一个起始基准。

paragraphs.en: Section 2.5 described the benchmarks and metrics in use; this subsection asks what they miss. Benchmarks test a system at one point in time, whereas self-improvement unfolds over rounds, so the test tasks must stay outside what the revising system can tune against. HarnessPAI reports 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO evaluation seeds that include its development seeds, and RoboRSI improves online on its evaluation tasks while its baselines do not. In RLE-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , coding agents improve on the development evaluations they can query but lose 19 to 41 points of verifier score, out of 100, on hidden robustness perturbations in simulation. Held-out seeds, tasks, and perturbations that the revising system never queries are part of a protected success evaluation. A held-out set also loses its validity when its results are reused repeatedly to select candidates, because the selection can overfit the held-out set itself ( Dwork et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 第2.5节介绍了所使用的基准测试与指标；本小节探讨它们遗漏了什么。 基准测试在某一时间点上检验系统，而自我改进则是跨越多轮展开的，因此测试任务必须保持在待修订系统所能针对调优的范围之外。 HarnessPAI 在包含其开发种子的 LIBERO-PRO 评估种子上报告了96.5%的成绩，而 RoboRSI 在其评估任务上实现在线提升，其基线方法则没有。 在 RLE-Bench（Ma et al., 2026）中，编码智能体在其可查询的开发评估上有所提升，但在仿真中的隐藏鲁棒性扰动上，验证器得分（满分100）下降了19到41分。 待修订系统从未查询过的保留种子、任务和扰动，属于受保护的成功评估的一部分。 当保留集的结果被反复用于挑选候选时，该保留集也会失去有效性，因为这种挑选可能对保留集本身产生过拟合（Dwork et al., 2015）。

paragraphs.en: Comparisons across rounds are rarer than single-round gains. Behavioral improvement is widely established (Tables 6 – 8 ), but later-learning and procedure claims need matched learners (Section 2.2 ). Few studies supply them. PLD does so for the training value of collected data on hardware, and FIERCE, RLER, WoVR, SAVE, and the demonstration-requesting RoboCoach do so for single procedure components. Integrated pipelines such as VLAW and the RoboCoach system ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , whose coding agent changes architecture, data augmentation, optimization, and validation code together, improve as a whole, and most results cover only the few rounds reported. For recursion, three judgments must be kept apart: a component of the procedure changes; the improver’s knowledge or tools change, as in AdaRSI, HARBOR, AURA, or PhysEvo; and a recursive gain is isolated by a frozen-knowledge or fixed-improver control with matched learners and budgets. The physical systems reviewed here reach the second judgment at most, while digital systems such as the Darwin Gödel Machine and HyperAgents run fixed-improver controls with executable tests or in simulation rather than through physical trials. Table 13 summarizes where the reviewed studies stand on each claim.
paragraphs.zh: 跨轮次的比较比单轮增益更少见。 行为改进已被广泛证实（表 6–8），但关于后续学习与程序的论断需要匹配的学习者（第 2.2 节）。很少有研究提供这些条件。 PLD 针对在硬件上采集数据的训练价值做到了这一点，而 FIERCE、RLER、WoVR、SAVE 以及请求演示的 RoboCoach 则针对单个程序组件做到了这一点。 诸如 VLAW 和 RoboCoach 系统（Lei et al., 2026）这样的集成式流水线，其编码智能体会同时修改架构、数据增强、优化和验证代码，从而作为整体获得改进，而大多数结果仅涵盖所报告的少数几轮。 对于递归，必须区分三个判断：程序中的某个组件发生了变化；改进者的知识或工具发生了变化，如 AdaRSI、HARBOR、AURA 或 PhysEvo；以及递归增益通过冻结知识或固定改进者的对照实验来隔离，且学习者和预算相匹配。 本文综述的物理系统至多达到第二个判断，而诸如 Darwin Gödel Machine 和 HyperAgents 之类的数字系统则通过可执行的测试或在仿真中而非通过物理试验来运行固定改进者的对照实验。 表 13 总结了所综述的各研究在每项论断上的立场。

paragraphs.en: When retained knowledge enters a decision rather than weights, the corresponding measure is a component test that holds the decision-maker fixed and varies only the retained resource. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026a ) compares debugging a real robot’s controller with and without transferred repair guidance, although whether starting programs and debugging budgets were matched is not stated; REVOLVE’s ( Liu et al., 2026b ) memory instead enters outcome judgments, so its test would compare judgments of the same observations under old and updated memory, a pathway that its reported judgment–policy trajectories do not isolate.
paragraphs.zh: 当被保留的知识以决策而非权重的方式进入系统时，相应的测量是保持决策者不变、仅变动被保留资源的组件测试。 ASPIRE（Lu 等，2026a）比较在有和没有迁移修复指导的情况下调试真实机器人控制器，但未说明起始程序和调试预算是否匹配；REVOLVE（Liu 等，2026b）的记忆则进入结果判断，因此其测试应比较在旧记忆与更新记忆下对相同观察的判断，而其报告的判断—策略轨迹并未隔离这一路径。

paragraphs.en: Even a well-designed comparison establishes improvement only relative to the success judgments made by a person, sensor, or model. Hardware studies differ in whether that channel is independent of the signal used for learning. RoboCat ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) uses learned reward models for autonomous success detection and relabeling, but counts final evaluation outcomes manually. In SILVR’s real-robot experiments ( Luo et al., 2026a ) , human judgments supply both the filtering signal and the evaluation outcome. Q-Planning ( Giridhar et al., 2026 ) goes further: a human-provided label supplies the terminal reward on the real robot, and its per-iteration success rates are computed from the same collection episodes. Each protocol supports a different claim. A shared judge can measure improvement against its own criterion but cannot reveal a systematic error in that criterion; an independent outcome audit tests that additional link. The same caution applies to an agent’s own report of completion: in the GPT-6-Astra evaluation ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , self-reported progress diverged from the actual completion conditions on simulated tasks, and its proposed benchmark keeps judging the trajectory after the agent declares that it is done.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是设计良好的对比实验，也只能相对某个人、传感器或模型所做出的成功判断来确立改进。 硬件研究的差异在于该通道是否独立于用于学习的信号。 RoboCat（Bousmalis 等，2024）使用学习到的奖励模型进行自主成功检测和重标注，但最终评估结果是人工统计的。 在 SILVR 的真机实验（Luo 等，2026a）中，人类判断既提供过滤信号，也提供评估结果。 Q-Planning（Giridhar 等，2026）更进一步：由人工提供的标签在真机上提供终止奖励，并且其每次迭代的成功率是从同一批采集回合中计算得出的。 每种协议所支撑的主张各不相同。 共享的评判者可以依据其自身的标准来衡量改进，但无法揭示该标准本身的系统性错误；而独立的结果审计则能检验这一额外的环节。 同样的告诫也适用于智能体自身对完成的报告：在 GPT-6-Astra 评估（Cai 等，2026）中，在仿真任务上自我报告的进度与实际的完成条件存在偏差，而且其提出的基准测试会在智能体宣称完成任务之后继续对轨迹进行评判。

sents.en: A shared judge can measure improvement against its own criterion but cannot reveal a systematic error in that criterion; an independent outcome audit tests that additional link.
sents.zh: 共享的评判者可以依据其自身的标准来衡量改进，但无法揭示该标准本身的系统性错误；而独立的结果审计则能检验这一额外的环节。

sents.en: The same caution applies to an agent’s own report of completion: in the GPT-6-Astra evaluation ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , self-reported progress diverged from the actual completion conditions on simulated tasks, and its proposed benchmark keeps judging the trajectory after the agent declares that it is done.
sents.zh: 同样的告诫也适用于智能体自身对完成的报告：在 GPT-6-Astra 评估（Cai 等，2026）中，在仿真任务上自我报告的进度与实际的完成条件存在偏差，而且其提出的基准测试会在智能体宣称完成任务之后继续对轨迹进行评判。

paragraphs.en: Tables 6 – 10 separate execution from outcome judgment for this reason. Final scorers, or their separation from training, remain unclear for SOAR, SI-EFM, RAPolicy, SARM2, VERITAS’s hardware tests, CIDER, RISE, PlayWorld, HIL-SERL, PLD’s hardware tests, and VLAW. SI-EFM’s collection labels and VLAW’s human filter audit do not establish independent final checks. DexTouch-WM specifies five human raters for its model-evaluation comparison; their role in the later mixed-data policy test is not separately stated.

paragraphs.en: Success-evaluation details are also unresolved for Robo-Cortex, Zeva, ReSYNC, ASPIRE, Uni-Skill, Criticality model, and GLIDE. REVOLVE provides human-referenced judgment accuracy without specifying the final policy judge. FIERCE reports independent terminal checks but insufficient detail to assess separation. These are reporting gaps, not evidence of incorrect judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Robo-Cortex、Zeva、ReSYNC、ASPIRE、Uni-Skill、Criticality model 和 GLIDE，成功评估的细节同样尚未明确。 REVOLVE 提供了以人为参照的判断准确率，但未指明最终的策略裁判。 FIERCE 报告了独立的终端检查，但细节不足，难以评估其分离性。 这些只是报告上的缺失，并非判断错误的证据。

paragraphs.en: A success rate should be read with the number of trials and independent training runs behind it. A few trials leave a wide interval even at perfect success, and trials that share scenes, resets, checkpoints, or training runs are less independent than a binomial calculation assumes. Reports should therefore state trial and run counts, how tasks, initial states, and checkpoints were selected, and whether judges agreed or were blinded ( Kress-Gazit et al., 2024 ) . Differences between methods should carry their own uncertainty. Sequential designs lower the cost: AnyRank ( Badithela et al., 2026 ) assigns more trials to policies that are hard to separate and needs up to 50% fewer hardware evaluations than earlier rigorous rankings. RoboArena ( Atreya et al., 2025 ) instead ranks policies from double-blind pairwise comparisons crowd-sourced across seven institutions on the DROID platform, and AutoEval ( Zhou et al., 2025d ) supplies automatic success detection and scene resets so that real-world evaluation runs with little human involvement.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率应结合其背后的试验次数和独立训练运行次数来解读。 少量试验即使在完全成功的情况下也会留下很宽的区间，而且共享场景、重置、检查点或训练运行的试验，其独立性低于二项式计算所假设的水平。 因此，报告应说明试验和运行的次数、任务、初始状态和检查点是如何选取的，以及评判者是否达成一致或是否被设盲（Kress-Gazit et al., 2024）。 方法之间的差异应附带其自身的不确定性。 序贯设计可以降低成本：AnyRank（Badithela et al., 2026）为难以区分的策略分配更多试验，与之前严格的排名方法相比，所需的硬件评估最多可减少 50%。 RoboArena（Atreya et al., 2025）则基于 DROID 平台上由七个机构众包的双盲成对比较来对策略进行排名，而 AutoEval（Zhou et al., 2025d）提供自动成功检测和场景重置，使真实世界评估几乎无需人工参与即可运行。

paragraphs.en: A cost comparison is meaningful only once the outcome and its uncertainty are specified. Cost accounting should separate setup and signal construction, acquisition of the revision, downstream training and evaluation, deployment, and later maintenance. ASPIRE reports model tokens to the first working program or to budget exhaustion, a measure that excludes robot time and total system cost. VLAW matches 50 physical rollouts per task category per round against its downstream baselines, while also fitting models and generating synthetic data. FIERCE reports 300 refinement rollouts per condition on each real task and explicitly excludes initialization, evaluator adaptation, calibration, evaluation, resets, and interventions from that count. These scopes answer useful but different questions, and ranking costs across studies would mix them. Table 9 preserves the reported scope; a complete comparison of the cost to reach a target would additionally count robot episodes and hours, resets and human time, compute or tokens, failed runs, and revalidation after later updates. Elapsed time belongs in this count too, because simulated benchmarks can pause while a model deliberates: in the GPT-6-Astra evaluation ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , the standard RoboDojo budgets correspond to 8–76 s of commanded motion against an average of 55 minutes of computation, so a larger step budget raises simulated success at no cost in elapsed time. On a real Unitree G1 humanoid, about 90% of each run went to deliberation and one manipulation trial took over an hour, and protective stops and actuator overheating ended trials on other robots. Its proposed benchmark therefore charges deliberation on a world clock that keeps running.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在明确了结果及其不确定性之后，成本比较才有意义。 成本核算应区分以下几部分：搭建与信号构建、获取修订版本、下游训练与评估、部署，以及后续维护。 ASPIRE 报告的是到首个可运行程序或预算耗尽为止的模型 token 数，这一度量不包括机器人时间和系统总成本。 VLAW 在每轮中为每个任务类别进行 50 次物理 rollout，并与下游基线进行对比，同时还要拟合模型并生成合成数据。 FIERCE 报告的是每个条件下在每项真实任务上 300 次精炼 rollout，并明确将初始化、评估器适配、校准、评估、复位和人工干预排除在该计数之外。 这些范围回答的是有用但不同的问题，跨研究对成本进行排名会将它们混为一谈。 表 9 保留了所报告的范围；要对达到目标所需的成本做完整比较，还需要计入机器人回合数与时长、复位与人工时间、算力或 token、失败运行次数，以及后续更新后的重新验证。 所耗时间也应计入其中，因为模拟基准测试在模型思考时可以暂停：在 GPT-6-Astra 评估（Cai et al., 2026）中，标准 RoboDojo 预算对应 8–76 秒的指令运动，而平均计算时间为 55 分钟，因此更大的步数预算可以在不增加所耗时间的情况下提升模拟成功率。 在真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，每次运行约 90% 的时间用于思考，一次操作试验耗时超过一小时，而在其他机器人上，保护性停机和执行器过热导致试验中断。 因此，它提出的基准测试在一个持续运行的世界时钟上对思考过程计费。

paragraphs.en: Measurement inside the learning loop raises a related problem: an experiment becomes misleading if the supervision used to judge it no longer resolves the failures produced by the improved policy. The measurement of the task may then need to evolve without silently changing the task itself. An early grasping policy may mostly miss the object, so a coarse lift detector is informative. A stronger policy may lift the object faster while squeezing hard enough to damage it. Adding force-sensitive evidence can refine the measurement of the original intent (a secure lift without damage), whereas redefining success to favor speed despite damage changes the intended outcome. An evaluator update should state which task requirements remain unchanged and which previously missed failure modes it now detects.
paragraphs.zh: 在学习回路内部进行测量会带来一个相关的问题：如果用于评判实验的监督不再能分辨出由改进后的智能体策略所产生的失败，实验就会变得具有误导性。 此时对任务的测量可能需要演进，但又不能悄悄改变任务本身。 早期的抓取策略可能大多抓不到物体，因此一个粗粒度的抬起检测器是有信息量的。 更强的策略可能更快地抬起物体，同时用力挤压到足以损坏物体。 增加力敏证据可以细化对原始意图的测量（无损且稳固地抬起物体），而将成功重新定义为在造成损坏的情况下仍偏重速度，则会改变预期的结果。 评估器的更新应当说明哪些任务要求保持不变，以及它现在能检测到哪些此前遗漏的失败模式。

paragraphs.en: Because behavior shifts toward subtler failures, an evaluator refreshed from examples it selected itself can reproduce its own blind spots, and one refreshed only on recent failures can forget distinctions needed for older behaviors. The supervision loop needs anchors that stay fixed across evaluator versions: outcome-linked examples spanning old and new failure modes, selectively requested physical or human judgments, and a protected success evaluation for disputed cases (Section 4.3.2 ). In the freeze–test–refresh–relabel sequence of Section 4.2 , these anchors serve as the test. Versioning must connect each score to the evaluator, evidence, and task definition that produced it.
paragraphs.zh: 由于行为会转向更隐蔽的失败，一个从其自选示例中刷新的评估器可能复现自身的盲点，而一个仅从近期失败中刷新的评估器可能遗忘较旧行为所需的区分。 监督环路需要跨评估器版本保持固定的锚点：跨越新旧失败模式、与结果关联的示例，选择性地请求的物理或人工判定，以及对争议案例的受保护成功评估（第 4.3.2 节）。 在第 4.2 节的冻结—测试—刷新—重标注序列中，这些锚点充当测试。 版本管理必须把每个分数与其产生它的评估器、证据和任务定义关联起来。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark for evaluator refresh should therefore separate better measurement from better supervision. With the learner, data, and update budget fixed, it varies only the evaluator and its refresh rule, tests judgments on independently selected old and new outcomes, and then trains the same learner from each version’s labels and evaluates the policies through protected physical outcomes. An evaluator counts as progress only if it preserves the intended ordering of outcomes across rounds and helps produce a better policy; fitting its refreshed labels more accurately is not enough.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，评估器刷新的基准测试应当将更好的测量与更好的监督区分开来。 在学习者、数据和更新预算固定的情况下，该基准仅改变评估器及其刷新规则，在独立选取的旧结果和新结果上检验判断，然后用每个版本的标签训练同一个学习者，并通过受保护的物理结果来评估这些策略。 一个评估器只有在其保持了各轮次之间结果的原有排序并有助于产生更好的策略时，才算取得了进展；仅仅更准确地拟合其刷新后的标签是不够的。

sents.en: An evaluator counts as progress only if it preserves the intended ordering of outcomes across rounds and helps produce a better policy; fitting its refreshed labels more accurately is not enough.
sents.zh: 一个评估器只有在其保持了各轮次之间结果的原有排序并有助于产生更好的策略时，才算取得了进展；仅仅更准确地拟合其刷新后的标签是不够的。

paragraphs.en: The gains reviewed in Section 3 are often real but local. Consider the missed grasp once more. After the robot learns to grasp reliably, its new successes may teach little that it does not already know, and its contact model may not cover the faster motions it now makes. A repaired grasp may expose a weakness in the controller that executes it. A growing library of grasp skills may become hard to search, and maintaining all of this machinery may cost more than it saves. These failures map onto the conditions of Section 2.2 . Narrowing data strains informative feedback , outgrown models and rewards reflect a lack of robustness to distribution shift , and a moving bottleneck is a problem of usability . Accumulation strains both usability and robustness to distribution shift, and infrastructure cost bears on continued practice . Table 14 lists the comparisons that bear most directly on each condition. Carrying a benefit forward means that it remains useful for later behavior or learning; performance need not grow at an accelerating rate. Because recursion depends on gains that carry into the next round, each of these stalls is also an obstacle to RSI.
paragraphs.zh: 第3节所回顾的收益往往是真实的，但只是局部的。 再考虑一下抓取失败这个例子。 在机器人学会可靠抓取之后，它新获得的成功可能教不了它什么未知的东西，而它的接触模型可能覆盖不了它现在更快的动作。 一次修复后的抓取可能会暴露执行它的控制器中的缺陷。 不断增长的抓取技能库可能变得难以搜索，而维护所有这些机制的成本可能超过其节省的成本。 这些失败对应于第2.2节中的条件。 数据收窄使信息性反馈变得紧张，过时的模型与奖励反映出对分布偏移缺乏鲁棒性，而移动的瓶颈则是一个可用性问题。 累积使可用性和对分布偏移的鲁棒性都变得紧张，而基础设施成本关系到持续实践。 表14列出了与每个条件最直接相关的比较。 收益的延续意味着它对后续的行为或学习仍然有用；性能并不需要以加速的速度增长。 由于递归依赖于能够带入下一轮的收益，这些停滞中的每一个也是通向递归式自我改进（RSI）的障碍。

paragraphs.en: When autonomous imitation keeps only successful rollouts (filtered behavior cloning), the next dataset increasingly reflects behavior that the current policy can already produce. A higher success rate can then raise the yield of accepted trajectories while each new trajectory teaches less. The plateaus reported by Mirchandani et al. (2025) are consistent with this pattern. PLD ( Xiao et al., 2026a ) shows the complementary case: collectors with equal success can differ in training value.
paragraphs.zh: 当自主模仿只保留成功的轨迹时（过滤式行为克隆），下一个数据集会越来越多地反映当前策略已经能够产生的行为。 更高的成功率随后可能提高被接受轨迹的产出，同时每条新轨迹所教授的内容却越来越少。 Mirchandani 等人报告的平台期 （2025）与这一模式一致。 PLD（Xiao 等人，2026a）展示了相反的情形：成功率相同的采集者在训练价值上可能有所不同。

sents.zh: （2025）与这一模式一致。

paragraphs.en: When success and training value diverge, choosing what to practice next (a curriculum) must answer two questions. The first is where another trial is informative, which failure prediction and competence progress answer differently. The second is what supervision the selected state needs. If an adequate recovery already lies within the range of behavior the learner can produce, autonomous practice may expose it. If no useful action is available, repeated failure adds little, and an expert correction, a residual controller, or a new skill may be required.
paragraphs.zh: 当成功与训练价值出现分歧时，选择接下来练习什么（即课程）必须回答两个问题。 第一个是另一次尝试在哪里具有信息量，失败预测与能力进展对此给出的答案不同。 第二个是所选状态需要什么样的监督。 如果充分的恢复已经处于学习者能够产生的行为范围之内，自主练习可能会使其显现出来。 如果没有可用的有效动作，重复失败收效甚微，此时可能需要专家纠正、残差控制器或一项新技能。

sents.en: When success and training value diverge, choosing what to practice next (a curriculum) must answer two questions.
sents.zh: 当成功与训练价值出现分歧时，选择接下来练习什么（即课程）必须回答两个问题。

sents.zh: 第一个是另一次尝试在哪里具有信息量，失败预测与能力进展对此给出的答案不同。

sents.en: The second is what supervision the selected state needs.
sents.zh: 第二个是所选状态需要什么样的监督。

sents.en: If no useful action is available, repeated failure adds little, and an expert correction, a residual controller, or a new skill may be required.
sents.zh: 如果没有可用的有效动作，重复失败收效甚微，此时可能需要专家纠正、残差控制器或一项新技能。

paragraphs.en: The choice must also move with the policy. A state that once exposed a useful error can become routine after correction, while better recovery and reset mechanisms can make previously costly states reachable enough to practice. Conversely, an irreversible or unreliable reset can make a theoretically informative failure a poor use of a physical budget. Collection, correction, and recovery should be reassessed together, judged by the downstream learner’s gain and the physical cost.
paragraphs.zh: 选择也必须随策略而变化。 曾经暴露出有用错误的状态在纠正后可能变得常规化，而更好的恢复与重置机制可以让原本代价高昂的状态变得足够可及，从而加以练习。 相反，不可逆或不可靠的重置会让理论上很有启发性的失败成为对物理预算的不当使用。 采集、纠正与恢复应当被放在一起重新评估，并以下游学习器的收益和物理成本来衡量。

sents.zh: 选择也必须随策略而变化。

paragraphs.en: A moving curriculum changes the distribution of situations in which the next policy acts, and predictors and evaluators fitted to earlier rounds can lose their footing. Two distinct forms of drift result. First, a world model may have little support (few comparable training examples) for the improved policy’s actions and contacts, such as the faster grasping motions it now makes, so optimization can favor trajectories that look successful only because the prediction is wrong. Second, an evaluator trained on earlier behavior may remain accurate on old failures yet miss the subtler ones produced by a stronger policy. Agreement between prediction and evaluation is weak evidence when both are computed from the same imagined trajectory and share the same blind spot about the physical world.
paragraphs.zh: 移动的课程改变了下一个智能体策略所处情境的分布，为之前各轮拟合的预测器和评估器可能会失去立足点。 由此产生两种截然不同的漂移。 第一，世界模型对改进后策略的动作与接触可能几乎没有支撑（可类比的训练样本很少），例如它现在做出的更快的抓取动作，因此优化可能偏向那些仅仅因为预测错误才显得成功的轨迹。 第二，基于早期行为训练的评估器可能对旧的失败仍然判断准确，却会遗漏更强策略所产生的更细微的失败。 当预测与评估都基于同一条想象轨迹计算、并对物理世界共享同一个盲点时，二者之间的一致只是微弱的证据。

sents.zh: 当预测与评估都基于同一条想象轨迹计算、并对物理世界共享同一个盲点时，二者之间的一致只是微弱的证据。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods respond at three different points. WISE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) restricts imagination to selected states and short horizons, HaWMPO ( Chen et al., 2026j ) downweights rewards from chunks it scores as hallucinated, and VLAW ( Guo et al., 2026 ) refits the world model on new physical rollouts. Restriction and downweighting protect an update within the model’s current support; refreshing attempts to enlarge that support. The trade-off is temporal: a conservative imagination region can be reliable now yet exclude the transitions required for the next improvement, whereas expanding it consumes physical trials and helps only if collection reaches the new policy’s relevant errors.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在三个不同的节点进行响应。 WISE（Zhang et al., 2026a）将想象限制在选定状态和较短的时间范围内，HaWMPO（Chen et al., 2026j）降低其判定为幻觉的分段所产生的奖励权重，而 VLAW（Guo et al., 2026）则在新的物理轨迹上重新拟合世界模型。 限制与降权是在模型当前支撑域内保护一次更新；刷新则试图扩大该支撑域。 这种权衡是时间维度上的：保守的想象区域现在可能可靠，却可能排除下一次改进所需的转移；而扩大该区域会消耗物理试验，并且只有当数据采集触及新策略的相关错误时才有帮助。

sents.en: Existing methods respond at three different points.
sents.zh: 现有方法在三个不同的节点进行响应。

paragraphs.en: In PlayWorld ( Yin et al., 2026b ) , prolonged fine-tuning inside the model can keep improving the imagined reward while reducing success on hardware, as the policy specializes to small prediction mismatches, so even a comparatively accurate model remains open to exploitation by optimization. Fresh physical rollouts act as an external anchor for deciding when to stop, refresh, or distrust imagination. Studies of generative models trained repeatedly on their own outputs provide an adjacent warning: without enough real data, such loops can progressively lose the tails of the data distribution ( Shumailov et al., 2024 ) or lose diversity ( Alemohammad et al., 2024 ) , a coverage failure that any mixture of real and imagined data must monitor.
paragraphs.zh: 在 PlayWorld（Yin et al., 2026b）中，模型内部长时间的微调可以持续提升想象奖励，同时降低硬件上的成功率，因为策略会过拟合于微小的预测偏差，因此即使一个相对准确的模型仍然可能被优化所利用。 新鲜的物理 rollout 可以作为外部锚点，用于决定何时停止、刷新或不信任想象。 对生成模型反复在自身输出上训练的研究提供了一个相邻的警示：在缺乏足够真实数据的情况下，这类循环会逐渐丢失数据分布的尾部（Shumailov et al., 2024）或丢失多样性（Alemohammad et al., 2024），任何真实与想象数据混合的方案都必须监控这种覆盖度失败。

paragraphs.en: Evaluator updates require a complementary timing rule. Combining FIERCE’s per-round refresh, which already freezes a versioned evaluator and relabels replay ( Tan et al., 2026b ) , with PEBBLE’s relabeling ( Lee et al., 2021 ) suggests a freeze–test–refresh–relabel sequence: keep feedback stable during an update, test it against current outcomes, revise it when behavior shifts, and make retained data consistent with the new version.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器的更新需要一条配套的时序规则。 将 FIERCE 的每轮刷新机制（其已经会冻结一个带版本的评估器并对回放数据进行重标注（Tan et al., 2026b））与 PEBBLE 的重标注方法（Lee et al., 2021）相结合，可以导出一个「冻结—测试—刷新—重标注」的序列：在更新期间保持反馈稳定，用当前结果对其进行测试，当行为发生偏移时进行修订，并使留存的数据与新版本保持一致。

sents.en: Evaluator updates require a complementary timing rule.
sents.zh: 评估器的更新需要一条配套的时序规则。

paragraphs.en: Every repair, including the repairs of prediction and feedback just described, also changes what the next component receives. A bottleneck moves when a previously adequate recipient becomes the dominant source of end-to-end error. Two ablations expose such a recipient: in SILVR’s simulated ablation ( Luo et al., 2026a ) , a frozen action translator limits what an updated video planner gains, and in SHAPER ( Wang et al., 2026e ) , skill guidance and the harness that delivers it have non-additive effects. Neither study follows the bottleneck across rounds, so the consequences below remain hypotheses that a multi-round test would need to check.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次修复，包括刚才所述的对预测和反馈的修复，也会改变下一个组件所接收到的内容。 当原本足够胜任的接收方成为端到端误差的主要来源时，瓶颈就会发生转移。 两个消融实验揭示了这样的接收方：在 SILVR 的模拟消融（Luo et al., 2026a）中，冻结的动作翻译器限制了更新后的视频规划器所能获得的收益；在 SHAPER（Wang et al., 2026e）中，技能引导及其传递载体具有非加性的效果。 两项研究都没有跨轮次追踪瓶颈，因此下文的结论仍属假设，需要通过多轮测试加以检验。

sents.en: Every repair, including the repairs of prediction and feedback just described, also changes what the next component receives.
sents.zh: 每一次修复，包括刚才所述的对预测和反馈的修复，也会改变下一个组件所接收到的内容。

sents.en: A bottleneck moves when a previously adequate recipient becomes the dominant source of end-to-end error.
sents.zh: 当原本足够胜任的接收方成为端到端误差的主要来源时，瓶颈就会发生转移。

sents.en: Two ablations expose such a recipient: in SILVR’s simulated ablation ( Luo et al., 2026a ) , a frozen action translator limits what an updated video planner gains, and in SHAPER ( Wang et al., 2026e ) , skill guidance and the harness that delivers it have non-additive effects.
sents.zh: 两个消融实验揭示了这样的接收方：在 SILVR 的模拟消融（Luo et al., 2026a）中，冻结的动作翻译器限制了更新后的视频规划器所能获得的收益；在 SHAPER（Wang et al., 2026e）中，技能引导及其传递载体具有非加性的效果。

sents.en: Neither study follows the bottleneck across rounds, so the consequences below remain hypotheses that a multi-round test would need to check.
sents.zh: 两项研究都没有跨轮次追踪瓶颈，因此下文的结论仍属假设，需要通过多轮测试加以检验。

paragraphs.en: When an execution module admits a wider range of behavior, the predictor and evaluator should be retested on the newly reached states. A runtime that rescues failures may hide from the learner the raw mistakes that motivated the rescue, unless trajectories from before the recovery and the corrections themselves are retained. A growing skill set forces the harness to decide which repair applies and which evidence should be preserved. A simulated study of 123 rounds of agentic skill discovery ( Wang, 2026 ) shows the resulting stall: changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task never succeeded, because perception could not represent the needed relation, learning concentrated on the first step of long skill chains, and the agent optimized the evaluator’s errors. A convincing test should evaluate the full pipeline on the distribution reached after the repair, ablate the receiving component, and inspect the next learning update, in addition to rechecking the repaired component.
paragraphs.zh: 当执行模块容纳了更广泛的行为范围时，应当在新到达的状态上重新测试预测器和评估器。 如果运行时能够挽救失败，可能会向学习者隐藏促成挽救的原始错误，除非保留恢复之前的轨迹以及纠正本身。 不断增长的技能集迫使测试框架决定应用哪种修复以及应保留哪些证据。 一项对123轮智能体技能发现的模拟研究（Wang, 2026）显示了由此产生的停滞：变更不断通过其测试，但目标任务始终未成功，因为感知无法表示所需的关系，学习集中于长技能链的第一步，且智能体优化了评估器的错误。 一个有说服力的测试应当除了重新检查被修复的组件之外，还要在修复后达到的分布上评估整个流水线，对接收组件进行消融实验，并检查下一次学习更新。

paragraphs.en: As repairs accumulate, the usability problem becomes one of retention and retrieval. Retention asks whether an earlier behavior remains available after the next update; retrieval asks whether the right behavior or record is selected under the present conditions. A system can satisfy one without the other. An old skill may survive in the weights yet be routed incorrectly, while a relevant trajectory may be retrieved but decoded through an action interface whose coordinates have changed. Lasting improvement must preserve content together with the distinctions, interfaces, and applicability conditions that make it usable.
paragraphs.zh: 随着修复不断累积，可用性问题就变成了保持与提取的问题。 保持关注的是，在下一次更新之后，先前的行为是否仍然可用；提取关注的是，在当前条件下，是否选中了正确的行为或记录。 一个系统可以满足其中之一而不满足另一个。 一项旧技能可能仍然存在于权重之中，却被错误地路由；而一条相关的轨迹可能被提取出来，却通过一个坐标已经改变的动作接口被解码。 持久的改进必须将内容与使其可用的区分、接口和适用条件一同保留下来。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods protect different parts of this path. Three methods rehearse earlier behavior: Memory Anchors ( Du et al., 2026 ) through targeted replay, CIDER ( Li et al., 2026d ) through distillation, and Dream to Remember ( Tharwat et al., 2026 ) inside a frozen world model. Pretraining changes how much protection is needed. On LIBERO suites in simulation, pretrained VLAs forget far less than small policies trained from scratch, simple experience replay sometimes removes forgetting, and skills that appear forgotten recover quickly with finetuning ( Liu et al., 2026c ) . Interpolating finetuned weights with the pretrained ones retains generalist abilities while learning a new task, in simulated and real experiments ( Yadav et al., 2026 ) . Dream to Remember also learns new tasks in imagination, but only where that model is accurate enough. ACCRUE ( Kim et al., 2026 ) instead carries lightweight actor–critic networks across a task sequence, cutting real-robot training time for later tasks by 31.0–68.5%, and FAN ( Hong et al., 2026a ) keeps the numerical meaning of retained actions fixed. These mechanisms complement one another: better rehearsal cannot repair coordinate drift, and stable coordinates do not decide which memory or skill applies. Their evaluations also use bounded task streams, so retrieval from an indefinitely growing repertoire is still to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法保护这条路径的不同部分。 三种方法演练先前的行为：Memory Anchors（Du et al., 2026）通过针对性回放，CIDER（Li et al., 2026d）通过蒸馏，以及 Dream to Remember（Tharwat et al., 2026）在一个冻结的世界模型内进行。 预训练改变了所需保护的程度。 在仿真中的 LIBERO 套件上，预训练的 VLA 遗忘的程度远小于从零训练的小型策略，简单的经验回放有时能完全消除遗忘，而看似遗忘的技能在微调后会很快恢复（Liu et al., 2026c）。 在仿真和真实实验中，将微调后的权重与预训练权重进行插值，在学习新任务的同时保留了通用能力（Yadav et al., 2026）。 Dream to Remember 还能在想象中学习新任务，但仅限于该模型足够准确的情形。 ACCRUE（Kim et al., 2026）则在任务序列中携带轻量级的 actor–critic 网络，将后续任务的真机训练时间缩短了 31.0–68.5%；FAN（Hong et al., 2026a）保持被保留动作的数值含义不变。 这些机制相互补充：更好的演练无法修复坐标漂移，而稳定的坐标也不能决定该使用哪段记忆或技能。 它们的评估同样使用有界的任务流，因此从无限增长的技能库中进行检索仍有待检验。

paragraphs.en: External memories make that final problem explicit. Robo-Cortex ( Chan et al., 2026 ) consolidates episode histories into retrievable principles and heuristics, whereas AllDayNav ( Yin et al., 2026a ) stores temporal context and can replace or extend visual memories as navigation experience accumulates. Their reported system-level gains support the usefulness of maintained memory; a general rule for detecting when a once-valid record has become stale has yet to be developed.
paragraphs.zh: 外部记忆使这一最终问题变得明确。 Robo-Cortex（Chan et al., 2026）将情节历史整合为可检索的原则与启发式方法，而 AllDayNav（Yin et al., 2026a）存储时间上下文，并能随着导航经验的积累替换或扩展视觉记忆。 它们所报告的系统级增益支持了持续维护记忆的有用性；然而，用于检测曾经有效的记录何时失效的通用规则尚待建立。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation should expose each burden separately. The task suites of Section 2.5 provide breadth, but each still needs a continual-learning protocol on top. After every update, the informative record is a matrix: performance on the new task, on earlier tasks, on deliberately conflicting states, and under shifted conditions in which stored knowledge may no longer apply. The matrix separates forgetting, retrieval error, and stale reuse, which a single final success rate would collapse together.
paragraphs.zh: 评估应当分别暴露每种负担。 第 2.5 节的任务套件提供了广度，但每一个仍需在其之上叠加一个持续学习协议。 每次更新之后，有价值的信息记录是一个矩阵：在新任务上的表现、在较早任务上的表现、在刻意设置的冲突状态下的表现，以及在存储的知识可能不再适用的偏移条件下的表现。 该矩阵区分了遗忘、检索错误与过时复用，而单一的最终成功率会将三者混为一谈。

sents.zh: 评估应当分别暴露每种负担。

sents.en: The task suites of Section 2.5 provide breadth, but each still needs a continual-learning protocol on top.
sents.zh: 第 2.5 节的任务套件提供了广度，但每一个仍需在其之上叠加一个持续学习协议。

paragraphs.en: Repair knowledge remains useful only while its applicability conditions hold. A system revision can break these conditions at several interfaces: a sensor or calibration change alters observations, a controller or API change alters action semantics, and a new gripper changes contact dynamics and reachable effects. Whether the change is labeled “hardware” or “software” matters less than which relation the retained artifact assumed. Replacing a gripper may invalidate a force threshold or joint-space recovery while preserving the higher-level strategy of releasing, retreating, and regrasping; renaming an API call may break code while leaving the intended behavior realizable through a new wrapper.
paragraphs.zh: 修复知识只有在其适用条件成立时才保持有用。 系统的某次修改可能在多个接口处破坏这些条件：传感器或标定的改变会改变观测结果，控制器或 API 的改变会改变动作语义，而新夹爪会改变接触动力学和可达效果。 这种变化被标注为「硬件」还是「软件」，并不如被保留的知识所假定的关系是什么来得重要。 更换夹爪可能使某个力阈值或关节空间的恢复动作失效，但仍保留了松开、退避并重新抓取这一更高层级的策略；重命名一个 API 调用可能使代码失效，但预期的行为仍可通过新的包装器实现。
