paragraphs.en: Maintenance has to operate on artifact-specific conditions. Policy weights depend on observation and action representations and on dynamics, and a learned evaluator depends on sensing and calibration. A skill depends on its preconditions, effects, and available controller, and code depends on APIs, schemas, timing, and permissions. A gate, shield, or monitor depends on the policies and dynamics against which it was validated. A single timestamp or confidence score for a whole memory cannot show which assumption has become stale. Each retained change should instead state its validity conditions: its required inputs, action meanings, physical envelope, software dependencies, and the evidence under which it last worked.
paragraphs.zh: 维护必须针对特定制品的条件进行操作。 策略权重取决于观测与动作表示以及动力学，而学习到的评估器则取决于传感与标定。 技能取决于其前置条件、效果和可用的控制器，代码取决于 API、模式、时序和权限。 门控、护盾或监视器取决于其验证时所针对的策略和动力学。 针对整段记忆的单一时间戳或置信度分数无法显示哪个假设已经过时。 相反，每条保留的变更都应声明其有效性条件：其所需输入、动作含义、物理包络、软件依赖，以及它最后一次生效时所依据的证据。

sents.en: Maintenance has to operate on artifact-specific conditions.
sents.zh: 维护必须针对特定制品的条件进行操作。

sents.en: Policy weights depend on observation and action representations and on dynamics, and a learned evaluator depends on sensing and calibration.
sents.zh: 策略权重取决于观测与动作表示以及动力学，而学习到的评估器则取决于传感与标定。

sents.en: A skill depends on its preconditions, effects, and available controller, and code depends on APIs, schemas, timing, and permissions.
sents.zh: 技能取决于其前置条件、效果和可用的控制器，代码取决于 API、模式、时序和权限。

sents.en: A gate, shield, or monitor depends on the policies and dynamics against which it was validated.
sents.zh: 门控、护盾或监视器取决于其验证时所针对的策略和动力学。

sents.en: A single timestamp or confidence score for a whole memory cannot show which assumption has become stale.
sents.zh: 针对整段记忆的单一时间戳或置信度分数无法显示哪个假设已经过时。

sents.en: Each retained change should instead state its validity conditions: its required inputs, action meanings, physical envelope, software dependencies, and the evidence under which it last worked.
sents.zh: 相反，每条保留的变更都应声明其有效性条件：其所需输入、动作含义、物理包络、软件依赖，以及它最后一次生效时所依据的证据。

paragraphs.en: Those conditions support four different responses. An artifact can be reused when its conditions still match, adapted when the task meaning is preserved but an interface can be translated, selectively revalidated when support is uncertain, or retired and rolled back when a required effect is no longer realizable. The distinction also guards against a misleading transfer claim. If a semantic recovery strategy succeeds on a new gripper only after a newly engineered adapter reconstructs its actions, the result tests the strategy and adapter together; the original commands were not what transferred. Conversely, rejecting the strategy because its old joint commands fail would overlook knowledge that remains valid at a higher level of abstraction.
paragraphs.zh: 这些条件支持四种不同的响应。 当工件的条件仍然匹配时可以复用；当任务含义保留但某个接口可以翻译时可以适配；当支持不确定时可以选择性重新验证；当某个必需效果不再可实现时可以退役并回滚。 这一区分还能防止误导性的迁移声明。 如果一个语义恢复策略只有在新建的适配器重构了它的动作之后才能在新夹持器上成功，那么该结果是对策略与适配器二者的联合测试；原始指令并非真正被迁移的东西。 反过来，仅因其旧的关节指令失效就否定该策略，会忽视在更高抽象层次上仍然有效的知识。

sents.en: Those conditions support four different responses.
sents.zh: 这些条件支持四种不同的响应。

sents.zh: 这一区分还能防止误导性的迁移声明。

sents.en: If a semantic recovery strategy succeeds on a new gripper only after a newly engineered adapter reconstructs its actions, the result tests the strategy and adapter together; the original commands were not what transferred.
sents.zh: 如果一个语义恢复策略只有在新建的适配器重构了它的动作之后才能在新夹持器上成功，那么该结果是对策略与适配器二者的联合测试；原始指令并非真正被迁移的东西。

sents.en: Conversely, rejecting the strategy because its old joint commands fail would overlook knowledge that remains valid at a higher level of abstraction.
sents.zh: 反过来，仅因其旧的关节指令失效就否定该策略，会忽视在更高抽象层次上仍然有效的知识。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark could introduce declared changes to sensing, embodiment, controller timing, APIs, and memory schemas, followed by gradual drift in calibration or wear, and compare unconditional reuse, relearning from scratch, and condition-aware adaptation or revalidation. Freezing the retained artifact while varying the adapter, and then the reverse, would separate semantic transfer from interface repair; the evaluation asks whether the system identifies the invalidated condition and restores held-out behavior without unsafe execution.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试可以对感知、具身、控制器时序、API 和记忆模式引入已声明的变更，随后伴随校准的逐渐漂移或磨损，并比较无条件复用、从零重新学习以及基于条件的适应性调整或重新验证。 冻结保留的工件而改变适配器，然后再反过来进行，可以将语义迁移与接口修复区分开来；该评估考察系统是否能识别失效的条件，并在不进行不安全执行的情况下恢复保留集上的行为。

paragraphs.en: Building a world model, evaluator, reset routine, or repair library consumes physical trials, engineering, supervision, and compute; reusing it can save later trials but also requires storage, calibration, and validation. Such an investment is worthwhile only if the artifact remains useful long enough to repay its cost. If setup costs C 0 C_{0} and reuse i i saves s i s_{i} while incurring maintenance cost m i m_{i} , all counted in one designated resource such as robot hours, the investment pays back only when ∑ i ( s i − m i ) > C 0 \sum_{i}(s_{i}-m_{i})>C_{0} before a change in task, scene, or robot makes it obsolete (the payback period). When several resources are involved, the criterion applies to each separately rather than to their sum. This is a design criterion that the surveyed studies do not yet estimate; reporting it alongside a comparison would be a natural next measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 构建世界模型、评估器、重置例程或修复库会消耗物理试验、工程投入、监督和算力；复用它可以节省后续试验，但也需要存储、校准和验证。 只有当该产物在足够长的时间内保持有用、能够收回其成本时，这样的投入才值得。 如果搭建成本为 C 0 C_{0}，第 i i 次复用节省 s i s_{i} 并产生维护成本 m i m_{i}，全部以某种指定的资源（如机器人小时）计量，那么只有在任务、场景或机器人发生变化使其过时之前满足 ∑ i ( s i − m i ) > C 0 \sum_{i}(s_{i}-m_{i})>C_{0}，投入才能收回（即回本期）。 当涉及多种资源时，该判据应分别应用于每种资源，而不是应用于它们的总和。 这是一个设计判据，所调研的研究尚未对其进行估计；在对比实验中同时报告该指标将是一个自然的下一步测量方向。

paragraphs.en: ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026b ) provides a concrete but bounded example: its safety, reset, and verification interfaces are built once and reused during later policy search. In its fleet experiments, scaling from one to eight agent–robot pairs reduces the time to reach the target from roughly five to two hours on Push-T and from more than 1.5 hours to about 40 minutes on pin insertion. The same scaling study reports lower mean utilization per robot and faster-than-linear growth in token consumption at eight agents; neither a cost-optimal fleet size nor the rate at which costs are amortized across tasks has been measured yet.
paragraphs.zh: ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026b）提供了一个具体但有边界约束的例子：其安全、重置和验证接口只构建一次，并在后续的策略搜索中重复使用。 在其机群实验中，将智能体–机器人配对从一对扩展到八对，使 Push-T 任务达到目标的时间从大约五小时缩短到两小时，使插针任务的时间从超过 1.5 小时缩短到约 40 分钟。 同一项扩展研究还报告了在八智能体规模下每台机器人的平均利用率更低，且令牌消耗呈现超线性增长；然而，成本最优的机群规模以及成本在任务间摊销的速度尚未得到测量。

paragraphs.en: The appropriate repair depends on both expected reuse and the risk of invalidation. A stable embodiment and a recurring family of tasks can justify expensive retraining or reusable infrastructure, whereas an imminent change in hardware or control interface favors a smaller, reversible repair whose assumptions are easier to revalidate. The resources involved are not interchangeable: more compute cannot undo hardware wear, a faster fleet cannot replace a success evaluation that no longer detects damage, and recovery can preserve access to trials without making those trials free. Comparisons should hold the target capability fixed and extend the cost accounting of Section 4.1 with robot utilization, the period over which the acquired capability is reused, and retained performance after later updates.
paragraphs.zh: 合适的修复方式取决于预期的复用程度和失效风险。 稳定的物理载体和反复出现的任务族可以证明昂贵的再训练或可复用基础设施是合理的，而硬件或控制接口即将发生变更时，则更适合采用规模较小、可逆的修复方式，因为其假设更容易重新验证。 所涉及的资源不可互换：更多的算力无法弥补硬件磨损，更快的机群无法替代已无法检测损伤的成功评估，而恢复可以保留试验机会，却不能使这些试验变得免费。 比较时应固定目标能力不变，并将第 4.1 节的成本核算扩展到机器人利用率、所获能力的复用周期以及后续更新后的保留性能。

paragraphs.en: Beyond explaining why costs can outrun gains, the open problem is how to allocate robot time, human attention, computation, reset effort, and hardware wear over a deployment horizon. Simulation can replace some hardware interaction but creates model-fitting and physical-validation costs, and safety exposure should remain a constraint rather than be traded against savings in time or computation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了解释成本为何可能超过收益之外，尚未解决的问题是如何在整个部署周期内分配机器人时间、人类注意力、计算资源、重置工作和硬件损耗。 仿真可以替代部分硬件交互，但会带来模型拟合与物理验证的成本，而安全暴露应始终作为一个约束条件，而不是用来与时间或计算上的节省做权衡。

sents.en: Beyond explaining why costs can outrun gains, the open problem is how to allocate robot time, human attention, computation, reset effort, and hardware wear over a deployment horizon.
sents.zh: 除了解释成本为何可能超过收益之外，尚未解决的问题是如何在整个部署周期内分配机器人时间、人类注意力、计算资源、重置工作和硬件损耗。

sents.en: Simulation can replace some hardware interaction but creates model-fitting and physical-validation costs, and safety exposure should remain a constraint rather than be traded against savings in time or computation.
sents.zh: 仿真可以替代部分硬件交互，但会带来模型拟合与物理验证的成本，而安全暴露应始终作为一个约束条件，而不是用来与时间或计算上的节省做权衡。

paragraphs.en: An allocation decision should combine expected downstream learning, frequency of reuse, maintenance and revalidation costs, and the probability that a task or system revision invalidates the artifact. It should also preserve option value: a reset capability, spare hardware capacity, or a human escalation path can be worthwhile because it keeps a future informative trial possible, even when it does not immediately raise task success. Three efficiency indicators can complement the causal tests: whether each round yields a gain, whether the gain arrives faster than human-engineered iteration, and whether the cost of each further gain, counted in robot time, attention, and wear, falls. A falling cost can also come from reused infrastructure or easier tasks, so it bears on the second recursive link only after the controlled comparison of Section 4.4 has established that link.
paragraphs.zh: 分配决策应综合考量预期的下游学习、复用频率、维护与重新验证成本，以及某项任务或系统修订使该产物失效的概率。 它还应保留期权价值：重置能力、备用硬件容量或人工升级路径都可能是值得的，因为它们使未来进行有信息量的试验成为可能，即便这些并不能立即提高任务成功率。 三个效率指标可以补充因果检验：每一轮是否带来增益、增益是否比人工工程迭代来得更快，以及以机器人时间、注意力和磨损计算的每次进一步增益的成本是否在下降。 成本的下降也可能来自复用的基础设施或更容易的任务，因此只有在第 4.4 节的受控比较确立了第二个递归环节之后，它才与该环节相关。

paragraphs.en: A deployment-horizon benchmark could present a sequence of tasks, failures, maintenance events, and system changes under finite resource capacities, let a method choose at each stage whether to collect, simulate, request supervision, build reusable infrastructure, revalidate an artifact, or retire it, and compare a horizon-aware allocator with myopic and fixed-budget schedules. Because no universal conversion rate relates robot time, human time, compute, and wear, results should report their trade-offs and their sensitivity to the assumed horizon rather than a single cost.
paragraphs.zh: 一个部署视野基准可以在有限资源容量下呈现一系列任务、故障、维护事件和系统变更，让方法在每个阶段选择是采集数据、进行仿真、请求监督、构建可复用基础设施、重新验证某个工件，还是将其退役，并将具备视野意识的分配器与短视和固定预算的调度方案进行比较。 由于机器人时间、人类时间、计算量和磨损之间不存在普遍适用的换算率，结果应报告它们之间的权衡及其对所假设视野的敏感性，而不是给出单一的成本。

paragraphs.en: For a robot that improves itself, safety preserves continued practice , the opportunity on which another learning round depends: a robot that damages its gripper or the object while practicing loses not only that attempt but also the trials that would have followed. Each update can also invalidate safety machinery built for the earlier system: an updated controller may exceed the assumptions of a safety guard, and a revised reset routine may no longer return the robot to a safe starting state. A recursive system faces this at two levels, because a revised learning procedure can also change what its safeguards must cover. Surveys of safe reinforcement learning ( García and Fernández, 2015 ) and of safe learning in control ( Brunke et al., 2022 ) catalog safeguards for collection, judgment, update, and execution. Some mechanisms below have been tested in simulation, formally, or on hardware; others are design requirements inferred from the ways self-modification can fail.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个自我改进的机器人而言，安全性保障了持续练习，而持续练习正是下一轮学习所依赖的机会：一个在练习中损坏夹爪或物体的机器人，不仅失去那一次尝试，也失去了随后本应进行的多次试验。 每次更新还可能使为早期系统构建的安全机制失效：更新后的控制器可能超出安全防护装置的假设范围，而修改后的复位程序可能无法再将机器人返回到安全的起始状态。 递归系统在两个层面上面临这一问题，因为修改后的学习程序也可能改变其安全防护措施所必须覆盖的范围。 关于安全强化学习（García and Fernández, 2015）和控制中安全学习（Brunke et al., 2022）的综述，对数据采集、判断、更新和执行各环节的安全防护措施进行了分类整理。 下文的某些机制已在仿真、形式化验证或硬件上得到测试；另一些则是根据自我修改可能的失败方式推断出的设计要求。

paragraphs.en: Resetting is itself a capability that determines which experiments remain possible, as Leave No Trace ( Eysenbach et al., 2018 ) and ReLMM ( Sun et al., 2022 ) show. Returning to an accessible starting state preserves the next experiment; a human reset preserves it too, but by moving part of the work outside the autonomous system. The resource that matters is safe access to an informative state, which a count of rollouts measures poorly.

paragraphs.en: Keeping practice available also means maintaining the interfaces that make another trial interpretable after wear, calibration drift, or software change.
paragraphs.zh: 保持实践可用还意味着维护那些接口——它们使得在磨损、校准漂移或软件变更之后，另一次试验仍可被解释。

paragraphs.en: Self-modification creates two windows of safety exposure. During improvement, harm can come from exploration, data collection, resets, and candidate testing before an update is accepted. After an update is accepted, the revised system can visit states or issue commands outside the assumptions of its existing monitors and recovery routines. The two windows can compound. A robot might first crush an object during exploration. A revised reset might then leave the object where the gripper cannot reach it, and an outcome detector that misses the damage can retain that transition as useful experience. Safety is a property of the whole loop of collection, judgment, update, and execution, not of the deployed policy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 自我修改会产生两个安全暴露窗口。 在改进过程中，危害可能来自探索、数据收集、重置，以及更新被接受之前的候选测试。 更新被接受后，修改后的系统可能进入超出其现有监控器和恢复例程假设的状态，或发出此类命令。 这两个窗口可能相互叠加。 机器人可能首先在探索过程中压碎某个物体。 修改后的重置可能随后把物体留在夹爪无法够到的位置，而未能发现损坏的结果检测器会将该转移保留为有用经验。 安全性是收集、判断、更新和执行这一整个循环的属性，而不仅仅是已部署策略的属性。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods protect different parts of this loop. Safe exploration based on recoverability ( Moldovan and Abbeel, 2012 ) formalizes safety as keeping, with a chosen probability, a route back to a home state. Constrained policy optimization instead keeps policy search near constraint satisfaction at every iteration ( Achiam et al., 2017 ) . Recovery RL ( Thananjeyan et al., 2021 ) learns this judgment from data, in simulation and on a surgical robot: a safety critic estimates the chance of constraint violation, and a learned recovery policy takes over when that chance crosses a threshold. The Neural Simplex Architecture ( Phan et al., 2020 ) switches to a baseline controller when a learned controller issues a potentially unsafe input, retrains the learned controller online, and returns control to it, in case studies on a ground rover and an artificial pancreas. Learning-based control ( Brunke et al., 2022 ) instead constrains behavior relative to a model of the dynamics and its uncertainty, for example through control barrier functions ( Ames et al., 2019 ) that keep the state in a certified safe set; such guarantees remain conditional on assumptions about state estimation, actuation, latency, and the operating envelope. Each notion covers part of physical safety. Task success establishes that an intended outcome occurred; failure detection covers only the failure modes that a detector represents; and constraint satisfaction is meaningful only relative to the specified constraint and model. A self-modifying system can pass one of these tests while failing another.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法保护的是这一循环的不同部分。 基于可恢复性的安全探索（Moldovan and Abbeel, 2012）将安全性形式化为：以选定的概率保持一条返回初始状态（home state）的路径。 约束策略优化则是在每次迭代中使策略搜索保持在约束满足附近（Achiam et al., 2017）。 Recovery RL（Thananjeyan et al., 2021）从数据中学习这一判断，并在仿真和手术机器人上进行了验证：一个安全评估器估计违反约束的概率，当该概率越过阈值时，一个学习到的恢复策略接管控制。 神经单纯形架构（Neural Simplex Architecture）（Phan et al., 2020）在学习到的控制器发出可能不安全的输入时切换到基线控制器，在线重新训练学习到的控制器，然后将控制权交还给它，并在地面巡视车和人工胰腺的案例研究中进行了验证。 基于学习的控制（Brunke et al., 2022）则是相对于动力学模型及其不确定性来约束行为，例如通过控制障碍函数（Ames et al., 2019）将状态保持在经认证的安全集内；此类保证仍然依赖于关于状态估计、执行、延迟以及工作包线的假设。 每种概念都只覆盖物理安全的一部分。 任务成功仅确认预期的结果发生了；失败检测只覆盖检测器所表征的失败模式；而约束满足只有相对于指定的约束和模型才有意义。 一个自我修改的智能体可以在通过其中一项测试的同时无法通过另一项测试。

paragraphs.en: The scope of a proposed modification determines which assumptions must be revalidated. Policy learning changes which actions are taken, and model-based practice can misestimate contact. A revision of memory, runtime, or resets can alter recovery, and a revision of feedback can change which failures are visible. For each candidate change, a record of assumptions should note what changed, which safeguard depends on it, what was rechecked, and which physical hazards remain unresolved. Table 15 applies this analysis to the objects that the four uses of retained change can modify.
paragraphs.zh: 提议修改的范围决定了哪些假设必须重新验证。 策略学习改变了采取哪些动作，而基于模型的实践可能会错误估计接触。 对记忆、运行时或重置的修改可以改变恢复过程，而对反馈的修改可以改变哪些失败是可见的。 对于每个候选修改，假设记录应注明修改了什么、哪个保障措施依赖于它、重新检查了什么，以及哪些物理危害仍未解决。 表 15 将此分析应用于保留修改的四种用途可以修改的对象。

paragraphs.en: A recent survey of self-evolving humanoid robots ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) similarly organizes safety around admissible changes, verification gates, and boundaries for human oversight, proposed as design principles for later testing; a survey of safety in self-evolving language-model agents ( Chen et al., 2026c ) finds the evidence strongest for admission and local containment and weakest for repairing what later versions inherit. A runtime guard can reduce risk while one candidate executes, yet the update process is safe only if admitting an update also revalidates the guard’s assumptions after the change.
paragraphs.zh: 一项关于自我进化人形机器人的近期综述（Nguyen et al., 2026）同样将安全围绕可允许的变更、验证关卡以及人类监督的边界来组织，并将其作为后续测试的设计原则；一项关于自我进化语言模型智能体安全性的综述（Chen et al., 2026c）发现，证据在准入与局部遏制方面最强，而在修复后续版本所继承的问题方面最弱。 运行时防护可以在候选执行期间降低风险，但只有当准入一次更新后还会在变更之后重新验证该防护的假设时，更新过程才是安全的。

paragraphs.en: A learning system can increase its recorded reward without improving the intended physical outcome. Several mechanisms produce this gap, and each needs its own defense. A misspecified objective rewards the wrong behavior; an ordinary evaluator error mismeasures an otherwise relevant outcome; specification gaming exploits an existing mismatch; and tampering changes the process that generates the learning signal. Amodei et al. (2016) separate problems such as side effects, reward hacking, and costly supervision, while Everitt et al. (2021) distinguish modifying the reward function from modifying its inputs. Moving the camera so that a slipping grasp is hidden affects the evaluator’s input, whereas editing the grasp-success checker affects the evaluator itself.
paragraphs.zh: 一个学习系统可以在不改善预期物理结果的情况下提高其记录到的奖励。 多种机制会产生这一差距，而每一种机制都需要各自的防御手段。 目标设定错误会奖励错误的行为；普通的评估器错误会错误地测量本应相关的结果；钻规范空子利用已有的不匹配；而篡改则会改变生成学习信号的过程。Amodei 等人 （2016）区分了副作用、奖励破解和高成本监督等问题，而 Everitt 等人 （2021）则区分了修改奖励函数与修改其输入。 移动摄像头以隐藏滑脱的抓取动作影响的是评估器的输入，而篡改抓取成功检查器影响的则是评估器本身。

paragraphs.en: Even ordinary evaluator errors matter once judged outcomes determine which experience is kept. Mirchandani et al. (2025) identify accurate success detection as part of the burden of designing environments for autonomous robot data collection. A false positive can place a failed contact in a dataset filtered for successes, after which training can reproduce the pattern that was mislabeled as success. No deliberate manipulation is required: a detector error at judgment time becomes a data error at update time and can return as a behavioral error in the next round. Versioning the evaluator together with the data it labeled makes this propagation traceable, though finding the wrong labels still requires an independent check. In SEAR’s simulated self-exploration ( Wang et al., 2026h ) , one agent run saved a success verifier that was wrong on 91% of the 699 later rollouts it declared successful, and the run ended at 4.6% success, against 15.5% and 23.6% for sibling runs without it.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦被判定的结果决定保留哪些经验，即使是普通的评估器错误也会产生影响。 Mirchandani 等人（2025）将准确的成功检测列为为自主机器人数据收集设计环境时负担的一部分。 假阳性可能把一次失败的接触放入一个按成功筛选的数据集中，此后训练可能复现这个被错误标记为成功的模式。 这不需要刻意的操纵：判定时刻的检测器错误会变成更新时刻的数据错误，并可能在下一轮以行为错误的形式回归。 将评估器与其标注的数据一同进行版本管理可以使这种传播可追溯，不过找出错误的标注仍然需要独立的检查。 在 SEAR 的模拟自我探索中（Wang 等人，2026h），一次智能体运行保存了一个成功验证器，在它判定为成功的 699 次后续 rollout 中有 91% 是错误的，该运行最终成功率为 4.6%，而未使用它的同类运行的成功率分别为 15.5% 和 23.6%。

paragraphs.en: Once feedback itself can be revised, testing a candidate evaluator only on outcomes or labels that it helped select becomes circular. Its admission test needs a protected success evaluation : a source of outcome judgments that the candidate update cannot also rewrite and that remains informative about the relevant physical failure. Depending on the hazard, this channel can combine held-out physical trials, write-protected raw measurements, dedicated instrumentation, and human review. ENPIRE’s verification services, which its coding agents cannot modify, are one physical instance. A report should state which failure modes the channel can reveal, which components it trusts, and which blind spots remain.

sents.zh: 视危险类型而定，这一通道可以结合留出的物理试验、写保护的原始测量数据、专用仪器以及人工审查。

paragraphs.en: An admission rule, or gate, turns protected evidence into a decision about whether a candidate update should run, trading the risk of accepting a harmful update against the cost of rejecting a useful one. In the notation of Section 2.2 , a confidence-based gate admits a candidate learner L ′ L^{\prime} only when a lower confidence bound on J ⁡ ( L ′ ) − J ⁡ ( L ) J(L^{\prime})-J(L) is positive. Batch RL formalized such gates early: high-confidence policy improvement guarantees, at a chosen confidence level, that a returned policy performs above a chosen lower bound ( Thomas et al., 2015 ) , and SPIBB falls back on the baseline policy wherever the data leave the estimate uncertain ( Laroche et al., 2019 ) . In a constructed one-step pushing diagnostic, Ma and Wu (2026) hold the stream of candidate updates fixed and find that a gate based on a conservative range-based confidence bound admits none of them, whereas a paired-binomial gate admits 31.6% of them at 2,000 episodes per stage; in separate closed-loop runs, always adopting the replay-trained update yields better learning than either gated alternative. The evidence is analytical and synthetic; a hardware safety comparison has yet to be run. Its broader lesson is that admission should report both how well it controls errors and how many learning opportunities it preserves at a stated interaction budget.
paragraphs.zh: 准入规则，或称门槛，将受保护的证据转化为关于候选更新是否应该运行的决策，在接受有害更新的风险与拒绝有用更新的代价之间进行权衡。 用第 2.2 节的记号，基于置信度的门槛仅在 J ⁡ ( L ′ ) − J ⁡ ( L ) J(L^{\prime})-J(L) 的置信下界为正时才接受候选学习器 L ′ L^{\prime}。 批量强化学习很早就对这类门槛进行了形式化：高置信度策略改进保证在选定的置信水平下确保返回的策略性能高于选定的下界（Thomas et al., 2015），而 SPIBB 在数据使估计不确定的地方回退到基线策略（Laroche et al., 2019）。 在一个构建的单步推动诊断实验中，Ma 和 Wu（2026）固定候选更新流，发现基于保守的区间置信下界的门槛一个都不接受，而配对二项门槛在每个阶段 2,000 个回合的设置下接受其中的 31.6%；在单独的闭环运行中，总是采用经重放训练的更新比两种门槛方案都取得更好的学习效果。 这些证据是分析性和合成性的；硬件安全对比尚未进行。 其更广泛的启示是，准入应当在既定交互预算下同时报告其控制错误的能力以及其保留的学习机会数量。

paragraphs.en: Robot-agent studies show the effect of the gate itself. When an optimizer agent revises a robot agent’s harness, accepting every revision degrades it within a few rounds, whereas a champion–challenger rule raises held-out success on simulated LIBERO tasks from 51% to 67% with 100 rollouts per round ( Wei et al., 2026b ) . In simulation, Robo-COP ( Zhang et al., 2026i ) reaches 73.8% when it adopts a fine-tuned policy only after verifying an improvement, against 65.8% for fine-tuning on a fixed schedule. A gate should also report what a candidate loses: a net gain can hide cases that the previous version solved, so a per-task regression check belongs beside the aggregate test. RegenHarness ( Wang et al., 2026b ) makes such a protocol explicit for a robot-agent harness: a candidate change to context rules, task templates, routing, or recovery policies is accepted only if it preserves safety and evidence contracts, passes designated regression checks, improves a predeclared metric, and receives release authorization. The updater cannot weaken its own acceptance rule. Its real quadruped deployment documents the runtime rather than measuring gains from revision.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人-智能体研究显示的是闸门本身的效果。 当一个优化智能体修改机器人智能体的运行框架时，接受每一次修改会在几轮内使其退化，而冠军-挑战者规则在每轮 100 次试运行的模拟 LIBERO 任务上，将留出集成功率从 51% 提升到 67%（Wei et al., 2026b）。 在模拟中，Robo-COP（Zhang et al., 2026i）仅在验证改进后才采用微调策略，达到 73.8%，而按固定时间表进行微调则为 65.8%。 闸门还应报告候选方案损失了什么：净收益可能掩盖先前版本已解决的情况，因此按任务的回归检查应与聚合测试并列。 RegenHarness（Wang et al., 2026b）为机器人智能体的运行框架明确了这样一个协议：对上下文规则、任务模板、路由或恢复策略的候选修改，只有在保持安全与证据契约、通过指定的回归检查、改进预先声明的指标并获得发布授权时才会被接受。 更新器不能削弱自己的接受规则。 其真实的四足机器人部署文档记录的是运行时情况，而非衡量修改带来的收益。

paragraphs.en: Once a candidate is admitted, runtime mechanisms limit what each trial can do, and they intervene at different points. The shield of Alshiekh et al. (2018) corrects actions that would violate a property stated in temporal logic, a formal language for requirements over time such as “never enter this region”. The learned monitor of Liu et al. (2024) instead predicts states that are out of distribution or likely to fail and requests human oversight. The first is conditional on a specification and a model of the environment; the second is conditional on learned dynamics, failure labels, and the coverage of deployment. Neither protects against a hazard absent from its representation.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦候选方案被采纳，运行时机制会限制每次试验能做什么，并且它们会在不同时点进行干预。 Alshiekh 等人的屏蔽机制 （2018）会纠正违反以时序逻辑表述的性质的动作，时序逻辑是一种用于描述随时间变化的需求的形式化语言，例如「永不进入该区域」。 Liu 等人的学习型监控器 （2024）则预测超出分布或可能失败的状态，并请求人类监督。 前者依赖于规约和环境模型；后者依赖于学习到的动力学、失败标签以及部署的覆盖范围。 两者都无法防范其表示中不存在的危险。

sents.en: The shield of Alshiekh et al.
sents.zh: Alshiekh 等人的屏蔽机制

sents.en: Neither protects against a hazard absent from its representation.
sents.zh: 两者都无法防范其表示中不存在的危险。

paragraphs.en: Other mechanisms move the check earlier or broaden the boundary around execution. VASO ( Yang et al., 2026e ) checks whole plans, model-checking skill-based plans against temporal specifications and using counterexamples to revise reusable skill contracts; GLIDE ( Song et al., 2026c ) checks single commands, filtering teleoperation and policy commands through task-specific executable guardrails; and PhyAgentOS ( Liu et al., 2026h ) wraps whole supervised sessions in compatibility checks before execution, verification, monitoring, and evidence collection. Safe online system identification ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) shows the value of stating assumptions precisely: its informative manipulator trajectories respect modeled input, state, and collision constraints, while its bounds on estimated parameters assume bounded sensor noise. Formal compliance, learned failure prediction, command filtering, and runtime mediation provide different kinds of evidence, and none translates directly into an unconditional probability of physical safety.
paragraphs.zh: 其他机制将检查提前，或扩大执行周围的边界。 VASO（Yang et al., 2026e）检查整个计划，将基于技能的计划与时间规约进行模型检验，并利用反例来修订可复用的技能契约；GLIDE（Song et al., 2026c）检查单条指令，通过任务特定的可执行护栏过滤遥操作和策略指令；PhyAgentOS（Liu et al., 2026h）在执行、验证、监控和证据收集之前，将整个受监督会话包裹在兼容性检查中。 安全在线系统辨识（Zhang et al., 2025a）展示了精确陈述假设的价值：其信息丰富的机械臂轨迹遵循建模的输入、状态和碰撞约束，而其对估计参数的界则假设传感器噪声有界。 形式化合规、学习式失败预测、指令过滤和运行时中介提供的是不同种类的证据，没有哪一种能直接转化为物理安全的无条件概率。

paragraphs.en: Systems that change their own software require a further boundary around authority. An updater should receive only the tool, file, network, and actuation permissions needed for the current experiment, while an independently controlled deployment service retains emergency stops, workspace limits, safety-critical calibration, and the authority to approve promotion. Each proposed change needs a provenance record linking the generating model, the prompt or memory used, the code diff, the data and evaluator versions, the test results, and the decision. A correct outcome does not show that each action rested on evidence gathered first; Lin et al. (2026) make this point for tool-using software agents by auditing trajectories against a provenance-bound evidence ledger. The checker can still err, but no single permission path can then silently rewrite both the candidate and every mechanism intended to assess it.
paragraphs.zh: 能更改自身软件的系统需要在权限边界之外再设一道权威边界。 更新程序应只获得当前实验所需的工具、文件、网络与执行权限，而由一个独立受控的部署服务保留紧急停止、工作区限制、安全关键校准以及批准晋升的权限。 每项拟议的更改都需要一条溯源记录，将生成模型、所用的提示词或记忆、代码差异、数据与评估器版本、测试结果以及决策关联起来。 一个正确的结果并不能表明每个动作都是基于先行收集的证据做出的；Lin 等人 （2026）通过对照溯源绑定证据账本审计轨迹，对使用工具的软件智能体阐明了这一点。 检查器仍可能出错，但此时没有任何单一权限路径能够悄然改写候选系统以及旨在评估它的所有机制。

paragraphs.en: Promotion can then proceed from sandboxed tests of interfaces and logic to guarded physical trials within a declared operating envelope. Each stage should record which assumptions it tested and which physical unknowns remain; success in simulation alone cannot establish contact safety or hardware compatibility. Recovery also has to respect dependencies among components. A previous grasp policy may no longer work with a revised model, memory schema, or runtime, so rollback should restore a compatible versioned bundle rather than an isolated checkpoint. Even such a rollback restores only computational state. Trial limits and a stopping mechanism are still required before an update is admitted, because no rollback can undo a crushed object or a damaged gripper.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，推广可以从针对接口和逻辑的沙箱化测试，推进到在声明运行包络内的受控物理试验。 每个阶段都应记录其检验了哪些假设、还有哪些物理未知因素；仅凭仿真中的成功无法确立接触安全性或硬件兼容性。 恢复也必须尊重组件之间的依赖关系。 先前的抓取策略在与修订后的模型、记忆模式或运行时配合时可能不再有效，因此回滚应恢复一个兼容的版本化捆绑包，而不是孤立的检查点。 即便这样的回滚也只恢复计算状态。 在更新被采纳之前仍需要试验限制和停止机制，因为任何回滚都无法撤销一个被压碎的物体或损坏的夹爪。

sents.en: Promotion can then proceed from sandboxed tests of interfaces and logic to guarded physical trials within a declared operating envelope.
sents.zh: 随后，推广可以从针对接口和逻辑的沙箱化测试，推进到在声明运行包络内的受控物理试验。

sents.en: Each stage should record which assumptions it tested and which physical unknowns remain; success in simulation alone cannot establish contact safety or hardware compatibility.
sents.zh: 每个阶段都应记录其检验了哪些假设、还有哪些物理未知因素；仅凭仿真中的成功无法确立接触安全性或硬件兼容性。

sents.en: Recovery also has to respect dependencies among components.
sents.zh: 恢复也必须尊重组件之间的依赖关系。

sents.en: A previous grasp policy may no longer work with a revised model, memory schema, or runtime, so rollback should restore a compatible versioned bundle rather than an isolated checkpoint.
sents.zh: 先前的抓取策略在与修订后的模型、记忆模式或运行时配合时可能不再有效，因此回滚应恢复一个兼容的版本化捆绑包，而不是孤立的检查点。

sents.en: Even such a rollback restores only computational state.
sents.zh: 即便这样的回滚也只恢复计算状态。

sents.en: Trial limits and a stopping mechanism are still required before an update is admitted, because no rollback can undo a crushed object or a damaged gripper.
sents.zh: 在更新被采纳之前仍需要试验限制和停止机制，因为任何回滚都无法撤销一个被压碎的物体或损坏的夹爪。

paragraphs.en: Gates and safeguards face a practical dilemma: continuous human monitoring limits scale, but removing supervision leaves unfamiliar failures without a reliable response. Human attention is most informative where automation lacks either a safe action or trustworthy evidence: before an irreversible contact, at a state the policy has not been trained on, when outcome signals disagree, or when a safety-relevant component is proposed for revision. These situations assign the human different roles: taking control prevents harm, a corrective action supplies a learning target, an audit adjudicates an outcome, and an approval authorizes a change. Recording these roles separately matters, because one intervention can otherwise be counted simultaneously as safety, as training data, and as evidence of autonomy. Interruptions can also bias what is learned: an agent rewarded for finishing a task may learn to avoid being stopped, and safe interruptibility requires that learning neither seek nor avoid interruptions, a property that off-policy learners such as Q-learning already have and Sarsa can be given ( Orseau and Armstrong, 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 门控与保障机制面临一个现实困境：持续的人类监督限制了规模，而取消监督又会使陌生故障得不到可靠的应对。 人类注意力在自动化既缺乏安全动作、又缺乏可信证据之处最有价值：在不可逆接触发生之前，在策略未曾训练过的状态上，当结果信号相互矛盾时，或当某个与安全相关的组件被提出修改时。 这些情境赋予人类不同的角色：接管控制以防止伤害，纠正性动作为学习提供目标，审计对结果作出裁决，而批准则授权一项变更。 分别记录这些角色很重要，否则一次干预可能同时被计入安全保障、训练数据和自主性证据。 中断还可能使学习产生偏差：因完成任务而获得奖励的智能体可能学会避免被打断，而安全可中断性要求学习既不寻求也不规避中断——Q-learning 等离策略学习器已经具备这一性质，Sarsa 也可以被赋予该性质（Orseau and Armstrong, 2016）。

paragraphs.en: Timing determines whether an intervention supplies that information. HIL-SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) uses demonstrations and human corrections during real-world RL, intervening often early in training and less as performance improves. ThriftyDAgger ( Hoque et al., 2022a ) requests help at states that are novel to a policy ensemble or risky under a learned estimate of task success, with thresholds set from an intervention budget. SAGE ( Hu et al., 2026a ) makes the threshold itself adaptive, so that predicted risk, uncertainty, and novelty decide when an expert policy takes over. These illustrate two allocation strategies, operator judgment and learned triage; neither is shown to detect every unsafe state. A late intervention may rescue the object without preventing a dangerous contact, whereas an overly conservative trigger can replace so much autonomy that the learner learns little about the limits of its competence.
paragraphs.zh: 时机决定了干预是否提供该信息。 HIL-SERL（Luo et al., 2025）在真实世界强化学习中使用演示和人类纠正，在训练早期频繁干预，随着性能提升而减少干预。 ThriftyDAgger（Hoque et al., 2022a）在对于策略集成来说是新状态、或在习得的任务成功估计下有风险的那些状态上请求帮助，阈值由干预预算设定。 SAGE（Hu et al., 2026a）使阈值本身具有自适应性，从而由预测风险、不确定性和新颖性决定专家策略何时接管。 这些例子展示了两种分配策略，即操作员判断和习得的分诊；但两者都未被证明能检测出所有不安全状态。 过晚的干预也许能挽救物体，却无法阻止危险接触；而过于保守的触发则会取代过多的自主性，使学习者几乎无法了解自身能力范围的局限。

sents.zh: 时机决定了干预是否提供该信息。

paragraphs.en: A rescue also changes how the episode should be learned from. If an autonomous grasp starts to slip and a person then completes the lift, crediting the final success to the entire trajectory can reinforce the very action that required correction. TORL-VLA ( Zheng et al., 2026a ) addresses this case in real-robot experiments with an intervention-censored critic, which prevents success achieved after an intervention from being credited to the policy’s actions before the takeover. The broader requirement is a record of who was in control: each transition should identify who acted, why control changed, and which later outcomes may legitimately supervise the preceding decision.
paragraphs.zh: 一次接管（干预）也会改变应当如何从该回合（episode）中学习。 如果一次自主抓取开始打滑，随后由人完成提起动作，把最终成功归功于整条轨迹，可能会强化恰恰需要纠正的那个动作。 TORL-VLA（Zheng et al., 2026a）在真实机器人实验中通过干预截断的评论家（critic）来处理这种情况，防止在干预之后取得的成功被归功于智能体在被接管之前的动作。 更广泛的要求是记录谁在控制：每个转移都应标明是谁在行动、控制为何改变，以及哪些后续结果可以合法地监督先前的决策。

sents.en: A rescue also changes how the episode should be learned from.
sents.zh: 一次接管（干预）也会改变应当如何从该回合（episode）中学习。

paragraphs.en: Fewer takeovers can coexist with more oversight overall, because control effort may fall while learning effort (demonstrations, corrections, and outcome labels) or assurance effort (audits, calibration, checker maintenance, and approvals) rises. Reports should separate these costs and state the trigger, who has authority to respond, and how quickly the supervisor can act. The broader survey of recursive self-improvement by Chen et al. (2026d) likewise treats the closing of the loop as a continuum and identifies evaluation and the setting of research direction as persistent human bottlenecks. For physical systems, a meaningful claim about autonomy names which decisions became reliably automated and where in the loop supervision moved.
paragraphs.zh: 更少的接管可以与更多的总体监督并存，因为控制性投入可能下降，而学习性投入（演示、纠正和结果标注）或保障性投入（审计、校准、检查器维护和批准）可能上升。 报告应将这些成本分开列明，并说明触发条件、谁有权响应，以及监督者能在多快的时间内采取行动。 Chen 等人对递归自我改进的更广泛的综述 （2026d）同样将闭环视为一个连续体，并指出评估和研究方向的设定是持续存在的人类瓶颈。 对于物理系统，关于自主性的有意义的主张应指明哪些决策已被可靠地自动化，以及监督在闭环中的哪个环节发生了移动。

sents.en: The broader survey of recursive self-improvement by Chen et al.
sents.zh: Chen 等人对递归自我改进的更广泛的综述

sents.zh: （2026d）同样将闭环视为一个连续体，并指出评估和研究方向的设定是持续存在的人类瓶颈。

sents.zh: 对于物理系统，关于自主性的有意义的主张应指明哪些决策已被可靠地自动化，以及监督在闭环中的哪个环节发生了移动。

paragraphs.en: Proposing a change, admitting it, executing it, and judging its outcome can be run by the same people, as long as the four steps do not all depend on the same mutable component or unprotected signal and each stage retains evidence or control capable of exposing and containing failure in the preceding one.
paragraphs.zh: 提出变更、承认变更、执行变更以及评判其结果，可以由同一批人完成，前提是这四个步骤并非全部依赖同一个可变组件或未受保护的信号，并且每个阶段都保留能够揭露和遏制前一阶段失败的证据或控制手段。

paragraphs.en: Admission and rollback act on one candidate at a time; a system that revises its own learning procedure must also ask whether the evidence behind its safeguards survives the revision. Three questions recur. First, does earlier safety evidence still apply? A guard validated for one controller, action normalization, or reset routine holds only for what it was validated on. FAN shows that updating action-normalization statistics shifts the coordinates shared by training and execution, so a bound stated in the old coordinates would need rechecking, and Table 15 lists how other revisions can invalidate safety assumptions. Each generation therefore needs a record of which checks were run against which component versions, and a rule that marks dependent checks as stale when those versions change.
paragraphs.zh: 准入与回滚一次只作用于一个候选；一个修订自身学习过程的系统还必须追问，其安全保障背后的证据是否能在修订中存活下来。有三个问题反复出现。 第一，较早的安全证据是否仍然适用？ 针对某个控制器、动作归一化或重置例程验证过的保护措施，只对它被验证时针对的内容有效。 FAN 表明，更新动作归一化统计量会改变训练与执行所共享的坐标系，因此以旧坐标系表述的界需要重新检查，表 15 列出了其他修订如何会使安全假设失效。 因此，每一代都需要一份记录，说明哪些检查是针对哪些组件版本运行的，并需要一条规则，当这些版本发生变化时，将依赖这些版本的检查标记为过时。

paragraphs.en: Second, who may change the safety boundary? ENPIRE builds its safety, reset, and verification services in a human-guided stage and exposes them as interfaces that its coding agents cannot modify, and RegenHarness forbids its updater to weaken its own acceptance rule; the same separation should extend to the improver, so that a revision of the learning procedure cannot also relax the checks that judge it.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，谁可以更改安全边界？ ENPIRE 在人工引导的阶段中构建其安全、重置与验证服务，并将它们暴露为其编码智能体无法修改的接口，而 RegenHarness 禁止其更新器削弱自身的验收规则；同样的分离应扩展到改进器，使得对学习程序的修订无法同时放宽用于评判它的检查。

sents.en: Second, who may change the safety boundary?
sents.zh: 其次，谁可以更改安全边界？

sents.en: ENPIRE builds its safety, reset, and verification services in a human-guided stage and exposes them as interfaces that its coding agents cannot modify, and RegenHarness forbids its updater to weaken its own acceptance rule; the same separation should extend to the improver, so that a revision of the learning procedure cannot also relax the checks that judge it.

paragraphs.en: Third, how are regressions across versions and bodies caught? A net gain can hide cases that the previous version solved, and a hardware change such as a replaced gripper can invalidate behavior that no software rollback restores; regression suites carried across generations and rerun after hardware changes keep earlier competence and safety margins visible. These requirements are inferred from the reviewed failures; testing them over several generations of a self-revising physical system is part of the open problem of surviving system changes (Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第三，如何捕捉跨版本和跨实体的回归问题？ 净收益可能掩盖旧版本已解决的情况，而更换夹爪等硬件变更可能使任何软件回滚都无法恢复的行为失效；跨越各代持续保留的回归测试套件，以及在硬件变更后重新运行，可以让此前的能力和安全余量保持可见。 这些要求是从所审查的失败案例中推断出来的；在自改进物理系统的多代演化中测试这些要求，是应对系统变化的开放性问题（第 4.2 节）的一部分。

sents.zh: 第三，如何捕捉跨版本和跨实体的回归问题？

paragraphs.en: Self-improving robots also raise questions that safety engineering does not settle. Fleet learning gathers experience in homes and workplaces, as when OpenBot-Fleet ( Müller et al., 2024 ) uploads data from user-operated robots, so consent, retention, and access to recorded scenes become part of the design of the learning loop. When a robot revises its own learning procedure, responsibility for a harmful update must also stay traceable; the provenance records and separated authority described above serve accountability as well as safety.

paragraphs.en: A recursive improver must decide what to repair and what to try before it can learn from its repairs. This subsection takes these capabilities in turn, from diagnosis and experiment choice to transferable repair knowledge, and then designs the test that would show the loop closing.
paragraphs.zh: 一个递归改进智能体在能够从其修复中学习之前，必须先决定要修复什么以及要尝试什么。 本小节依次讨论这些能力，从诊断与实验选择到可迁移的修复知识，然后设计能够表明循环闭合的测试。

sents.en: A recursive improver must decide what to repair and what to try before it can learn from its repairs.
sents.zh: 一个递归改进智能体在能够从其修复中学习之前，必须先决定要修复什么以及要尝试什么。

sents.en: This subsection takes these capabilities in turn, from diagnosis and experiment choice to transferable repair knowledge, and then designs the test that would show the loop closing.
sents.zh: 本小节依次讨论这些能力，从诊断与实验选择到可迁移的修复知识，然后设计能够表明循环闭合的测试。

paragraphs.en: The agenda begins with diagnosis because changing the wrong component consumes physical trials and can obscure the evidence needed for the next attempt. The same observed failure can have several causes, as the missed grasp of Section 1 shows, so a failure label alone cannot determine which repair to choose. Calling a component the bottleneck therefore states a hypothesis to be tested against other, interacting explanations; logs can narrow those explanations but rarely determine which change will improve downstream behavior, and Table 16 separates evidence that supports a diagnosis before intervention from comparisons that test a candidate repair after intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 议程从诊断开始，因为改错组件会消耗实体试验次数，并可能掩盖下一次尝试所需的证据。 同一个观察到的失败可能有多种原因，正如第 1 节中未成功抓取的例子所示，因此仅凭失败标签无法确定应选择哪种修复。 因此，把某个组件称为瓶颈是在陈述一个待检验的假设，需要将其与其他相互作用的解释进行对照；日志可以缩小这些解释的范围，但很少能确定哪种改动会改善下游行为，表 16 区分了在干预之前支持某一诊断的证据与在干预之后检验候选修复的对比实验。

sents.zh: 议程从诊断开始，因为改错组件会消耗实体试验次数，并可能掩盖下一次尝试所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: Physical traces make this inference harder because they are partial and often censored by safety mechanisms. An intervention may prevent the failure that would have revealed the weakness, while the final rescued success may conceal which autonomous transition required correction. A diagnostic trace should align observations, proposed actions, executed actions, any shield or human modification, feedback versions, and intervention timing. Unobserved signals should stay marked as unknown, never counted as evidence that a component worked. The bottleneck is the component hypothesized to limit the next improvement, given the available repairs; diagnosing it does not presuppose a single independent root cause.
paragraphs.zh: 物理痕迹使这种推断更加困难，因为它们是不完整的，而且常常被安全机制屏蔽。 一次干预可能防止了原本会暴露弱点的失败，而最终被挽救的成功可能掩盖了哪一次自主转换需要纠正。 一份诊断性痕迹记录应当将观察结果、提议的动作、已执行的动作、任何屏蔽或人工修改、反馈版本以及干预时机对齐起来。 未被观察到的信号应保持标记为未知，绝不能被算作某个组件正常工作的证据。 瓶颈是在现有修复手段下，被假设为限制下一次改进的组件；诊断它并不预设存在单一独立的根本原因。

sents.zh: 未被观察到的信号应保持标记为未知，绝不能被算作某个组件正常工作的证据。

sents.en: The bottleneck is the component hypothesized to limit the next improvement, given the available repairs; diagnosing it does not presuppose a single independent root cause.
sents.zh: 瓶颈是在现有修复手段下，被假设为限制下一次改进的组件；诊断它并不预设存在单一独立的根本原因。

paragraphs.en: Failure explanation is a natural starting point. REFLECT ( Liu et al., 2023c ) summarizes multisensory robot experience hierarchically and asks a language model to explain failures and plan corrections, and AHA ( Duan et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a vision-language model on procedurally perturbed demonstrations to detect and explain manipulation failures. Both explain a failure from the recorded episode alone. A diagnostic system should go further, keeping competing explanations ranked and choosing a small, safe probe expected to separate them before attempting a costly repair. A concrete benchmark could inject matched policy, model, evaluator, and interface faults that produce similar terminal outcomes within the same task family. Single faults would test basic identification; unseen combinations and intervention-censored traces would test whether the method preserves uncertainty when causes interact or evidence is missing. Fault injection supplies controlled causal labels but not full realism, so the resulting repair choices should also be tested on held-out, naturally occurring hardware failures. Evaluation should measure calibrated cause rankings, information gained per probe, and, most importantly, whether the selected repair improves downstream behavior from matched starting points and physical budgets. This last test separates useful diagnosis from classification that merely names the injected fault.
paragraphs.zh: 失败解释是一个自然的起点。 REFLECT（Liu et al., 2023c）以分层方式总结多感官机器人经验，并让语言模型解释失败和规划纠正；AHA（Duan et al., 2025）则在经过程序性扰动的示范数据上微调视觉-语言模型，以检测和解释操作失败。 两者都仅从记录的经历片段来解释失败。 一个诊断系统应该更进一步，保持多种竞争性解释的排序，并在尝试代价高昂的修复之前，选择一个预期能够区分这些解释的小型、安全的探测。 一个具体的基准测试可以在同一任务族内注入会产生相似终端结果的匹配的策略、模型、评估器和接口故障。 单一故障用于测试基本的识别能力；未见过的故障组合和干预被删失的轨迹用于测试该方法在原因相互作用或证据缺失时能否保持不确定性。 故障注入提供了受控的因果标签，但并不具备完全的真实性，因此由此产生的修复选择还应在留出的、自然发生的硬件故障上进行测试。 评估应衡量校准的原因排序、每次探测获得的信息量，以及最重要的，所选修复是否能在相同的起点和物理预算下改善下游行为。 最后一项测试将有助于诊断与仅仅为注入故障命名的分类区分开来。

paragraphs.en: While several causes remain plausible, the most diagnostic experiment and the most useful learning experience can differ. Suppose a grasp failure could reflect either a missing recovery action or an incorrect contact model. Repeating the contact with additional force sensing may separate those explanations, but evidence of a contact-model error helps only if a model update can represent the discrepancy and a later learner can use the revised prediction. An expert correction supplies an immediately usable action target, yet may leave the contact-model error unresolved. An experiment is useful for learning only if an available update method can use the evidence it provides, so its value depends on which uncertainty it reduces and whether the resulting update improves behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管多种原因仍然可能成立，但最具诊断价值的实验与最有用的学习经历可能并不相同。 假设一次抓取失败既可能反映缺少恢复动作，也可能反映接触模型不正确。 在重复该接触时增加力感知或许能区分这两种解释，但接触模型错误的证据只有在模型更新能够表达该偏差、且后续学习器能够使用修正后的预测时才有帮助。 专家纠正提供了一个可立即使用的动作目标，却可能让接触模型错误悬而未决。 只有当可用的更新方法能够利用实验所提供的证据时，该实验才对学习有用，因此其价值取决于它减少的是哪种不确定性，以及由此产生的更新能否改进行为。

paragraphs.en: An experiment also incurs reset, wear, intervention, and safety costs immediately, whereas its learning benefit appears only after updating and redeployment. Some informative states cannot be revisited safely, yet a promising repair may need one. A staged selector could first use stored traces, counterfactual replay, or short model-based probes, then request new contact or correction only while the remaining explanations would lead to different usable updates. Cheap probes narrow the question but cannot resolve a physical distinction that their data or model omits.
paragraphs.zh: 实验还会立即产生重置、损耗、干预和安全成本，而其学习收益只有在更新并重新部署之后才会显现。 有些信息性状态无法被安全地再次访问，但一个有前景的修复却可能需要这样做。 分阶段的智能体选择器可以首先使用存储的轨迹、反事实回放或简短的基于模型的探测，只有在剩余的各种解释会导致不同的可用更新时，才请求新的接触或纠正。 廉价的探测可以缩小问题范围，但无法解决其数据或模型所遗漏的物理差异。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark for this problem should compare joint experiment–update selection with fixed collection, information-gain-only selection, and a sequential baseline that diagnoses first and chooses an update afterward, scoring held-out behavioral improvement rather than predicted information gain under the reporting rules of Section 4.1 . Ablating either the predicted information gain or the predicted usability of the evidence would show which part of the joint decision matters.
paragraphs.zh: 针对该问题的基准测试应当比较联合的实验—更新选择与固定采集、仅基于信息增益的选择，以及先诊断后选择更新的顺序基线，并依据第 4.1 节的报告规则，以留出的行为改进作为评分，而非以预测的信息增益作为评分。 若分别消融预测的信息增益或证据的预测可用性，就能看出这一联合决策的哪个部分起作用。

paragraphs.en: Recursion requires retaining what was learned from a repair, not only the repaired policy. A stored edit without its applicability conditions supports patch reuse, and a searcher that keeps rediscovering edits repeats a search rather than learning from earlier repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 递归要求保留从修复中学到的内容，而不仅仅是修复后的策略。 只存储编辑而不存储其适用条件，仅支持补丁复用；而一个不断重新发现编辑的搜索器，只是在重复搜索，而不是从先前的修复中学习。

sents.en: Recursion requires retaining what was learned from a repair, not only the repaired policy.
sents.zh: 递归要求保留从修复中学到的内容，而不仅仅是修复后的策略。

sents.en: A stored edit without its applicability conditions supports patch reuse, and a searcher that keeps rediscovering edits repeats a search rather than learning from earlier repairs.
sents.zh: 只存储编辑而不存储其适用条件，仅支持补丁复用；而一个不断重新发现编辑的搜索器，只是在重复搜索，而不是从先前的修复中学习。

paragraphs.en: Learning such knowledge requires histories that expose both success and failure. The same slip penalty can help one grasping policy and harm another because their exploration differs; a code repair can depend on an API, timing convention, sensor, or control rate. Each record should connect the proposed explanation and unresolved alternatives, attempted change, starting competence, component and interface versions, data and feedback, physical conditions, resources spent, and downstream successes or regressions. Failed revisions do more than serve as negative examples: they identify missing prerequisites or incorrect causal explanations. Selectively recording only accepted patches would make an editor appear more reliable while removing the evidence needed to decide when not to reuse them.
paragraphs.zh: 学习这类知识需要同时暴露成功与失败的历史记录。 同样的失误惩罚可能有助于一个抓取策略却损害另一个，因为它们的探索方式不同；一次代码修复可能依赖于某个 API、时序约定、传感器或控制频率。 每条记录都应关联所提出的解释与尚未解决的备选方案、尝试的改动、初始能力水平、组件与接口版本、数据与反馈、物理条件、所消耗的资源，以及下游的成功或退化。 失败的修改不仅是作为反面示例：它们还能识别出缺失的前提条件或错误的因果解释。 只选择性记录被接受的补丁，会让编辑者显得更可靠，同时却移除了判断何时不应复用这些补丁所需的证据。

sents.en: Learning such knowledge requires histories that expose both success and failure.
sents.zh: 学习这类知识需要同时暴露成功与失败的历史记录。

sents.en: The same slip penalty can help one grasping policy and harm another because their exploration differs; a code repair can depend on an API, timing convention, sensor, or control rate.
sents.zh: 同样的失误惩罚可能有助于一个抓取策略却损害另一个，因为它们的探索方式不同；一次代码修复可能依赖于某个 API、时序约定、传感器或控制频率。

sents.en: Each record should connect the proposed explanation and unresolved alternatives, attempted change, starting competence, component and interface versions, data and feedback, physical conditions, resources spent, and downstream successes or regressions.
sents.zh: 每条记录都应关联所提出的解释与尚未解决的备选方案、尝试的改动、初始能力水平、组件与接口版本、数据与反馈、物理条件、所消耗的资源，以及下游的成功或退化。

sents.en: Failed revisions do more than serve as negative examples: they identify missing prerequisites or incorrect causal explanations.
sents.zh: 失败的修改不仅是作为反面示例：它们还能识别出缺失的前提条件或错误的因果解释。

sents.en: Selectively recording only accepted patches would make an editor appear more reliable while removing the evidence needed to decide when not to reuse them.
sents.zh: 只选择性记录被接受的补丁，会让编辑者显得更可靠，同时却移除了判断何时不应复用这些补丁所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: The main open problem is how to use accumulating real-robot revision histories to learn a procedure improver that transfers across failure types, and to verify that it also helps produce its own next improvement. If what is learned does not transfer beyond near-duplicates of past failures, repair knowledge amounts to a library of patches, and the two-round test below reduces to a test of reuse. The improver must separate transferable gains from those due to extra data, a stronger starting policy, or a changed apparatus, and recognize when to reuse an earlier repair, adapt it, or seek a different explanation. Benchmark tasks should vary starting competence, feedback versions, interfaces, and physical conditions while keeping tools, opportunities, and budgets matched. Direct retrieval of an old patch should be reported as reuse; a transferable repair principle should pass both comparisons of Figure 9 on held-out failure families.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的开放问题在于，如何利用不断累积的实体机器人修订历史，学习一个能够跨故障类型迁移的程序改进器，并验证它是否也有助于产生它自己的下一次改进。 如果学到的东西不能迁移到过去故障的近似重复之外，那么修复知识就只是一个补丁库，下文的两轮检验也就退化为对复用能力的检验。 改进器必须区分可迁移的收益与那些来自额外数据、更强初始策略或已更改装置的收益，并识别何时复用先前的修复、对其加以调整，或寻求不同的解释。 基准任务应在起始能力、反馈版本、接口和物理条件上有所变化，同时保持工具、机会和预算相匹配。 直接检索旧补丁应报告为复用；一个可迁移的修复原则应能在留出的故障族上通过图9的两项对比检验。

paragraphs.en: Can a system learn from attempted repairs to improve the way it produces further improvements? The two links of Section 2.2 describe a causal dependence across revisions, which no count of mutable components, checkpoints, or autonomous steps can establish. Section 4.1 sets out the judgments that a recursive claim must keep apart; the two-round test below would isolate either link for a learning procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 一个系统能否从尝试过的修复中学习，以改进其产生进一步改进的方式？ 2.2 节的两条链接描述了跨修订的因果依赖，任何对可变组件、检查点或自主步骤的计数都无法确立这种依赖。 4.1 节列出了一个递归性主张必须加以区分的判断；下文的两轮测试将为学习过程隔离出其中任一链接。

paragraphs.en: Each of the four routes can supply the object of a recursive test: a rule for changing that route, together with records of how earlier changes fared.
paragraphs.zh: 四条路径中的每一条都可以为递归测试提供对象：一条用于改变该路径的规则，以及关于早期改变效果如何的记录。

paragraphs.en: For policies , the natural rule to revise is the one that chooses which experience to collect. A criticality model already steers collection toward likely failures and, in two simulated multi-round runs, is retrained on the current policy’s rollouts each round; a recursive version would also learn, from which collections taught later learners, how to revise that criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 对于策略而言，最值得修订的自然规则就是那条决定收集哪些经验的规则。 关键度模型本身已经引导数据收集偏向可能出现的失败，并且在两次模拟的多轮运行中，每一轮都会基于当前策略的轨迹进行重新训练；递归版本还会进一步学习——从哪些数据收集成果启发了后续的学习者中，学会如何修订该标准。

paragraphs.en: For world models , the rule decides when a model may judge. A learned model is the closest physical counterpart of the executable tests that make digital RSI cheap, because it can screen candidate changes before hardware trials, but its judgments must themselves be checked. On a physical arm, a world-model judge fine-tuned only on successes scores most held-out failing sequences as success-like, and fine-tuning on execution-checked counterfactual failures reduces this sharply ( Xu et al., 2026c ) . A recursive version would learn from such mismatches how to refresh the judge, so that each refresh leaves fewer errors for the next.
paragraphs.zh: 对于世界模型而言，规则决定模型何时可以做出判断。 学习到的模型是使数字式递归自我改进变得廉价的可执行测试在物理世界中最接近的对应物，因为它可以在硬件试验之前筛选候选变更，但其判断本身也必须被检验。 在物理机械臂上，仅用成功样本微调的世界模型裁判会将大多数留出的失败序列判为类似成功，而在经执行检验的反事实失败上微调则能显著降低这一现象 ( Xu et al., 2026c ) 。 递归版本可以从这类不匹配中学习如何刷新裁判，使每次刷新都为下一轮留下更少的错误。

paragraphs.en: The first two steps test the first link and the third tests the second, as stated by the R1 and R2 inequalities of Section 2.2 (Figure 9 ); retention, performance under changed conditions, and sustainable resource use decide whether the relation is useful beyond a local controlled test. SEAR ( Wang et al., 2026h ) already supplies benchmark controls for such tests, separating retained experience from repeated attempts, task familiarity, privileged state, larger budgets, and chance.
paragraphs.zh: 前两个步骤检验第一个环节，第三个步骤检验第二个环节，如第 2.2 节的 R1 和 R2 不等式所述（图 9）；而保持性、在条件变化下的表现以及可持续的资源使用，则决定这种关系在局部受控测试之外是否有用。 SEAR（Wang et al., 2026h）已经为此类测试提供了基准对照，将保留的经验与重复尝试、任务熟悉度、特权状态、更大的预算以及偶然因素区分开来。

paragraphs.en: A successor can score higher because of accumulated experience or a stronger starting system rather than a better improvement mechanism, as a concurrent survey also notes ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) . Three details decide whether the test is informative. First, freezing must match the form of the improver’s knowledge: a parametric improver is compared with its earlier checkpoint, a retrieval-based improver with its earlier memory snapshot, and an improver whose knowledge lives in code or prompts with their earlier versions, while the base model, tools, and budget stay the same. This suffices for R1, but R2 also requires the control revision to start from the same parent. That holds when the acquired knowledge can be withheld without changing the rest of the improver, as with a memory snapshot or separable code or prompts; when the knowledge lives in the improver’s weights, restoring the earlier checkpoint also changes the parent, so the R2 control for a parametric improver needs a design of its own. Second, the new failure families must be held out from everything the improver has learned from; otherwise the comparison measures memorization. Third, the physical cost should be staged: candidate procedures can be screened in simulation or on stored traces, so that hardware trials go to matched learners for the few candidates that survive. With one survivor per improver, the two comparisons need four hardware-trained learners per seed, because the updated improver’s learner from the first comparison also serves as the parent baseline of the second: about 1,200 refinement rollouts at FIERCE’s per-condition budget, excluding evaluation, resets, and repetition across failure families. Digital precedents run close analogues of both comparisons when evaluation is cheap; the physical version adds protected outcomes and a matched downstream learner. SpecRSI’s same-artifact comparison, which runs the original and the updated improver on one released artifact, is a digital instance of this control.
paragraphs.zh: 后继者可能因为经验积累或更强的起始系统而非更好的改进机制获得更高分数，同期的一项综述也指出了这一点（Zhou et al., 2026a）。 三个细节决定该测试是否有信息量。 第一，冻结必须与改进者知识的形式相匹配：参数化的改进者与其较早的检查点进行比较，基于检索的改进者与其较早的记忆快照进行比较，知识存在于代码或提示词中的改进者则与其较早版本进行比较，同时基础模型、工具和预算保持不变。 这对 R1 已经足够，但 R2 还要求对照修订从同一个父代出发。 这一点在所获知识可以在不改动改进者其余部分的情况下被移除时成立，例如记忆快照或可分离的代码或提示词；当知识存在于改进者的权重中时，恢复较早的检查点也会改变父代，因此参数化改进者的 R2 对照需要专门的设计。 第二，新的失败族必须从改进者曾据以学习的一切中留出；否则该比较衡量的就是记忆。 第三，物理成本应当分阶段：候选流程可以先在仿真或存储的轨迹中筛选，使硬件试验只留给匹配的学习者去执行少数幸存的候选。 每个改进者留一个幸存者时，这两次比较在每个种子下需要四个经硬件训练的学习者，因为第一次比较中更新后改进者的学习者同时充当第二次比较的父代基线：按 FIERCE 的每条件预算约为 1,200 次改进 rollout，不包括评估、重置以及跨失败族的重复。 在评估廉价时，数字先例可以运行这两次比较的近似版本；物理版本则增加了受保护的结果和匹配的下游学习者。 SpecRSI 的同工件比较——在同一个发布工件上运行原始改进者和更新后的改进者——就是这一对照的数字实例。

sents.en: A successor can score higher because of accumulated experience or a stronger starting system rather than a better improvement mechanism, as a concurrent survey also notes ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 后继者可能因为经验积累或更强的起始系统而非更好的改进机制获得更高分数，同期的一项综述也指出了这一点（Zhou et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Three details decide whether the test is informative.
sents.zh: 三个细节决定该测试是否有信息量。

sents.en: First, freezing must match the form of the improver’s knowledge: a parametric improver is compared with its earlier checkpoint, a retrieval-based improver with its earlier memory snapshot, and an improver whose knowledge lives in code or prompts with their earlier versions, while the base model, tools, and budget stay the same.
sents.zh: 第一，冻结必须与改进者知识的形式相匹配：参数化的改进者与其较早的检查点进行比较，基于检索的改进者与其较早的记忆快照进行比较，知识存在于代码或提示词中的改进者则与其较早版本进行比较，同时基础模型、工具和预算保持不变。

sents.en: This suffices for R1, but R2 also requires the control revision to start from the same parent.
sents.zh: 这对 R1 已经足够，但 R2 还要求对照修订从同一个父代出发。

sents.en: That holds when the acquired knowledge can be withheld without changing the rest of the improver, as with a memory snapshot or separable code or prompts; when the knowledge lives in the improver’s weights, restoring the earlier checkpoint also changes the parent, so the R2 control for a parametric improver needs a design of its own.
sents.zh: 这一点在所获知识可以在不改动改进者其余部分的情况下被移除时成立，例如记忆快照或可分离的代码或提示词；当知识存在于改进者的权重中时，恢复较早的检查点也会改变父代，因此参数化改进者的 R2 对照需要专门的设计。

sents.en: Second, the new failure families must be held out from everything the improver has learned from; otherwise the comparison measures memorization.
sents.zh: 第二，新的失败族必须从改进者曾据以学习的一切中留出；否则该比较衡量的就是记忆。

sents.en: Third, the physical cost should be staged: candidate procedures can be screened in simulation or on stored traces, so that hardware trials go to matched learners for the few candidates that survive.
sents.zh: 第三，物理成本应当分阶段：候选流程可以先在仿真或存储的轨迹中筛选，使硬件试验只留给匹配的学习者去执行少数幸存的候选。

sents.en: With one survivor per improver, the two comparisons need four hardware-trained learners per seed, because the updated improver’s learner from the first comparison also serves as the parent baseline of the second: about 1,200 refinement rollouts at FIERCE’s per-condition budget, excluding evaluation, resets, and repetition across failure families.
sents.zh: 每个改进者留一个幸存者时，这两次比较在每个种子下需要四个经硬件训练的学习者，因为第一次比较中更新后改进者的学习者同时充当第二次比较的父代基线：按 FIERCE 的每条件预算约为 1,200 次改进 rollout，不包括评估、重置以及跨失败族的重复。

sents.en: Digital precedents run close analogues of both comparisons when evaluation is cheap; the physical version adds protected outcomes and a matched downstream learner.
sents.zh: 在评估廉价时，数字先例可以运行这两次比较的近似版本；物理版本则增加了受保护的结果和匹配的下游学习者。

sents.en: SpecRSI’s same-artifact comparison, which runs the original and the updated improver on one released artifact, is a digital instance of this control.
sents.zh: SpecRSI 的同工件比较——在同一个发布工件上运行原始改进者和更新后的改进者——就是这一对照的数字实例。

paragraphs.en: Three near-term programs follow from the agenda. First, combine cross-component diagnosis with joint experiment–update selection under matched multi-resource budgets, so that the correct repair and the cost of identifying it both determine success. Second, test versioned evaluators and repair knowledge on held-out failures and declared hardware or software changes, using protected outcome checks to separate transfer from drift. Third, connect these tests across at least two causally isolated procedure-revision rounds and report their full acquisition, maintenance, and revalidation costs.
paragraphs.zh: 根据这一议程，可以得出三个近期项目。 第一，在匹配的多资源预算下，将跨组件诊断与联合实验—更新选择相结合，使正确的修复方式与识别该修复方式的成本共同决定成败。 第二，在留出的失败案例以及已声明的硬件或软件变更上测试带版本管理的评估器与修复知识，并使用受保护的结局检查来区分迁移与漂移。 第三，将这些测试贯穿于至少两个因果隔离的程序修订轮次，并报告其完整的获取、维护与再验证成本。

paragraphs.en: This survey examined how robots that improve from physical experience can move toward recursive self-improvement, in which a system improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. We positioned RSI within robot learning: reinforcement learning, self-training, continual learning, meta-learning, and AutoML say how updates are computed or what they must cope with, whereas a ladder of claims states what an experiment shows to have improved. Along that ladder, we reviewed how physical experience improves policies, world models, and knowledge, the learning procedures that produce them, and the improver that revises those procedures. What limits a robot’s next improvement (RQ1) is rarely visible in a terminal outcome; it is a hypothesis about missing experience, supervision, optimization, action generation, interfaces, or retention, to be tested by intervention rather than inferred from data volume or component accuracy. The changes that address it (RQ2) are kept in policies, world models, external knowledge, or the learning procedure, and they build on one another (RQ3) only under four conditions: feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Physical constraints (RQ4) act through all four: incomplete sensing limits what a signal can distinguish; embodiment interfaces limit what a recipient can execute; wear, calibration drift, and hardware changes drive distribution shift; and reset, safety, and cost bound continued practice.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述考察了能够从物理经验中改进的机器人如何走向递归自我改进，即系统不仅改进其行为，还改进其改进过程本身。 我们将递归自我改进置于机器人学习的框架中：强化学习、自训练、持续学习、元学习和 AutoML 规定了更新如何计算或更新必须应对什么，而一系列等级化的论断则规定了一项实验所展示的改进是什么。 沿着这一等级，我们综述了物理经验如何改进策略、世界模型与知识，产生它们的学习过程，以及修改这些过程的改进者。 限制机器人下一次改进的因素（RQ1）很少能在最终结果中直接看出；它是一个关于缺失经验、监督、优化、动作生成、接口或记忆保持的假设，需要通过干预来检验，而不能从数据量或组件精度中推断。 针对这些限制的改动（RQ2）保存在策略、世界模型、外部知识或学习过程中，而这些改动只有在四个条件下才能相互叠加（RQ3）：反馈能够回应尚存的学习需求、接收组件能够使用该改动、其价值在任务或硬件变化后仍然成立、以及持续练习仍然安全且成本可负担。 物理约束（RQ4）通过全部四个方面起作用：不完整的感知限制了信号所能区分的内容；具身接口限制了接收者所能执行的内容；磨损、校准漂移和硬件变化引发分布偏移；而重置、安全和成本则限制了持续练习。

paragraphs.en: Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, later-learning benefits, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change their improver’s knowledge or tools, but no physical study reviewed here has yet isolated a gain attributable to recursion, which requires a controlled comparison against a version of the improver whose acquired knowledge is frozen. These answers remain provisional, because the four conditions are overlapping diagnostic lenses rather than independently validated constructs and much of the evidence comes from recent preprints with few training runs or trials.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究集中于操作，支持行为改进、后续学习收益以及流程改进。 一些系统还会改变其改进者的知识或工具，但本文综述中尚无物理研究分离出可归因于递归的收益，因为这需要与一个习得知识被冻结的改进者版本进行受控比较。 这些答案仍是暂定性的，因为四个条件是相互重叠的诊断视角而非经过独立验证的构念，且大部分证据来自训练次数或试验次数很少的最新预印本。

paragraphs.en: Digital agents already supply mechanisms for revising their own code and tools. Whether these mechanisms work with physical experience and under physical constraints depends on the open problems identified here: evaluation on tasks the revising system cannot tune against, with matched learners for claims beyond behavior; gains that keep accumulating as data stop teaching and bottlenecks move; practice that stays safe while the procedure governing it changes; and an improver that learns to find bottlenecks, choose experiments, and transfer repair knowledge. Physical recursive self-improvement will be demonstrated not when a robot changes many times, but when knowledge of why one repair worked causally improves how the next repair is made, and when that improved capability, applied to new evidence, helps improve itself again without losing the ability to keep learning. Even a robot that becomes measurably better at rewriting its own recipe for a single family of failures would give the first such evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 数字智能体已经具备了修改自身代码和工具的机制。 这些机制能否结合物理经验并在物理约束下发挥作用，取决于本文指出的开放性问题：在修改系统无法据此调优的任务上进行评估，并使用匹配的学习者来支持超出行为的论断；当数据不再能带来增益、瓶颈转移时仍能持续积累的提升；在控制流程发生变化时保持安全的实践；以及一个学会发现瓶颈、选择实验并迁移修复知识的改进者。 物理递归自我改进的证明，不在于机器人多次改变自身，而在于对某次修复为何有效的因果知识能切实改进下一次修复的方式，并且这种改进后的能力在应用于新证据时，能帮助其再次改进自身而不丧失持续学习的能力。 即使一个机器人仅在单一失败类型上变得可度量地更善于改写自身的方法，也将提供首个这样的证据。

paragraphs.en: Read alongside the mechanism tables, these results distinguish isolated component effects from pipeline gains, hardware outcomes from simulated or formal scores, and acquisition from maintenance costs. Section 4.1 discusses the corresponding comparison and reporting requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些结果与各机制表对照阅读，可以区分单个组件的独立效果与流水线增益、硬件实测结果与仿真或形式化评分，以及获取成本与维护成本。 第4.1节讨论相应的对比与报告要求。

paragraphs.en: This glossary summarizes the terminology used in the review; section references point to the relevant discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 本术语表总结了该综述中使用的术语；章节引用指向相关讨论。

paragraphs.en: The figures in this appendix collect images released with several of the reviewed systems. They show the settings behind the results discussed in Section 3 and Appendix B : robots practising on hardware, fleets that pool experience, simulators and world models paired with real setups, agents that write the code that drives a robot, laboratories that run experiments on their own, and a wider range of robot bodies and settings, from legged and aerial robots to arms working in homes and outdoors. Each caption cites the work and names the source of the image.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录中的图片汇集了随若干所评测系统一同发布的图像。 它们展示了第 3 节和附录 B 中所讨论结果背后的环境：在硬件上练习的机器人、汇集经验的机器人集群、与现实装置配套的模拟器和世界模型、编写驱动机器人代码的智能体、自主运行实验的实验室，以及更广泛的机器人本体和场景，从腿式和飞行机器人到在家庭和户外工作的机械臂。 每条图注都注明了相关工作和图片来源。

sents.zh: 本附录中的图片汇集了随若干所评测系统一同发布的图像。
